title: #2229 Surface empty BCPT results as a warning instead of silent success
summary: When BCPT performance tests produce a results file with no entries, GetBcptSummaryMD now returns a message that appears in the GitHub step summary instead of an empty string. A missing results file still yields an empty summary.

title: #2257 Test Result Analyzer fails if no stack trace is available
summary: Fixed Test Result Analyzer to handle XML elements without stack traces by using InnerText instead of the potentially null text property.

title: #2283 Fix issue 2267: appsourcecop.json is not created for testapps
summary: Test and BCPT apps now generate appsourcecop.json files when code analyzers are enabled on test apps, preventing AS0054 compilation failures.

title: #2286 fix: Refactor GetModifiedSettingsContent for PS5 compatibility
summary: The GetModifiedSettingsContent function now explicitly lists property names instead of using wildcards in Select-Object to ensure compatibility with PowerShell 5.

title: #2300 Make failOn: newWarning work with workspace compilation
summary: The failOn: newWarning setting now detects newly introduced AL compiler warnings when workspace compilation is enabled, by running the check during the compile phase instead of the pipeline phase and handling workspace-format compiler output.

title: #2301 Provide package cache to aldoc when building reference documentation
summary: The aldoc command now receives a populated package cache to resolve cross-module references in generated reference documentation, fixing unresolved links that occurred when building documentation for artifact-based apps.

title: #2304 Support framework-dependent (flat) AL Language extension layout
summary: AL-Go now supports framework-dependent AL Language extensions with flat internal layout by making path resolution aware of both nested and flat folder structures for altool, analyzers, and aldoc.

title: #2313 Fix dependency resolution when branch name contains ']' character
summary: Fixed dependency resolution in GitHub Helper to correctly handle branch names containing the ] character by using literal path interpretation instead of wildcard matching.

title: #2314 Retry current-build dependency artifact download up to 3 times
summary: The Download Project Dependencies action now retries failed artifact downloads up to 3 times with 30-second delays between attempts to handle transient network errors from GitHub's Actions Results service.

title: #2321 fix: error on delivery of multiple release artifacts of same project
summary: The CreateRelease workflow now prevents redundant artifact deliveries by only running NuGet and Storage delivery steps when the matrix processes the Apps artifact type, eliminating duplicate delivery attempts.

title: #2323 Fix enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps not disabling customCodeCops in workspace compilation
summary: Workspace compilation now correctly disables custom code analyzers when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps is false, preventing custom analyzer diagnostics from running against test apps.

title: #2327 Add doNotPerformUpgrade setting and enhance upgrade warning messages
summary: AL-Go pipeline now supports skipping the upgrade phase with a new doNotPerformUpgrade setting while continuing to publish and test apps. Warning messages about upgrade testing have also been improved.

title: #2328 Use cacheImageName for local development environments
summary: Local development environments now use the configured cacheImageName setting to enable reuse of cached Business Central images, reducing container creation time by avoiding repeated Business Central installations.

title: #2330 Emit valid SARIF URIs for AL code analysis paths containing spaces
summary: ProcessALCodeAnalysisLogs now properly URI-encodes file paths with spaces in SARIF output to comply with URI standards and prevent upload warnings.

title: #2331 Support trackALAlertsInGitHub for workspace compilation build path
summary: AL-Go now produces error log files during workspace compilation when GitHub code scanning alerts are enabled, allowing AL compiler diagnostics to surface as code scanning alerts in the workspace build path.

title: #2334 Handle app names with underscores correctly for reference documentation
summary: AL-Go now handles underscores in app names consistently with AlDoc by preserving underscores instead of converting them to dashes when generating reference documentation paths.

title: #2340 Add opt-in unpublishOldVersions setting to unpublish stale PTE app versions after deploy
summary: AL-Go now supports an opt-in setting to automatically unpublish old, uninstalled versions of Per Tenant Extensions after deployment, keeping the Extension Management list clean and reducing clutter.

title: #2342 Fix incremental builds poisoning buildMode-specific artifacts (#2337)
summary: Fixed incremental builds in AL-Go that were corrupting buildMode-specific artifacts by re-publishing default build mode apps under incorrect artifact names, causing dependent projects to fail with runtime version mismatches.

title: #2346 Pin all actions that are not currently pinned
summary: References to GitHub actions that were not yet pinned are now pinned in the BuildPowerPlatform, DeployPowerPlatform and PullPowerPlatformChanges actions. The dependabot configuration also gets a small addition.

title: #2355 Move CreateRelease update check to separate job
summary: The AL-Go CreateRelease workflow now runs update checks in a separate, parallel job instead of blocking release creation, allowing faster releases while keeping the check non-blocking.

title: #2367 Enhance NuGet feed selection to support pre-release packages
summary: AL-Go now supports pre-release NuGet packages by adding an `-allowPrerelease` suffix to the nuGetFeedSelectMode setting, enabling developers to include pre-release versions in dependency resolution.

title: #2376 fix: modified files with umlauts
summary: Incremental build detection now finds project and app paths that contain umlauts or other special characters such as ß. It does this by turning off git path escaping and switching to UTF-8 output encoding while git diff runs.

title: #2378 Retry CI/CD baseline discovery when no eligible run is found
summary: AL-Go now retries CI/CD baseline discovery up to three times when the GitHub workflow-runs API returns incomplete results, with backoff pauses between attempts and pagination resets to avoid missing eligible baselines.

title: #2379 Avoid CI/CD runs for template SHA-only system updates
summary: The system no longer commits template SHA changes when only an empty commit occurs in the template repository, preventing unnecessary CI/CD triggers with no actual file modifications.

title: #2380 Fix device login initialization with a shared authentication action
summary: A shared authentication action now handles device login initialization for AL-Go workflows, ensuring credentials are validated and helpers are available before sign-in instructions are displayed.

title: #2382 Fix dependency artifact pattern for branch names with glob-special characters
summary: Fixed a bug where dependency artifact downloads failed silently when branch names contained special characters that minimatch interprets, such as commas, braces, or parentheses.

title: #2392 AL-Go Telemetry Enhancements: repository fork and hosting information
summary: AL-Go telemetry now captures whether a repository is a fork and its GitHub hosting type (GitHub.com, GHEC, or GHES), helping distinguish workflows across different environments without sending server details to telemetry.

title: #2395 Prevent workflow telemetry failures from failing the workflow
summary: WorkflowPostProcess telemetry failures no longer cause the entire workflow to fail, allowing GitHub API errors during finalization to remain visible in logs without blocking successful builds.

title: #10005 Improve error messages when there are no quantities to reverse in shipped/received lines in Sales/Purchase/Transfer
summary: Error messages when reversing shipped or received lines now distinguish between no reversible quantities and already-reversed lines, providing clearer guidance for users and AI agents.

title: #10007 [SOA] Ignore item availability when disabled
summary: The Sales Order Agent now ignores item availability signals when availability checking is disabled in settings, while still requesting assistance when no item is found.

title: #10008 [MCP] Add codeunit APIs as MCP tools in MCP configuration
summary: Codeunit APIs are now integrated into MCP configuration as a new object type alongside API pages and queries, with unified selection UI and metadata sourced from the Api Web Service table.

title: #10009 Disable low-usage Change Log Entry index
summary: The Change Log Entry table's Key4 index on Notification Message Id is disabled to improve write performance. The index showed negligible read usage (967 reads) compared to extremely high write maintenance costs (1.3 billion writes), making it a significant performance drain.

title: #10010 Add Report Inbox API pages for automated report retrieval
summary: Four new API pages expose Report Inbox data through the 'automate' API group, allowing Power Platform and OData clients to discover and download scheduled report outputs across single or multiple companies.

title: #10011 Improve performance when posting credit memos by skipping unnecessary lookups on empty keys
summary: Credit memo posting now skips unnecessary table lookups when source keys are empty, improving performance for both purchase and sales credit memos without changing functional behavior.

title: #10017 [Master] - Bug 644751 Moving an expense report line to another report wrongly reports a duplicate
summary: Moving an expense report line to another open expense report no longer raises a false duplicate expense violation. The duplicate check no longer compares the moved line against its own source line.

title: #10020 [Master] - Bug 641894: [Expense Agent] [Rules] Mileage expense should not validate require receipt number rule
summary: Mileage expenses in Expense Agent no longer incorrectly trigger the receipt number mandatory validation rule, since mileage never has receipts.

title: #10022 Known senders table should only be inserted to when the task is coming from an email
summary: The Known Senders table now only gets populated when tasks arrive from email, preventing unwanted entries when tasks are created by manually uploading PDFs.

title: #10023 [Master]-Customer Ledger Bill Entries display default Customer Posting Group instead of Alternative Customer Posting Group set on Sales Documents in the Spanish version.
summary: Invoice split payment posting in the Spanish version now preserves the alternative customer posting group from sales documents instead of defaulting to the customer's current posting group.

title: #10029 [Main]-Import of e-documents with format ZUGfERD & XRECHNUNG fail with error message You cannot insert a purchase line without a purchase header in German localisation
summary: An earlier fix in the German XRechnung and ZUGFeRD import codeunits is reverted. The error 'You cannot insert a purchase line without a purchase header' is now handled by a separate change to Purchase Line and Sales Line in another PR.

title: #10030 [main]planning worksheet requires second runof calculate regenerative plan
summary: The low-level code calculation engine now processes SKU-level production BOMs correctly, ensuring planning worksheets generate all required planning lines in a single run for multi-level assemblies when BOMs are defined at the SKU level rather than the item card.

title: #10031 Add AI-assisted policy evaluation backend to Expense Agent
summary: Expense Agent now supports AI-assisted policy evaluation, storing immutable evaluation results for each policy and expense report subject, with new tables, pages, and APIs to track compliance status and enable policy validation at approval.
tags: page exp. report line particip. api
page exp. report line per diem api
page expense report line item api

title: #10032 Fix Agent List and Agent Task List filter and refresh issues (AB#646062)
summary: Fixed filter visibility and refresh issues on Agent List and Agent Task List pages by moving system-managed filters from the user-owned filter group to the server-owned filter group, and updated the Archive action guard to re-read the agent state from the database instead of relying on cached page data.

title: #10034 [Shopify] Don't block Shops page when user lacks extension permissions
summary: The Shopify Shops page no longer fails to open on Belgian environments when users lack extension installation permissions. A permission error during the installation status check now skips the notification instead of blocking the page.

title: #10036 [SOA]: Bugbash for releases 28.x - Contact unable to find due to Qasim map to Megan, different names
summary: Fixes Sales Order Agent contact lookup and reply routing when a sender's email is mapped to a different contact. Lookup, filtering and recipient resolution now consider E-Mail 2 and the task contact override, and replies go to the mapped contact's primary email in the same thread.

title: #10041 [Master]-]G/L Account Sheet with Foreign Currency report (11564) includes LCY-originated entries after enabling G/L currency revaluation feature resulting in mixed-currency totals in the Swiss version. - Copy
summary: G/L Account Sheet with Foreign Currency report in Swiss version now correctly excludes local currency entries when G/L currency revaluation is enabled, ensuring totals reflect only foreign currency amounts.
tags: report sr g/l acc sheet foreign curr

title: #10047 [main] bug 646167 - Enhance VIES Declaration pages: update option captions for declaration types
summary: Updates the option captions for declaration types on the CZ VIES Declaration Header CZL table. The description also mentions moving the Corrective-Supplementary check behind an OnBeforeCheckDeclarationType event, but the small diff (+2 -3) does not clearly reflect that.

title: #10048 Add GTIN to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports
summary: GTIN codes from item cards are now exported to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD documents with GS1 scheme, enabling recipients to identify invoiced items by their standard product identifier.

title: #10049 Removed the ReplicateData=false property
summary: Three Spend Request tables had an incorrectly applied ReplicateData property removed to restore proper data replication behavior.
tags: table spend request to g/l link

title: #10050 Bug 638128: Deadlock in Duplicate Management when multiple users create customers at the same time
summary: Fixes a deadlock in Duplicate Management that could happen when several users create customers, and therefore contacts, at the same time. The change is a one-line addition to codeunit 5060 DuplicateManagement.

title: #10051 Bug 642053: [master] [Sustainability] Preview Posting Creates Gaps in Sustainability Ledger Entry Numbers
summary: Preview posting of journal lines and documents that carry sustainability emissions no longer leaves gaps in Sustainability Ledger Entry numbers. Preview rows are now collected in memory under temporary numbers instead of being inserted, so no AutoIncrement identity is used. Normal posting is unchanged.

title: #10055 Fix: migrating a document attachment deletes shared Tenant Media
summary: Document attachment migration no longer deletes shared Tenant Media records, preventing silent loss of content when attachments are copied to posted documents.

title: #10056 [Master]- Cartera: Service Credit Memo cannot be posted - settlement check ignores Applies-to Doc. No. and Application Method.
summary: Service credit memos in Spanish localization can now be posted when using Cartera settlement, as the posting logic now properly respects the Applies-to Document No. and Application Method fields during validation.

title: #10058 [Master]-Withholding Tax Posting generates Unbalanced G/L Entries when Multiple Withholding Tax Rates are used on one Purchase Invoice.
summary: The withholding tax posting calculation is corrected to prevent unbalanced G/L entries when multiple withholding tax rates apply to a single purchase invoice.

title: #10061 [Master]-Payment Reference from Purchase Order Prepayment Invoice is not Transferred to Vendor Ledger Entries.
summary: Payment reference from purchase order prepayment invoices is now transferred to vendor ledger entries when posting prepayment invoices.

title: #10064 Add support for “External Document No.” in Subscription Contracts Fixes #8818
summary: Subscription Contracts now support an External Document No. field that is automatically transferred to generated sales documents and posted invoices, improving support for EAN invoicing scenarios.

title: #10065 [Quality Management] Quality Inspection User assignment fixes
summary: Fixes a table relation error when manually selecting an assigned user on a quality inspection, and shows a self-assignment notification when modifying an inspection that has no assigned user.

title: #10066 [PEPPOL] Handle unknown persisted PEPPOL format values
summary: The PEPPOL 3.0 Format enum now handles persisted format values that become unknown when their declaring extension is uninstalled, preventing runtime errors and prompting users to select an available format.

title: #10067 [Quality Management] Enable Bin code selection for transfer disposition in workflow response
summary: Bin code selection is now available for transfer disposition in workflow responses for quality inspections, matching the behavior of the manual disposition form.

title: #10072 [main] - Serial and Lot number mismatch when item is produced via Production Order and moved to inventory through an Internal Put-away
summary: Registering a warehouse put-away now checks each line that has a Serial No. against the open Item Ledger Entry for that item, variant, location and serial number. If that entry has a Lot No., the line's Lot No. must match it, so a blank or wrong lot can no longer be registered, for example after an internal put-away of produced items.

title: #10079 [main] features 640066 Add integration events for events for CZ Adv. Payment and CZ Cash Desk
summary: Integration events added for Czech advance payment and cash desk functionality to allow customization of validation and lookup behavior on cash document lines, with optional skipping of amount field validation.

title: #10080 Bug 646141: Forward-port Subcontracting Dispatch List action from 28.x to main
summary: Forward-ports the app-owned Subcontractor Dispatch List action to the Subcontracting Work Center Card extension and removes the obsolete modify of the Base Application action, resolving AppSourceCop AS0031. The retained legacy Base Application action is now captioned Subcontractor - Dispatch List (Obsolete).

title: #10083 [main]- Negative Shipped and Invoiced Quantities appear on Sales Order Lines after using the Copy Document from a Sales Credit Memo.
summary: When a sales credit memo created with Copy Document from a posted invoice that has the same item on several lines is posted, each credit memo line now resolves to a different invoice line. This stops negative Quantity Shipped and Quantity Invoiced on one sales order line while another order line stays unchanged.

title: #10084 Let the agent update invoice due dates on user instructions
summary: The Payables Agent can now update due dates on purchase invoices when requested by users during draft review by making the Due Date field visible in the agent's page customization.

title: #10086 Make AA0194 an error in the base ruleset
summary: AA0194 code analysis rule is now enforced as an error instead of a warning in the base application ruleset, requiring all actions to have either an OnAction trigger or RunObject property.

title: #10088 Harden base ruleset: promote 21 rules back to Error
summary: 21 analyzer rules were promoted from Warning back to Error in the base ruleset after measuring violations across all country-specific builds, with source code fixes applied where needed to address the handful of violations found.
tags: codeunit vat pmt. comm. xml generator

title: #10090 [Bank Acc. Reconciliation with Copilot] Read the functional part of the prompt from .resources and safety clause from Key Vault
summary: Bank account reconciliation with Copilot now loads the functional part of AI prompts from resource files and retrieves only the safety clause from Key Vault, improving separation of concerns.
tags: codeunit bank acc. rec. trans. to acc.
codeunit bank rec. ai matching impl.

title: #10092 [Shopify] Add cues for Skipped Records and API Errors on Activities page
summary: Two new cues on the Shopify Activities page display counts of skipped sync records and API errors, making background job issues visible without manually opening logs.

title: #10093 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling]: "Prices Including VAT" handling is incomplete — contract billing invoice treats VAT‑exclusive Subscription Line amounts as VAT‑inclusive
summary: The Subscription Billing contract billing feature now correctly grosses up net prices to VAT-inclusive amounts when a customer or vendor uses prices including VAT, ensuring VAT calculations reconcile with the original order.

title: #10094 [Main]- Standard-cost purchase receipts use Direct Unit Cost instead of Standard Cost when cumulative expected-cost rounding is enabled
summary: Standard-cost items now correctly use Standard Cost instead of Direct Unit Cost when calculating expected cost on purchase receipts with cumulative rounding enabled, preventing inventory overstatement and ensuring purchase variance is properly recognized on invoicing.

title: #10096 Fix Close Income Statement grouping when no dimensions are selected
summary: Fixed the Close Income Statement report to properly group G/L entries by account, business unit, and source currency when no dimensions are selected, and ensured closing lines retain source currency codes even when amounts net to zero.

title: #10098 Reenable Expense Agent VAT tests
summary: Expense Agent VAT posting tests are re-enabled by removing them from the disabled tests list. The PR also makes a small change to the IT version of the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit and a one-line change to the VAT test codeunit.

title: #10100 [Bug 644091] Separate B2B and B2C HSN summaries in GSTR-1 report
summary: The GSTR-1 report now handles B2B and B2C HSN summaries separately through conditional filtering based on the selected Nature of Supply, with fallback to combined output when no specific category is chosen.

title: #10101 [Master] [Expense Agent] Bug 641393 [AT] Recognize International Standard Code 1A as mileage UOM
summary: The mileage unit of measure filter now recognizes the Austrian 'Meilen' unit with International Standard Code 1A, allowing it to appear in the Default Mileage UOM selector in Expense Agent setup.

title: #10123 [Extensibility Request] issue 30401: add credit memo sales line filter event
summary: An integration event OnUpdateSalesDocumentOnBeforeFindSetCreditMemoSalesLine was added to the Sales-Post Prepayments codeunit, allowing extensions to filter credit memo sales lines during prepayment document processing.

title: #10124 [Extensibility Request] issue 30400: add credit memo line filter event
summary: A new integration event allows extensions to filter purchase credit memo lines before they are selected during prepayment document updates, enabling customization without replacing standard posting logic.

title: #10125 [Extensibility Request] issue 30395: expose production pick grouping number
summary: A new event enables extensions to modify the warehouse pick grouping number for production order components, allowing separate activity lines to be created for each component instead of using the same grouping number.

title: #10126 [Extensibility Request] issue 30389: allow skipping service item confirmation
summary: The ServItemManagement codeunit now allows extensions to skip the service item confirmation dialog through a new event parameter while preserving the standard creation logic.

title: #10127 [Extensibility Request] issue 30379: enable grouped pick printing
summary: Report 5754 now exposes pick headers before printing through an event, allowing extensions to implement grouped printing while preserving the default behavior.

title: #10128 [Extensibility Request] issue 30357: add prepayment credit memo confirmation event
summary: A handled event is added to the prepayment credit memo posting process, allowing extensions to replace the standard confirmation dialog just as they can for prepayment invoices.

title: #10129 [Extensibility Request] issue 30342: allow skipping blocked item checks
summary: ServContractManagement gets two separate IsHandled events so extensions can skip the blocked service item check or the blocked item and variant check. This lets them keep invoicing contracts whose references were later blocked or deleted.

title: #10130 [ExpenseAgent] Expose VatSpecifications on Expense API Page
summary: The Expense API page now exposes VAT specifications through a new part, and a new capability is added to the Expense Agent for backwards compatibility.

title: #10131 [Extensibility Request] issue 30298: allow production scheduling direction control
summary: Production order line quantity changes can now be extended to control scheduling direction, allowing backward or forward rescheduling instead of only backward scheduling.

title: #10134 [Bug 646487] Composite layout: focus fix, body-layout gating, and setup UI
summary: Multiple bugs in composite layout management are fixed, including focus handling, multi-select deletion, configuration key conflicts, and layout subtype restrictions. UI labels are clarified and a Details FactBox replaces the Theme and Header/Footer Box.

title: #10135 [Master]-Performance issue when calculating the VAT advance return / VAT statement (Base Application, German environment) - Copy
summary: Removed database keys from the VAT Entry table in CH and DACH environments to prevent performance degradation on CRUD operations, reverting an earlier attempt to address VAT statement calculation issues.

title: #10136 [CH][SEPA CT] Export requires both IBAN and Clearing No. for domestic payments and refunds
summary: Swiss SEPA CT export now automatically extracts the clearing number from the IBAN when not explicitly provided, ensuring both values are populated for domestic payments and refunds.

title: #10141 [Quality Management] Make transaction blocked error more understandable and actionable
summary: Quality Management transaction blocking errors now display more clearly with actionable information. Error messages become clickable and show context of the source quality inspection, and all affected item tracking lines are processed rather than stopping at the first error.

title: #10143 Handle non-invoice or currupt PDF extraction
summary: E-document extraction now detects non-invoice or corrupt PDFs that return empty data and stops with a clear error, preventing creation of empty drafts and unnecessary vendor searches.

title: #10149 Improve the Index Mgmt page discoverability
summary: The index management page can now be opened directly from Tell Me or direct access, and it then shows a table selection dialog. Table Information gets a button to open it instead of the previous hyperlink, and empty datetimes show a dash instead of the minimum value.

title: #10150 [Bug 617189] Clarify strict expiration posting tooltip
summary: The tooltip for Strict Expiration Posting in Item Tracking Code now clarifies that it uses First-Expired-First-Out picking for tracked items, independent of the location's FEFO setting.

title: #10151 Fix vendor contact relation read permission
summary: Vendor changes made through indirect permissions no longer fail when the contact update check reads Contact Business Relation. VendCont-Update now elevates read permission on that table, and CustCont-Update and BankCont-Update get the same small edit.

title: #10155 Slice 641293: [Expense Agent] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configurationAdded more locations
summary: Expense Agent now includes comprehensive expense locations for all country/regions with corresponding expense rule headers and conditions to support more detailed per-diem and rule configuration.

title: #10156 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Assign Subscription Lines dialog does not identify the sales line it was opened for
summary: The Assign Subscription Lines dialog caption now shows the sales line No. and Description, and a new event lets extensions supply their own caption. During Explode BOM, package assignment now runs only once per component line, so the dialog no longer opens twice per component.

title: #10158 Add details to project sales tooltip
summary: Project Sales by Project chart now displays project description and customer name in the tooltip alongside the project number to help users identify projects and customers without reducing visual readability.

title: #10159 Warn when missing Power BI Account Categories Mappings
summary: The Power BI Reports Setup page now warns users when Power BI Account Categories mappings are missing, a common problem in customer setups. The check is implemented in the Finance Installation Handler codeunit.

title: #10162 Fix stale start status in e-document import pipeline
summary: The e-document import pipeline now uses the initial processing status instead of the post-undo status for telemetry emission and event triggering, fixing an edge case where no telemetry or event was sent after undoing to unprocessed.

title: #10164 Correction of where inventory valuation Power BI reports are shown
summary: Inventory valuation Power BI reports now appear only in the Business Manager Role Center with their own dedicated section, instead of being shown in the Finance Manager Role Center.

title: #10165 [Extensibility Request] issue 29901: expose item application entry before find
summary: Adds an event in Undo Sales Shipment Line before the filtered Item Application Entry is retrieved when undoing a drop shipment, so subscribers can adjust loaded fields and avoid JIT load-field errors on extension fields.

title: #10166 [Extensibility Request] issue 29643: enable split transfer demand profiles
summary: Transfer demand profile handling now supports an event that allows extensions to create multiple profiles for different planning contexts, such as preserving distinct cable and cut-length requirements instead of aggregating quantities.

title: #10167 [Extensibility Request] issue 30240: add event before adding price list lines
summary: A cancellable event is added before price list line creation so extensions can implement custom logic or replace the standard line creation behavior.

title: #10168 [APAC] Keep vendor ACY on purchase invoice payables entry
summary: The posting engine in APAC regions now correctly preserves the vendor-calculated additional reporting currency on payables entries, preventing unbalanced ACY amounts and spurious residual entries when posting purchase invoices with blank currencies and non-zero vendor exchange rates.

title: #10169 [Extensibility Request] issue 30081: add VAT registration number override event
summary: An integration event allows extensions to override VAT registration number formatting in Intrastat reports before standard concatenation logic runs.

title: #10171 [Extensibility Request] issue 30110: add prepayment update events
summary: Sales prepayment posting now exposes two integration events that allow extensions to customize which lines are included in redistribution and modify each line before persistence without duplicating standard logic.

title: #10172 [Extensibility Request] issue 30111: add purchase prepayment update events
summary: Three integration events are added to the purchase prepayment line update procedure, allowing extensions to adjust line selection, handle missing-lines errors, and modify custom fields before each line update.

title: #10173 [Extensibility Request] issue 30129: expose manufacturing cost calculation events
summary: Manufacturing extensions can now separate setup and runtime costs during standard cost calculation by subscribing to new routing, cost-time, direct unit cost, and production order cost events in Calculate Standard Cost and Manufacturing Cost Calculation Management codeunits.

title: #10174 [Extensibility Request] issue 30137: allow overriding cost share application
summary: An integration event was added to the Cost Shares Breakdown report to allow extensions to override how cost share application calculates and applies cost values to capacity and overhead amounts.

title: #10176 [Main][all-e]Prepayment Invoice and Quantity Change Issue in Business Central
summary: Fixes an issue with prepayment invoices when the quantity is changed on purchase or sales lines. Purchase Line and Sales Line tables were updated in many localization layers, and tests were added.

title: #10179 [master] Financial Report Recalculate clears Global Dimension filters
summary: Recalculating a financial report no longer clears Global Dimension filters on the Acc. Schedule Overview page. The fix preserves in-page filter values during recalculation.

title: #10182 [Bug]: [Subscription Billing] Payment discount on contract invoices comes from the customer, not from the contract's payment terms
summary: Payment discount percentages on subscription billing invoices now correctly use the contract's payment terms instead of the customer or vendor's payment terms.

title: #10183 Bug 646432: [master] [Sustainability] Line does not indicate/enforce which Calculation Foundation is in use; all formula input fields are editable
summary: Sustainability Journal and Purchase Order lines now enforce field editability based on the selected account category's Calculation Foundation and Emission Scope, preventing users from editing formula inputs that are not supported by the chosen calculation method.

title: #10184 [Mai][German Localization] Recurring Frequency DateFormula Exports as Invariant Tokens (+1D/+1Y) Instead of Localized UI Tokens (+1T/+1J) in ExcelInital commit
summary: The Recurring General Journal page now exports recurring frequency date formulas in localized UI tokens (like +1T for German) instead of invariant tokens (+1D) when exporting to Excel or OData.

title: #10185 Fix Reduce Contacts report silently ignores contacts whose company no…
summary: The Remove Contacts report now correctly handles contacts whose company reference doesn't match their actual company, filtering by contact number for single contacts and by company number only for entire companies.

title: #10205 Deprecate Text Completion API in AI SDK (work item 621038)
summary: The Text Completion API in the Azure OpenAI AI module is marked obsolete and guarded with conditional compilation to prepare for its removal, as Azure OpenAI has retired the davinci models.

title: #10206 Bug 646576: Preserve manually changed component Flushing Method on subcontracting transfers
summary: Production order components in subcontracting transfers no longer lose their manually set Flushing Method when moved to or from the subcontractor location. A new helper function preserves the Flushing Method during automatic location changes while maintaining all validation side effects.
tags: codeunit subc. prod. order comp. ext.

title: #10207 [Dataverse] Use Truncate for CRM Integration Record cleanup during environment copy
summary: Environment copy cleanup of CRM Integration Records now uses bulk truncate instead of row-by-row deletion to improve performance on large coupling tables, with fallback to the original DeleteAll method when truncate is unsupported.

title: #10208 [Subcontracting] Detect subcontracting purchase/transfer orders in legacy data check
summary: The legacy data check for subcontracting now detects production-order-linked purchase and transfer orders to ensure migration runs when needed, and renames an internal function for clarity.

title: #10209 Promote AA0471, AA0472 and AA0474 to Error in the base ruleset
summary: Three analyzer rules (AA0471, AA0472, AA0474) are promoted from None to Error in the base ruleset, with violations in the Withholding Tax app fixed by adding missing AutoFormatExpression attributes to amount fields.
tags: tableextension wht empl. ledger entry ext

title: #10210 [Bug][Subscription Billing] "Delete Invoiced Sales Orders" leaves orphaned Sales Subscription Lines behind
summary: Fixed orphaned Sales Subscription Lines left behind by "Delete Invoiced Sales Orders" and "Delete Invd Blnkt Sales Orders" reports by adding event subscribers and batch deletion procedures on the Sales Header table extension.

title: #10211 [master] Projects WIP related field tooltips missing broken grammar outdated terminology
summary: Tooltips for WIP-related fields in the Job table were fixed: missing tooltips were added, broken grammar was corrected and outdated terminology was updated.

title: #10212 Add SetReferenceType method to SignedXml and SignedXmlImpl (#10139)
summary: A SetReferenceType method is added to the SignedXml codeunit to allow callers to set the Type property on XMLDSIG Reference elements, enabling creation of XML signatures with typed references such as references to XAdES SignedProperties.

title: #10213 Bug 8845 Old Prices Calculated in Req. Worksheet
summary: When other fields on a Requisition Line are validated, Order Date is no longer set to a date before the work date, so prices are calculated correctly. Starting Date is now only updated through validation, so validating Order Date from code no longer sets it directly.

title: #10214 [Main]Posting Error with 50% Non-Deductible VAT when "Check Source Currency Consistency" is enabled in "General Ledger Setup" page
summary: Fixed a posting error that occurred when posting purchase documents with 50% non-deductible VAT in a foreign currency while source currency consistency checking was enabled. The source currency VAT amount for deductible VAT entries now correctly excludes the non-deductible portion.

title: #10216 Fix Purchase Journal document amount decimal formatting
summary: The Purchase Journal page now refreshes its Document Amount field formatting when a vendor is validated, so it immediately reflects the correct decimal-place settings from the vendor's currency instead of retaining the previous format.

title: #10220 [main] Calculate Inventory - Add check to skip report processing if Warehouse Entry table is empty
summary: The Calculate Inventory report now skips its per-iteration Warehouse Entry processing when the Warehouse Entry table is completely empty. This avoids needless work in databases that have no warehouse entries.

title: #10225 [Master]-When we run the Order Planning Worksheet by Project, a supply suggestion is created for items that are already received but not invoiced in Purchase Orders, but only after updating Order and Posting Dates on Purchase Order.
summary: Fixes Order Planning Worksheet run by project creating supply suggestions for items already received but not invoiced on purchase orders, which happened after the order and posting dates on the purchase order were updated. The change is in the Get Unplanned Demand codeunit.

title: #10227 Fix regression introduced by Apply-to-Oldest optimization
summary: The Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit was fixed to resolve a regression introduced by the Apply-to-Oldest optimization that affected application logic in general ledger posting.

title: #10230 [Main]<ImporteTAIReglasLocalizacion> node should have negative sign in the SII XML for Sales Credit Memos under One-Stop-Shop regime in the Spanish version
summary: The ImporteTAIReglasLocalizacion node in Spanish SII XML for sales credit memos under One-Stop-Shop regime now displays the correct negative sign when submitted.

title: #10232 Block unauthorized Sales Order Agent setup access
summary: The SOA Setup page now validates user permissions before allowing access to Sales Order Agent configuration, preventing unauthorized users from bypassing agent authorization controls.

title: #10235 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Enforce Subscription Line Start Date change rules on all edit paths
summary: Subscription Line start date changes are now blocked when billing has occurred, preventing periods from being invoiced multiple times or skipped. The validation runs on all edit paths instead of just two subpages.

title: #10238 Remove consumed credits from Payables Agent setup
summary: The Payables Agent setup page no longer displays consumed Copilot credits information, and the related calculation code has been removed as part of monetization changes.

title: #10247 [SOA] Show Cc recipients on email messages
summary: Sales Order Agent email cards now display Cc recipients in a read-only field, matching Business Central's Email Viewer formatting, with special handling for mapped-contact replies and calculation failures.

title: #10248 Bug 646799: Spend Request fields in Posted Gen. Journal Line have wrong/different field numbers in country versions (correct in w1)
summary: Spend Request field numbers in the Posted Gen. Journal Line table (181) are corrected in 13 country layers so they match the W1 version.

title: #10251 Ruleset hardening: promote 5 rules from Warning to Error
summary: Five analyzer rules (AL0547, AL0679, AW0014, AS0058, PTE0007) were promoted back to Error by removing their overrides from the base ruleset. Violations were fixed by adding a missing codeunit to a permission set and unhiding an action group, or suppressed with documented pragmas.

title: #10252 Adjust audit log tables
summary: Four lines referring to audit log tables were removed from codeunit 8390 Financial Report Auditing, per work item AB#646814.

title: #10253 Avoid starting a write transaction under `ShowCanCreateAgent`
summary: Payables Agent Setup no longer starts a write transaction when computing ShowCanCreateAgent. This avoids problems when third-party code commits, asks for confirmation and then opens a page, while a separate platform bug remains open.

title: #10254 Fix 644744: Undo subcontracting receipt keys Item Entry Relation with Capacity Ledger Entry No.
summary: Subcontracting purchase receipt undo now uses the correct Output Item Ledger Entry instead of the Capacity Ledger Entry No. when recording item entry relations, preventing data corruption and duplicate key errors for tracked items.

title: #10255 Add expense activity history foundation
summary: Expense activity history foundation adds tracking of lifecycle events for expense reports with an append-only activity log table, read-only APIs scoped by report and user role, factbox UI components, and comprehensive test coverage.

title: #10256 [Shopify] Fix customer matching when phone numbers contain spaces
summary: When exporting customers to Shopify, the connector now strips phone numbers down to the plus sign and digits before searching. It accepts a search result only if the phone or email matches exactly. Formatted phone numbers no longer match unrelated Shopify customers, which used to make the export get skipped with a misleading 'already exists' message.

title: #10259 Slice 550732: Keep routing descriptions when vendor changes
summary: When the vendor changes on a subcontracting requisition line, Description and Description 2 are now kept from the matching production order routing line. The work-center descriptions are still used when the routing line is missing, belongs to another work center, or has a blank Description 2.

title: #10270 [Quality Management] Repair and improve XML documentation of procedures
summary: XML documentation for Quality Management procedures has been repaired and improved across numerous codeunits, tables, pages, and reports.

title: #10276 [master] Renewal Term field on the Create Contract Renewal Quote page does not accept the entered value such as 12M
summary: The Renewal Term field on the Create Contract Renewal Quote page now correctly accepts and retains entered values like '12M' instead of resetting to blank when the field is exited.

title: #10277 Slice 554749: Inventory put-away/pick support for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers
summary: Inventory put-away and pick functionality is now supported for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers, with proper handling of quantities, item tracking, bin propagation, and partial posting scenarios.

title: #10278 Subcontracting Operation Notes
summary: Subcontracting operations now support dedicated comments at the standard task, routing line, and production order routing line levels, which flow to subcontracting purchase orders as attached blank lines while production-order attachments flow to related purchase lines.

codeunit subc. prod. order rtng. ext.

title: #10279 [Extensibility Request] issue 30414: add sales budget navigation events
summary: Integration events are added to the Sales Budget Overview Matrix page so extensions can adjust Item Budget Name filters during record navigation operations.

title: #10281 [Extensibility Request] issue 30416: add purchase budget navigation events
summary: The purchase budget overview matrix page now exposes before and after integration events around record navigation calls, allowing extensions to adjust Item Budget Name filters during navigation without replacing standard behavior.

title: #10283 [Extensibility Request] issue 30419: add time sheet filtering events
summary: Integration events are added to report 952 Suggest Job Jnl. Lines to allow extensions to filter time sheet headers and lines before they are processed.

title: #10285 [Extensibility Request] issue 29642: add Inventory Valuation events
summary: Inventory Valuation report 10139 now exposes two integration events to let extensions skip items and adjust Value Entry filters, matching the W1 report's extensibility.

title: #10287 Move SOA item search and attachment extraction to GPT-5.5 deployments
summary: Sales Order Agent AI operations move to GPT-5.5 chat deployments for attachment extraction, item search expansion, and item selection while leaving other SOA AI calls on GPT-4.1.

title: #10290 [Main] -Drop shipment undo receipt fails for service and non-inventory items.
summary: Undo receipt and undo shipment operations now work correctly for drop shipments involving service and non-inventory items by removing unnecessary cost application filters and adding a fallback lookup method through drop shipment links.

title: #10293 [Master] - Bug 641309: [Sustainability][Value Chain] Item Reclassification (location move) uses average emissions instead of Specific carbon tracking (lot/serial)
summary: Item reclassifications now track specific carbon emissions (by lot/serial) instead of using average emissions, and Carbon Tracking Method validation is enforced in all contexts including non-UI operations.

title: #10294 [SOA] Fix missing Agent Task Message read permission in contact search
summary: SOA Contact Search Impl now has read permission for Agent Task Message, allowing the Sales Order Agent to complete contact-mapping flows without permission intervention.

title: #10298 [main]A WIP Balance is presented incorrectly on the “Production Order – WIP” Report 5802 after Finishing Production Order Without Output Item Ledger Entry posted with new Manufacturing Setup option for no Output required.
summary: Report 5802 now displays a new Expensed WIP column to correctly show work-in-progress that was written off when production orders are finished without output, resolving a reconciliation issue with the general ledger.

title: #10301 [Master]-Bug 646962: Withholding Tax Posting Setup
summary: Withholding Tax Posting Setup now validates that certain options are only available for employee-related withholding taxes, and blocks threshold period selection when inappropriate. This prevents misconfiguration when setting up withholding tax rules for vendors.

title: #10302 [SOA] Clarify contact mapping options for unknown email senders
summary: The contact-link dialog for unmatched email senders now clearly separates task-level contact overrides from updating contact data, shows the sender's email address, explains that matching uses both E-Mail and E-Mail 2, and spells out the E-Mail 2 replacement values.

title: #10303 [Master]-Modifying a linked contact's common field clears the SIREN field on the associated customer record in the French version.
summary: The French version now correctly preserves the SIREN field on a customer record when modifying a linked contact's common fields, fixing an issue where the field was being cleared.

title: #10307 [Shopify] Fix Order Totals factbox opening an unrelated sales order for a linked posted invoice
summary: The Shopify Order Totals factbox now correctly resolves and displays totals for open sales orders, open sales invoices, and posted sales invoices by using the document link table, and navigates to the correct document type instead of always opening a sales order.

title: #10308 Uptake agent archiving in Sales Order Agent (AB#644549)
summary: The Sales Order Agent app now supports agent archiving, a soft delete capability that marks deactivated agents as read-only while preserving their data. Archived agents no longer consume instance slots, their identities and mailboxes can be reused by administrators, and the setup experience becomes read-only for archived agents.

title: #10311 [Master] - Slice 640778: [Sustainability] Sustainability Entries should be more easy to find like other entries across BC
summary: Sustainability entries can now be found more easily through a Find Entries action on the Sustainability Ledger Entries page and new Sustainability Value Entries actions on Item Card and Item List pages.

title: #10312 Update expense VAT specification source
summary: Expense Agent now sets the Source of VAT specification records to Agent when created through the API and Manual when created in the UI, blocks changes and deletions of agent-created records, and gives more specific errors when posting expense reports with pending VAT reclaim status.

title: #10331 [Master]-Missing VAT Identifier in Peppol XML for Zero-Value Invoice
summary: PEPPOL XML export now includes the VAT identifier for zero-value invoices, where it was previously missing. The fix is in the PEPPOL30 Impl. codeunit, and BIS billing tests were added.

title: #10332 [Main]]No Employee posting group for AT when new employee is created
summary: An Austrian localization issue where new employees created from templates lacked an employee posting group assignment has been fixed by applying the EMPLEXP posting group to employee templates.

title: #10334 Add integration event OnAfterGetRecordOnAfterConfirmAndModify in the General Posting Setup dataitem OnAfterGetRecord trigger after Modify.
summary: Report 87 now raises an integration event after modifying records in the General Posting Setup dataitem when the user confirms the action, enabling partners to hook into this specific point in the workflow.

title: #10335 Unblock bc login due to pp failures
summary: Business Central sign-in no longer blocks when Power Platform environment lookup fails. The change handles lookup failures gracefully by logging telemetry for diagnosis while allowing sign-in to proceed.

title: #10336 [Main]- Incorrect calculation of single-level capacity and material cost for Stockkeeping Units (SKU) when running cost changes in the Standard Cost Worksheet and implementing the Standard Cost change
summary: The Implement Standard Cost Change report no longer copies an item's updated cost shares to its stockkeeping units in the Load SKU Cost on Manufacturing mode, where it used to ignore that setting. Users are told to recalculate SKU costs with Calc. Standard Cost on the Stockkeeping Unit Card.

title: #10337 Let subscribers override the half-year new year date in SetHalfYearConventionMethod
summary: The OnBeforeSetHalfYearConventionMethod event now allows subscribers to override the accounting period start date used for half-year depreciation calculations by adding a trailing var parameter that subscribers can populate.

title: #10341 Remove Anthropic privacy notice from Expense Agent
summary: Anthropic privacy notice components are removed from Expense Agent with the original page marked for future removal, while upgrade logic attempts to clean up persisted legacy data.

title: #10342 Add GLN information to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports
summary: GLN identifiers with schemeID 0088 are now included in German XRechnung and ZUGFeRD electronic document exports, respecting customer GLN settings and address hierarchy rules.

title: #10343 [Subcontracting] Bug 641241: Notify to install Subcontracting app in Subcontracting Worksheet
summary: A notification now prompts users on SaaS to install the Subcontracting app when they access the obsolete Subcontracting Worksheet page, with options to install or dismiss the message.

title: #10345 [Main][ALL-E]Issues with Service Contract Invoicing and Retrospective Billing--when the second unposted Service Invoice is deleted the values on the Service Contract are no longer reset--The "Invoiced to Date" field does not resetInitial commit
summary: Fixed an issue where the Invoiced to Date field on service contracts failed to reset when a second unposted service invoice was deleted, by improving the logic to count only non-reversed ledger entries.

title: #10346 Fix activity log indirect permissions
summary: The Expense Agent and Expense Management permission sets now grant indirect permissions on Expense Activity Log Entry to prevent SaaS entitlement failures when users create lifecycle activity entries, while keeping all writes code-mediated through the activity log manager.

title: #10347 [Bug][Subscription Billing] Wrong number of days on vendor contract deferrals when the billing period lies within a single calendar month
summary: Vendor subscription contract deferrals now calculate the correct number of days when a billing period falls entirely within a single calendar month, fixing day counts that previously extended to the month's end.

title: #10348 Adding a Power BI workspace to Company Information to be used when deploying reports
summary: Company Information now supports configuring a Power BI Workspace to serve as the target destination for deploying Power BI reports from Business Central.

title: #10349 [DE] Support registration numbers in E-Documents
summary: E-Document import and export processing now handles registration numbers for vendor matching and supports German FC tax identifiers in multiple document formats.

title: #10352 [Master]-Bug 646964: Withholding Tax Prod. Posting Group is missing o…
summary: The Withholding Tax Prod. Posting Group field, previously missing, is now shown on the General Journal and Payment Journal pages through new page extensions in the Withholding Tax app.

title: #10359 Add activity log amount formatting metadata
summary: Amount fields in the Expense Activity Log Entry table now include currency-aware formatting metadata to display local currency and reimbursement currency values correctly.

title: #10361 [main] Line Discount Amount Rounding Discrepancy When Transferring Project Planning Lines to Sales Invoice
summary: Line Discount Amount is now correctly preserved when transferring project planning lines to a sales invoice, eliminating rounding discrepancies caused by recalculation from the rounded percentage.

title: #10364 Create released production orders from planning worksheet
summary: The carry out action message feature on the planning worksheet now supports creating released production orders directly, with options to release them immediately or release and print them.

summary: Two searchable fields in Quality Management's Inspection Header table now use optimized text search to improve performance on large datasets.

title: #10368 Bug 614967: Skip mismatched TransferFields in posting
summary: Sales and Purchase posting now skip fields with mismatched types when transferring from source to posted records, allowing posting to continue even when extension fields reuse the same field numbers with different data types.

title: #10369 Bug 640428: Fix Production BOM Comment Line TableRelation filters
summary: Table relations in the Production BOM Comment Line table are corrected to properly filter by version. The Version Code field now shows all versions of a production BOM, and the BOM Line No. field correctly filters by both production BOM number and version code.

title: #10370 [Master]-Bug 647018: Withholding tax for Employees and GL Accounts
summary: When a G/L account is used as the balance account on a General Journal line, the line now inherits the WHT product posting group from that G/L account. This lets withholding tax for employees be used outside expense management.

title: #10376 [Main] Fix unbalanced G/L when a Credit Memo is applied to a rejected/redraw…
summary: Fixed an issue where applying a sales credit memo to a rejected or redrawn bill in the Spanish (Cartera) version caused the Rejected Bills Account to become unbalanced due to duplicate posting.

title: #10377 [Main][ALL-E] Sales Price from customer card and Purcase Price from vendor card is showing "All Customers/All Vendors" as header instead of the specific customer/vendor informationInitial  commit
summary: The Price List Lines page now displays the correct customer or vendor name in its caption when opened from a customer or vendor card, instead of showing 'All Customers' or 'All Vendors'.

title: #10381 [Main] Inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT calculations on Purchase & Sales Invoices containing lines with Full VAT calculation type
summary: Fixes inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT calculations on purchase and sales invoices that contain lines with the Full VAT calculation type. Small additions are made to the Purchase Line and VAT Amount Line tables across the W1 and localized base apps, with new tests.

title: #10382 [Expense Agent] Fix administrative recall history access
summary: Expense Report recall authorization is now restricted to the submitter or users with Unlimited Expense Approval, and non-submitter recalls are recorded as administrative activity outside the approval history.

title: #10386 [Agent Archiving] Prevent archived custom agents from being modified
summary: Archived custom agents can now be viewed for auditing but are protected from modification across all authoring surfaces, blocking direct changes and closing persistence gaps in the agent card and instruction history.

title: #10404 Deliverable 638799: Requisitions in Base App - add layout to report + minor fixes
summary: A Word layout was added to the Spend Request Document report, and several fixes were applied to the Spend Request feature based on manual testing feedback.

title: #10407 Shopify connector: persist order Tax Area Code, Tax Liable, and Tax Exempt (stack 1/3)
summary: Shopify connector now captures and persists tax area code, tax liable, and tax exempt fields from Shopify orders, propagates them to sales documents during order and refund creation, and adds integration events for downstream extensions.

summary: Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent adds a headless matching engine that uses AI to match Shopify tax lines to Business Central tax jurisdictions, creates tax areas, and includes comprehensive unit tests.

title: #10409 Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent: human-in-the-loop review + tests (stack 3/3)
summary: The Shopify Copilot Tax Matching Agent adds a human-in-the-loop review experience with pages and notification components, including comprehensive tests for the review flow and architecture documentation.

title: #10411 [SOA] Allow changing or clearing manually selected contacts
summary: Users can now select, change, or clear manually chosen contacts in the Sales Order Agent through a dedicated lookup interface and assist-edit, with changes isolated to one-time overrides that don't modify underlying contact fields.

title: #10412 Fixes in Excel reports for Aged Accounts.

summary: The Shopify connector now paces GraphQL requests issued through the raw-text overload to prevent excessive throttling, by using an estimated cost value instead of zero.

title: #10418 [SOA] Ignore extended-text lines when editing sales quotes
summary: Sales Order Agent now filters out extended-text lines from the sales quote view to prevent the agent from getting stuck when attempting to add items after automatic extended text is inserted.

title: #10422 [Extensibility Request] issue 30423: expose previous service header
summary: Service Header event subscribers now receive the previous record state through the OnValidateShipToCodeOnBeforeDeleteLines event to track custom field changes during line deletion.

title: #10423 Bug 620761: Move subconracting tests from base app to subcontracting app
summary: Subcontracting-specific SCM and manufacturing tests moved from the base app to the subcontracting app for better maintainability, and production-order requisition line descriptions are restored after vendor validation using routing line data or work center names.

title: #10424 [Extensibility Request] issue 30421: allow custom travel cost lookup
summary: A handled event is added to the travel cost lookup process in service order management, enabling extensions to customize how travel fees are determined without breaking existing implementations.

title: #10425 [master] Remittance Advice Report (ID 10083) prints Amount Due = 0 when using Suggest Vendor Payments with Summarize Per Vendor
summary: Report 10083 now correctly displays the Amount Due field when generating remittance advice with vendor payments summarized per vendor, fixing an issue where the field appeared as zero due to a missing field calculation.

title: #10430 [Master]-ACY amount on Value Entries is recalculated from LCY when the document currency equals the Additional Reporting Currency, causing a mismatch with G/L Entries]
summary: Fixed a calculation error in item journal posting when the document currency matches the additional reporting currency, ensuring ACY amounts on value entries are consistent with G/L entries.

title: #10431 [Agent Archiving] Fix broken reference links to archived agents and their tasks
summary: Reference links to archived agents and their tasks now open the Agent Card and Agent Task Log Entries respectively instead of failing or showing unrelated agents, while non-archived agents follow the same navigation paths as before.

title: #10432 [MCP] Change System Tool factbox caption to 'Active System Tools'
summary: The caption of the MCP System Tool List factbox page has been updated from 'System Tools' to 'Active System Tools' to better reflect that only tools from active server features are displayed.

title: #10437 [FR E-Reporting] Add payment and invoice lifecycle messages
summary: E-Document message lifecycle infrastructure and French electronic invoicing support added to enable payment and invoice lifecycle communication with message queuing, response handling, VAT allocation, and buyer acceptance or refusal workflows.

title: #10438 [Master] - Bug 647272: [Expense Agent] Unwanted caption in expense report FactBox
summary: The Expense Report FactBox and Posted Expense Report FactBox pages now use the captions 'Expense Report' and 'Posted Expense Report', replacing an unwanted caption.

title: #10446 [Bug][Subscription Billing] "Subscription Lines - Overdue" cue counts lines of contracts that already ended
summary: Fixed the Overdue Subscription Lines cue and page to exclude subscription lines that have been billed past their term end date, eliminating false positives in the overdue count and improving accuracy by checking billing progress rather than relying on a stale flag.

title: #10447 [Bug][Subscription Billing] Price Update Template filters on Subscription Lines are overwritten by the proposal's own default filters
summary: Price Update Template filters on Subscription Lines are now correctly preserved instead of being overwritten by default filters. Two defects in the filter application logic were fixed: mandatory filters now use a separate filter group to intersect with template filters, and the Subscription Line record parameter is passed by reference to carry filters correctly.

title: #10449 Remove permission set ref and move the Page Inspector changes to BCApps
summary: Removes references to the soon-to-be-obsoleted table "Extension Execution Info" from three permission sets: D365 Basic - Read, Page Inspection and VSC Intgr. - Admin. title: #10451 [Bug 647233] Fix User Confirmed copied into Canceled when posting expense report lines
summary: Fixed a data corruption bug where the User Confirmed field from expense report lines was being incorrectly copied into the Canceled field of posted expense report lines during posting, by introducing a new non-colliding field and adding data migration logic.

title: #10458 SOA Setup page tooltips improvement
summary: The SOA Setup page received improved tooltips to provide better guidance to users configuring the Sales Order Agent feature.

title: #10459 Bug 647298: Incorrect currency conversion rates for new currencies
summary: Currency exchange rates in the Contoso demo dataset were corrected from reciprocal values and updated to current rates to ensure accurate currency conversions.

title: #10461 [SOA] Uptake Agent Task Message Failed status for outbound replies
summary: Sales Order Agent now marks outbound replies as Failed when they exhaust their retry budget, leveraging a new terminal Failed status from the Agent Runtime instead of application-side state. This prevents failed messages from being re-processed on subsequent agent runs.

title: #10462 [Shopify] Fix order edit retaining discount allocation for removed quantity
summary: The Shopify connector now correctly adjusts line-level discount amounts when refunds reduce order line quantities, preventing over-discounting of the remaining quantity in sales documents.

title: #10466 Resolve purchase lines to items on exact description match
summary: Inbound purchase invoice lines now resolve to items when the description exactly matches one existing item, instead of falling through to G/L account matching.

title: #10467 [Shopify] Fix more-expensive exchange refund: no balancing G/L line, no false processed-order warning
summary: Fixed Shopify exchange refund handling when the replacement item is more expensive than the returned item, eliminating the false processed-order warning and removing the spurious balancing G/L line that forced the credit memo total to zero.

title: #10483 [Subcontracting] Bug 647210 & 647791: Enable IT migration in production and keep Legacy Subcontracting on when app install is declined
summary: The Legacy Subcontracting to Subcontracting app migration now works in production environments, and declining the app installation prompt no longer incorrectly disables the legacy feature.

title: #10486 [Quality Management] Use Bin code selection for transfer disposition in workflow response
summary: The Quality Management transfer disposition now uses the bin code selected in the workflow response when creating a transfer order. The workflow response options page extension and tests were updated to match.

title: #10487 Add integration event before inserting the cost allocation journal line
summary: Cost Allocation report now exposes an integration event that allows extensions to modify cost journal lines before they are inserted into the temporary journal.

title: #10488 Add integration event before inserting the outgoing IC sales line buffer
summary: An integration event now fires before each outgoing intercompany sales line buffer is inserted, allowing extensions to enrich line data before it enters the API payload.

title: #10489 MSlenejennum/647452/new header and footer layouts and report themes
summary: New composite report parts management codeunit seeds 11 header/footer designs and 3 themes into the shared Tenant Report Defaults pool on install and upgrade, overwriting tenant edits to shipped content.

title: #10492 [SOA] Restrict direct deletion of contact overrides
summary: The SOA Task Contact Override table restricts direct deletion by removing the inherent delete permission, while preserving legitimate deletions through validated code paths.

title: #10495 MSlenejennum/647454/sales internal new body layouts and obsolete current
summary: Three sales reports receive new internal Word body layouts while their existing Word layouts are marked obsolete, with no change to default behavior since Excel remains the default rendering format.

title: #10498 [Pmt. Recon. Journal] Optimize opening of the Payment Application screen
summary: Payment application screen opening is optimized by adding a date filter setting to reduce candidate records, avoiding duplicate database reads, and preventing excessive SetAutoCalcfields calls. title: #10504 [Reminders] Complete the communication texts model uptake
summary: Reminder attachment and email communication model is now the permanent behavior across runtime code, UI, tests, and demo data, removing feature-gated branches and legacy model assumptions.

title: #10509 [IRS Forms] Performance optimization
summary: IRS 1099 form box calculation now queries detailed vendor ledger entries with a current key matching its equality filters and can filter payments by vendor. Profiling had shown one query taking most of a roughly 10-minute run; calculation results are unchanged.

title: #10511 [NL][Telebank] Payment History export crashes when combining entries
summary: Payment history export in Dutch telebank functionality no longer crashes when combining entries that exceed the 140-character limit for SEPA CT remittance text.

title: #10513 [Extensibility Request] issue 30270: expose JobPostLine before calculating totals
summary: Sales invoice posting exposes a new event that provides access to the Job Post-Line instance before calculating totals, enabling extensions to interact with job data during the posting process.

title: #10514 Ruleset hardening: promote AS0022, AA0087, AW0003, AA0203, AL0717 to Error
summary: Five analyzer rules (AS0022, AA0087, AW0003, AA0203, AL0717) are promoted from Warning to Error by removing their overrides from the shared ruleset, with targeted pragmas added to suppress specific violations.

title: #10515 [Payables Agent] Fix stale Payables Agent setup save
summary: The Payables Agent Setup now persists instruction updates in a single final modification to prevent stale-record errors when applying agent instructions during setup.

title: #10516 Ruleset hardening: promote AL0468, AL0520, AL0589, AL0611, AL0749, AW0004 to Error
summary: Six AL compiler rules are promoted from Warning to Error severity in the base ruleset, with all existing accepted violations marked by pragmas at their source locations to enforce the rules going forward.

title: #10518 [Extensibility Request] issue 30338: expose internal put-away line event
summary: Report 7305 exposes a new event that allows extensions to receive and adjust the internal put-away line record after the dataitem filters are prepared.

title: #10519 SOA - Try it out : agent activation after closing the page
summary: The Sales Order Agent now activates only after a task is submitted rather than when the Create Task page closes, preventing unintended activation when the form is cancelled.

title: #10522 [main] Bug 647499 Bin Replenishment with Pick by FEFO Creates Incorrect Inventory Movements
summary: Fixed bin replenishment with FEFO-based picking to correctly calculate quantities and clear processed worksheet lines in basic warehouse locations.

title: #10524 Add a purchase order matching API
summary: New public codeunits in the Base Application let other apps, starting with E-Documents, create Matched Order Line records through a validated match group. A helper suggests receipts that could cover the remaining amount to invoice on an order.

summary: E-Documents now leverages BaseApp's new PO Matching module to support one-to-many matching and receiving at invoice for two-way matches, with additional warnings for amount mismatches and expanded matching fields.

title: #10528 Track receipt on invoice per purchase order line
summary: Receipt on invoice can now be set per purchase order line, not just per purchase order. Lines inherit the value from the header, which in turn inherits from a new vendor-level setting.

summary: Payment Journal now displays a batch total showing the cumulative amount selected for payment without requiring posting first.

title: #11063 Prevent Sales Order Agent from skipping emails moved into monitored folders
summary: The Sales Order Agent no longer advances the email sync timestamp after polling, allowing emails moved to monitored folders to be retrieved if they fall within the configured start date instead of being permanently skipped.

title: #11065 Open installation status after AppSource install failure
summary: When an AppSource installation fails synchronously, users now see a prompt offering to open the Extension Installation Status page instead of the operation closing silently.

title: #11068 SOA: Clear previous search filter
summary: The item search function now clears stale filters before processing a new search, preventing previous results from affecting subsequent searches.

title: #11094 [FS] Prevent duplicate Field Service customer assets during item synchronization
summary: Field Service Integration now prevents duplicate Customer Assets by setting Products synchronized from Business Central Items to not convert to Customer Assets, keeping BC as the source of truth for Customer Asset creation.

title: #11095 [main] Bug 649204 Validation missing for Deferral Code field on Released Purchase documents.
summary: Deferral Code field on released purchase line documents now validates that the purchase header status is open, preventing modification of deferrals on non-open purchase records.

title: #11096 PEPPOL FR improvements
summary: French PEPPOL exports now correctly handle billing profiles, identifiers, regulatory comments, and delivery information to meet partner feedback and French e-invoicing requirements.

title: #11113 [Master][All-e][FTE][SaaS] Last name of the employee relative is not editable when customized using “Profile (Role)”.
summary: The Last Name field is now visible and editable on the Employee Relatives page, allowing users to view and modify employee relative information.

title: #11114 [Master][ALL-E] Document Type is Quote in Document Attachment table (1173) after posting a Sales Invoice with attachments.
summary: Document Type is now correctly set to Invoice or Credit Memo when attachments are transferred to posted sales documents, fixing an issue where the type was incorrectly defaulting to Quote.

title: #11115 [29.x ]Trial Balance (Excel) report shows incorrect figures and formatting differences compared to Trial Balance (Obsolete) report in Business Central v28.2
summary: Trial Balance Excel reports now correctly apply global dimension filters (Department) when generating data, fixing incorrect figures that were appearing when dimension filters were combined with date filters.

title: #11121 Fix generation rule source table validation
summary: Fixed source table validation for quality inspection generation rules to prevent clearing the source table through programmatic modifications while allowing legacy rules without a source table to remain editable.

title: #11125 [29.x]-[Sustainability][Value Chain] ESG layouts: request-page option to print emissions by Item Tracking for Specific Carbon Tracking Method
summary: ESG report layouts now support printing emissions by item tracking details as an alternative to the average calculation method, enabling granular emission reporting for items using specific carbon tracking.

title: #11129 [Quality Management] Refactor permission management
summary: Quality Management now uses standard permission errors instead of custom table permission checks, simplifying permission management while maintaining administrator-only access controls.

title: #11134 [Main][All-E][Repair Item] Posted Purchase Invoice Order No. is blank when invoice rounding creates a generated line
summary: Posted purchase invoice now correctly shows the Order No. from the source purchase order even when invoice rounding creates a system-generated line.

title: #11135 Fix dimensions not populated by "Get Order Lines" on Purchase Invoices
summary: The 'Get Order Lines' function on purchase invoices now copies dimension sets from order lines, fixing a bug where dimensions were reset to defaults during line validation.

title: #11137 Composite Report Parts: seed via a report extension instead of install/upgrade code
summary: The 14 shipped header/footer designs and report themes are now registered through a declarative Composite Layout report extension on Tenant Report Defaults instead of install/upgrade seeding code. The seeding codeunits, upgrade tag and SeedPart tests were removed, which also removes the elevated write path.

title: #11138 [29.x][Bug Fix] Fix recurring journal background posting for IRS 1099 invoice lines (US)
summary: IRS 1099 subscribers no longer call Modify(true) on journal lines during validation, allowing background recurring posting to succeed without re-entering OnModify and triggering posting failure checks.

title: #11141 [main] bug 649305 - Add Report Address Source functionality to Company Information
summary: Company Information in the CZ localization now includes a configurable Report Address Source setting that lets users choose whether printed sales and purchase documents show the address from Company Information or a Responsibility Center.

title: #11144 [Master]-Post Inventory Cost to G/L fails when concatenated dimension text exceeds 250 characters
summary: The Post Inventory Cost to G/L report now handles cases where concatenated dimension text exceeds 250 characters without failing.
tags: report post inventory cost to g/l

title: #11147 Bug 648962: Create transfer order shows generic error when existing transfers cover subcontracting demand
summary: The Create Transfer Order report now distinguishes between demand that is fully covered by existing transfers and truly ineligible demand, providing users with an actionable error message and navigation option to view related open transfer orders instead of a generic error.

title: #11149 [BE][Purchase Ledger Report] Wrong VAT Amounts on the report
summary: The Belgium-specific Purchase Ledger report now displays correct VAT amounts for all line items and fixes the alignment of two report cells.

title: #11150 Deliverable 638799: Requisitions in Base App: Missed dataclassification on user field
summary: A missing data classification attribute was restored on a user field in the Spend Request table.

title: #11152 [29.x]Mark as Accepted in posted documents for Spanish SII
summary: A new Mark As Accepted action was added to posted sales, purchase, and service invoice and credit memo pages in Spanish SII. Users can now correct stuck documents with Incorrect or Pending SII status directly from the posted page instead of only through the SII History page.
