summary: Backports to 29.x the Spend Request Document report layout and data classification on a user ID field. The spend request table, card, list and report objects change, along with Expense Agent subscribers and tests. The description notes that the report is still affected by a platform issue.

title: #11154 Fix AL0254 compile error in Stock Register for Job Work report
summary: Stock Register for Job Work report in GST Subcontracting (IN) now compiles by suppressing AL0254 warnings on sort fields from a table extension that lack a covering key.

title: #11155 Fix missing default item journal batch in Contoso Inventory setup
summary: Inventory's default item journal batch is now created with its template during Contoso setup, removing the dependency on Manufacturing, Service, or Jobs modules for this creation.

title: #11157 [main] Bug 647991 Assembly-to-Order Item Incorrectly Blocks Shipment of Unrelated Sales Order Line
summary: A fix prevents Assemble-to-Order sales lines from incorrectly blocking the shipment of unrelated non-ATO lines on the same order when warehouse activities are pending.

title: #11158 [Master]-"The record in table Reminder Line already exists." error appears if you Create Reminders for a Customer with all the Open Entries On Hold and no Reminder Free applied on the Reminder Terms used
summary: Fixed a duplicate record error in Reminder Communication when creating reminders for customers with all open entries on hold and no reminder free amount on the reminder terms.

title: #11160 Ruleset hardening: promote three mechanical rules to Error
summary: The BCApps base ruleset now treats AL0606, AA0161 and AA0448 as errors instead of warnings. Code across apps and layers was updated to remove deprecated with statements, narrowly scope intentional AssertError uses, and show localized captions instead of technical field and table names in messages.

title: #11161 [29.x][BE][Purchase Ledger Report] Wrong VAT Amounts on the report
summary: The Belgium-specific Purchase Ledger report now displays correct VAT amounts on document lines by updating the data source logic and fixing RDLC cell alignment.

title: #11163 [29.x]Adjustment Amount is not accurate in the Exch. Rate Adjmt. Ledger Entries page if an Unrealized Gain gest registered and a second adjustment turns into a Loss.
summary: The Exchange Rate Adjustment process now correctly calculates individual adjustment amounts in ledger entries when unrealized gains reverse into losses, instead of incorrectly using cumulative amounts.

title: #11168 Restore E-Document vendor invoice field compatibility

summary: Integration endpoint URLs stored in setup tables are now validated against their expected host and scheme before use to prevent credential redirection to malicious endpoints. title: #11184 [29.x][All-e][FTE][SaaS] Cannot Rename User Due to Financial Report Audit Log Permissions
summary: User Management now updates Financial Report Audit Log entries when a user is renamed, and the required permissions have been added to allow the renaming operation to succeed.

title: #11186 [Master]-]VAT Settlement G/L Entries Do Not Populate Source Currency Amount and Source VAT Currency Amount After Running Calculate and Post VAT Settlement
summary: The Calculate and Post VAT Settlement report now correctly populates source currency amount and source VAT currency amount fields in VAT settlement G/L entries, fixing missing values that appeared after the settlement process ran.

title: #11204 Chat v2 privacy notice behavior changed to not auto agree for Eval companies
summary: Copilot chat privacy notice now requires explicit agreement for evaluation companies instead of being automatically skipped, aligning their behavior with non-evaluation companies.

title: #11206 [CH] When posting with FCY, VAT G/L Entry stores VAT base amount in Source Currency Amount instead of VAT amount
summary: In the Swiss (CH) localization, VAT G/L entries posted in a foreign currency now store the VAT amount in Source Currency Amount instead of the VAT base amount. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line no longer recalculates source currency amounts when it initializes a system-generated G/L entry.

title: #11207 [Master]-Bug 648672: [Expense Agent][Translation] Agent name is not localized across setup wizard, avatar, and Agent Card
summary: The Expense Agent name is now localized across the setup wizard, avatar, and Agent Card by removing the locked caption restriction in the Agent Metadata Provider.

summary: Fixed an issue where changing the VAT product posting group on G/L account lines in purchase invoices with prices including VAT incorrectly recalculated the direct unit cost and line amount.

title: #11209 [29.x]-"The record in table Reminder Line already exists." error appears if you Create Reminders for a Customer with all the Open Entries On Hold and no Reminder Free applied on the Reminder Terms used.
summary: Fixed an error that occurred when creating reminders for customers with all open entries on hold and no reminder free applied on the reminder terms.

title: #11211 [Bug 649379] Composite layout stress-test fixes, part resolution source and status action captions
summary: Fixes composite report layout defects: a new layout can no longer overwrite one with the same name, default layouts must stay Approved, and empty uploads are rejected. Blank header/footer parts can be created. Show layout parts now resolves the effective layout correctly, and status actions read Set as ....

title: #11213 Fix sample invoice email when the agent setup is not saved yet
summary: The payables agent demo guide now receives the setup configuration from the setup page buffer instead of fetching it from the database, allowing sample invoice emails to be sent even before saving the setup.

title: #11214 [29.x][All-e][SaaS] Last name of the employee relative is not editable when customized using “Profile (Role)”
summary: The Last Name field for employee relatives is now visible and editable on the Employee Relatives page after being missing from the page layout.

title: #11217 [Master] - Slice 641591: EUDR Certificate Capture for Items
summary: EUDR certificate information can now be captured and tracked across items, lot information, and purchasing and sales documents, with the certificate propagated through purchase and sales transactions and displayed in the EUDR sales invoice report.

title: #11218 [master] - Subscription Contract Price Update applies the lowest sales price across all Unit of Measure codes instead of respecting Unit-Specific Price List entries in Subscription Billing.
summary: Subscription Contract Price Update now correctly respects unit-specific price list entries when calculating prices instead of applying the lowest price across all units of measure.

title: #11238 [29.X]- The Available to Take logic is incorrect or inaccurate in the Pick Worksheet as it includes Ship and Receive bin inventory
summary: The Available to Take logic in the Pick Worksheet incorrectly included inventory from Ship and Receive bins. The calculation was corrected to exclude these bin types from availability calculations.

title: #11259 Postcode Configuration Page: display the stored provider selection on open
summary: The Postcode Configuration Page now displays the currently stored provider selection when opened, preventing the configured value from being cleared when closing the page with OK.

title: #11260 Ruleset hardening: promote four legacy warning rules to Error
summary: The repository ruleset now treats AS0103, PTE0004, AS0011 and AA0136 as errors instead of warnings. Legacy tables and identifiers are scoped as exceptions, 34 production tables are added to their owning permission sets, and unreachable code is removed without deleting any public API.

title: #11262 Fix retention policy deletion-limit stop propagation

title: #11274 [Master]-[Drop shipment reversal] Undo Shipment fails with blank Bin Code at bin-mandatory location
summary: Fixed an issue where undoing shipments failed with blank Bin Code errors at bin-mandatory warehouse locations, particularly for drop shipment reversals.

title: #11280 [Subcontracting] Bug 648949: Allow subcontracting direct transfers from warehouse locations

title: #11290 [Bug 640454] Scope Expense Agent Entra permissions by company

title: #11292 Bug 648535: Reprice subcontracting lines after scheduling

title: #11294 [Master]-Source Currency Amount calculation causes discrepancies with Foreign Currency G/L Entries whit Reversal Charge VAT.

title: #11304 [Master]-Validation of the "No." field on the sales order additionally re-validates the Unit of Measure Code
summary: Validation of the item number field on sales lines now prevents duplicate production order status checks when the unit of measure code is re-validated, fixing repeated modal dialogs and write-transaction errors.

title: #11309 [29.X]-Post Inventory Cost to G/L fails when concatenated dimension text exceeds 250 characters
summary: The 'Post Inventory Cost to G/L' report now handles dimension text longer than 250 characters without failing.

title: #11314 [Project Arches] Microsoft Fabric Export Setup
summary: New Microsoft Fabric Export functionality allows Business Central to export data to Microsoft Fabric with setup pages, configuration packages, and platform management capabilities.

title: #11318 [main] Bug 649189: Update E-Document vendor invoice caption
summary: The E-Document purchase header field caption and page labels were updated to use applies-to terminology instead of vendor invoice number terminology, clarifying that the field refers to the external invoice number being referenced.

title: #11319 [MCP] Allow setting default configuration from card
summary: The MCP configuration card now provides actions to set and clear default configurations directly from the card interface, with new regression tests added.

title: #11320 [Master]-[Subcontracting] Purchase Return Order cannot be posted for subcontracting, while Corrective Credit Memo works well
summary: Purchase Return Orders for subcontracting can now be posted correctly, matching the behavior of Corrective Credit Memos.

title: #11321 Update default Pricing implementation (v.30)
summary: The default pricing implementation in codeunit 7001 Price Calculation Mgt. was updated for v30 by removing 4 lines. The PR is linked as a fix for work item AB#651521; the description does not explain the exact effect.

title: #11324 [main] Bug 649837 Export to Excel All exported rows if Show Currency is enabled in General Ledger Setup.
summary: Fixed an issue where exporting to Excel applied a selected currency to all exported rows when Show Currency was enabled in General Ledger Setup by hiding the unreleased currency feature.

title: #11333 Align travel request APIs with employee travelers and expense report lifecycle
summary: Expense Agent APIs now align travel request and expense report workflows by adding employee filtering, creating expense reports during travel request approval, and supporting owner-scoped report recreation after draft deletion.

title: #11336 [master] Report 400 (Remittance Advice) Does Not Include Applied Vendor Refund Entries Resulting in Incorrect Total Calculation
summary: Report 400 now includes applied vendor refund entries that share a payment's document number, ensuring the report lines match the total amount instead of showing a discrepancy.

title: #11339 Prevent order matching for invoice lines created by Get Receipt Lines
summary: Matched order line functionality now rejects invoice lines created through Get Receipt Lines, preventing inconsistent matching information when working with similar purchase orders.

title: #11342 [29.x][ALL-E] Document Type is Quote in Document Attachment table (1173) after posting a Sales Invoice with attachmentsIntial Commit
summary: Document attachments transferred after posting a sales invoice or credit memo now correctly retain the posted document type instead of being incorrectly set to Quote.

title: #11359 [Master] - Bug 648886: [Sustainability][Value Chain] Transfer Order uses average emissions instead of Specific carbon tracking (lot/serial)
summary: Sustainability posting now correctly tracks specific emissions for lots and serial numbers across transfer orders, preventing the use of average emissions on later sales.

title: #11366 Filter top customer and top vendor Excel reports on the posting group
summary: The Top Customer and Top Vendor Excel reports now correctly filter on posting group by joining detailed ledger entries to their parent ledger entries, since posting group fields in detailed entries are often unfilled on existing tenants.

title: #11367 [29.X][Repair Item][SaaS][Drop shipment reversal] Undo Shipment fails with blank Bin Code at bin-mandatory location
summary: Fixed an issue where undoing a shipment would fail when a bin code was blank at locations requiring bins during drop shipment reversals.

title: #11368 [29.X]-[Subcontracting] Purchase Return Order cannot be posted for subcontracting, while Corrective Credit Memo works well
summary: Fixed an issue where purchase return orders could not be posted for subcontracting operations, while corrective credit memos worked correctly.

title: #11373 [Shopify] Improve shop navigation and background sync guidance
summary: The Shopify integration adds shop-filtered payment actions to the Shop Card's Related menu and improves background synchronization guidance by directing users to Job Queue entries with clearer job descriptions.

title: #11375 Obsolete GPT-5.5 chat and add GPT-5.6 Ceres deployments
summary: GPT-5.5 chat deployment getters in AOAI Deployments are marked obsolete because those deployments retire on 11 September 2026. New GPT-5.6 Ceres latest and preview getters are added, and Sales Order Agent attachment extraction and item search now use them.

title: #11378 [29.x][InterCompany][SII] Setup and telemetry enhancements
summary: Backport to 29.x of setup and telemetry enhancements for the Cross Intercompany connector and its setup pages and for the Spanish SII Setup table, taken from #11016. Automated intercompany tests were added.

title: #11381 Slice 641293: [Expense Agent] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configuration - added check for existing country
summary: Expense Agent setup now skips creating expense locations, rule conditions and rule headers for country and currency codes that do not exist. This avoids failures in customer databases that hold less data than the demo data.

title: #11383 [SOA] Fix "The Order Promising Setup does not exist." crash when setting quote quantity
summary: The Sales Order Agent now handles missing Order Promising Setup gracefully by skipping capable-to-promise calculations and preventing misconfiguration through a setup confirmation dialog on the SOA Setup page.

summary: The E-Doc. Item Charge Mapping codeunit ID was corrected from 6532 to the properly assigned ID 6246.

summary: Fixed a bug in Subscription Billing where monthly billing with Align to End of Month created an unwanted one-day prorated line when the subscription ended. The period end date calculation now properly includes the subscription line end date.

title: #11400 [Shopify] Handle missing variant mapping in product action
summary: The Show product in Shopify action on the Item Card and Item List is now enabled only when the item has a Shopify Variant linked through an enabled shop. If the variant mapping disappears before the action runs, users get clear guidance instead of a raw database filter error.

title: #11407 [Shopify] Keep exchange shipments eligible for synchronization
summary: Exchange-refund Shopify orders now sync their shipments correctly. A bug where the refund ID was incorrectly copied to the fulfillment ID field during shipment posting has been fixed.

summary: Fixed inconsistent able-to-make calculations in BOM analysis when a component's replenishment method changes between assembly and purchase types.

title: #11419 [main] Bug 650139 The Non-Deductible VAT Amount is currently not taken into account in the VAT return Austria
summary: The Austrian VAT return report (11110) now includes non-deductible VAT amounts and full base amounts in its calculations, fixing a reporting omission for Austrian users.

title: #11420 [Master] - [Expense Management] Hide Enable Agent on Expense Agent Setup Page
summary: The Enable Agent control on the Expense Agent Setup page is now hidden since it should be managed only through the setup wizard.

title: #11425 Bug 650137: [29.x] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configuration - Backport
summary: Backport to 29.x that adds more expense locations and per-diem rules to the Expense Agent's default and demo data. Three new setup codeunits create the default expense locations, rule headers and rule conditions.

title: #11431 [Master] - [Expense Management] Move missing Employee Posting Group validation to rule violation
summary: The Expense Agent now validates Employee Posting Group through rule violations instead of hard errors, allowing users to review and resolve missing posting groups gracefully without getting stuck during submission.

title: #11434 [main] Incorrect Additional Currency Base and Additional Currency Amount calculation in VAT/GST Entries when Line Discount is applied on Sales Invoice in the Australian version.

title: #11435 Validate unauthenticated public API responses before use

summary: Adjusts Purchase Line handling for G/L Account purchase invoice lines with Prices Including VAT enabled, where changing the VAT Prod. Posting Group caused Direct Unit Cost Incl. VAT and Line Amount to be recalculated. Related tests were updated.

title: #11441 Fixes AB#640874: Clarify Expense Agent scheduling permission error
summary: The Expense Agent scheduler authorization error message is now clearer, providing specific guidance to users about missing permissions and directing them to request 'Can Configure Agent' access from an administrator.

title: #11476 [29.X]-Item Availability by BOM Level Produces Inconsistent Able-to-Make Results When G-TOP-BOM-02 Replenishment Changes from Assembly to Purchase - 2606050050002529- #11411
summary: Fixed inconsistent able-to-make results in Item Availability by BOM Level when an item's replenishment system changes from Assembly to Purchase. The Calculate BOM Tree codeunit is adjusted and a test is added.

title: #11481 [Master] - Bug 648681: [Expense Agent] Fix Expense Agent KPI report-line drill-down filter
summary: The Expense Agent KPI drill-down filter now correctly shows only expense report lines for the selected report instead of displaying unrelated lines.

title: #11483 [E-Documents Core] - Linkage & Traceability

title: #11484 [E-Documents Core] - Supported type direction configuration
summary: E-Document services now support per-document-type direction configuration (Incoming, Outgoing, or Both), allowing administrators to control which document types each service can process and preventing implicit document exchanges.

summary: The Early Access Preview feature list is cleared to an empty array, and the loader is guarded to handle cases where no preview features are found.

summary: Unix timestamp conversion in TypeHelper now delegates to System.DateTime's Unix Timestamp codeunit to avoid incorrectly shifting UTC instants by the user's timezone offset, especially during daylight saving time.

summary: Fixed an issue where posting an inventory pick for a non-ATO sales line could fail when an unrelated ATO line on the same order had outstanding warehouse activity. The fix prevents unnecessary updates to the assembly order when warehouse activity is still pending.

title: #11517 [29.x]-export/import of a report definition fails if the statuses in the originating company do not exist in the destination company

title: #11604 fix: capture Shopify fulfillment deliveredAt timestamp
summary: The Shopify connector now captures and displays the fulfillment delivery timestamp from Shopify, enabling users to see when shipments were actually delivered. A new field stores the deliveredAt value, the GraphQL query requests it, and the import logic parses it across both order fetches and shipment exports.

title: #11609 [Main]-Reduce redundant record restriction checks in item journal line
summary: Record restriction checks in item journal operations are optimized to eliminate redundant calls that were affecting performance.

title: #11611 [Shopify] Add GraphQL type to request telemetry
summary: Shopify request telemetry now includes a GraphQL Type custom dimension that captures the query type name for typed requests while preserving privacy by not exposing query contents or variables.

title: #11612 Multiple runs of email retrieval on the same emails don't persist again
summary: Email retrieval no longer creates duplicate entries when the same emails are retrieved multiple times. A new centralized FindRetrievedEmail method helps connectors check if an email was already stored, and attachments are added only when needed.

title: #11626 [Master Data Management] Fixing synchronization of contacts, media, date, datetime, source watermarking, permission issue and minor UX issues
summary: Master Data Management synchronization is fixed to handle contacts, media caching, date/datetime values, privacy consent errors, and permission issues affecting non-SUPER users.

title: #11628 Expense Agent: capture submission policy evaluation history
summary: Expense Agent now captures policy evaluation history at the report level, storing outcomes and flagged categories in the activity log during submission and resubmission with deduplication per submission round.
tags: codeunit exp. policies to eval builder

title: #11629 Fix Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export issues
summary: Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 export now correctly reports header versions, handles credit amounts as non-negative, excludes unselected dimensions from the XML, and counts transaction groups consistently across split files.
tags: query saf-t g/l entry by doc.

title: #11632 [29.X]-Source Currency Amount calculation causes discrepancies with Foreign Currency G/L Entries whit Reversal Charge VAT.
summary: Fixed how Gen. Jnl.-Post Line calculates source currency amounts, so G/L entries in a foreign currency with reverse charge VAT no longer show discrepancies.

title: #11635 Bugs/Bug 647818 Source Currency Amount FCY GL Entries Reversal Charged
summary: Fixes how the source currency amount is handled when general ledger entries in a foreign currency are reversed. The fix is a one-line change in the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit, repeated in 11 localization layers.

title: #11637 [Master]- Create Documents on Recurring Billing ignores the Partner filter and fails when a vendor billing proposal exists
summary: Create Documents in Recurring Billing now respects the Partner filter and no longer fails when a vendor billing proposal exists. The fix is a small change in the Create Billing Documents codeunit, with new tests.

title: #11639 [Master] - Slice 640938: [Expense Agent][VENDOR] Adding approval limits (November '26)
summary: The Expense Agent gains approval limits. New fields on User Setup and Expense User hold the limits, and the approval management codeunit now takes them into account when approving expense reports. Upgrade code and new interim approval tests are included.

title: #11644 [Subcontracting] Bug 648937: Transfer WIP Item is lost when production orders are created from Planning Worksheet
summary: The Transfer WIP Item setting and transfer descriptions from routing lines are now kept on Planning Routing Lines and carried through Planning Worksheet carry-out to production order routing lines. Previously they were lost when production orders were created from the Planning Worksheet.
tags: codeunit subc. planning line mgmt ext.
codeunit subc. prod. order rtng. ext.

title: #11648 [MAIN]: When receiving a payment from an SEZ (Special Economic Zone) customer under the "Without Payment of Duty" scenario, GST is being calculated incorrectly in the Bank Receipt Voucher in the Indian version.
summary: Fixed GST calculation for Special Economic Zone customers in Bank Receipt Voucher when receiving payments without duty payment in the Indian version. The tax engine now recalculates properly and generates required GST ledger entries.
tags: pageextension gst bank receipt voucher ext

title: #11649 [29.x]: When receiving a payment from an SEZ (Special Economic Zone) customer under the "Without Payment of Duty" scenario, GST is being calculated incorrectly in the Bank Receipt Voucher in the Indian version.
summary: Fixed GST calculation for SEZ customers using the Without Payment of Duty scenario in the Indian Bank Receipt Voucher by triggering tax engine recalculation and correcting the use case configuration to properly zero out IGST and generate required ledger entries.
tags: pageextension gst bank receipt voucher ext

title: #11654 Repair and re-enable Expense Agent permission and posted-history tests
summary: Expense Agent tests were repaired and re-enabled. The fixes cover permission checks, posted-history fixtures and foreign-currency fixtures, and 14 exclusions were removed from the disabled-test manifest. The Travel Requests API page was also adjusted, and HTTP API test exclusions stay in place.

title: #11657 Fix VIES integrity check: tolerate country-code prefix on echoed VAT number (uptake fix)
summary: The VIES integrity check for VAT numbers now tolerates country-code prefixes in echoed responses, normalizing both sides before comparison to prevent false rejection of valid VAT numbers during registration.

title: #11658 [Shopify] Limit webhook subscription payload fields
summary: Shopify webhook subscriptions now request only the required fields (id for orders, admin_graphql_api_id and type for bulk operations) instead of receiving full webhook resources, reducing payload size and network overhead.

title: #11664 Add OnBefore event for approval insertion checks
summary: An integration event is added to the Approvals Mgmt. codeunit that allows extensions to skip journal insertion approval checks by handling the event.

title: #11667 Fix quantity fields on Sales Return Order Archive
summary: Sales Return Order Archive pages now display return-receipt quantities instead of shipment quantities. Return quantity fields are added and bound to archive records, while shipment fields are hidden by default but remain for extensibility.
tags: page sales return order arc subform

title: #11669 Fix reserved-lot re-picking after warehouse reclassification
summary: A sales line can now re-pick its reserved lot after the original pick was registered, the unposted shipment was deleted and the stock was moved back to a pick bin by warehouse reclassification. CalcLineReservedQtyOnInvt now applies the existing shipment-bin guard to registered quantity, which avoids the Nothing to handle error.

title: #11673 #[MAIN]-Not enough inventory available at vendor location for this order
summary: India Localization subcontracting receipt now prevents duplicate component consumption that occurred when both standard manufacturing posting and the Delivery Challan process posted consumption simultaneously.

title: #11679 [29.x][Subscription Billing] 1M 'Align to End of Month' line with end date produces a 1-day prorated stub
summary: Fixed a billing period calculation issue in Subscription Billing where monthly billing with 'Align to End of Month' would create an unintended one-day prorated stub when the subscription line ended within the period.

title: #11682 [Expense Agent] Remove migration TODO and analyzer suppressions
summary: Expense Agent setup code removes stale TODOs and obsolete analyzer suppressions, replacing broad suppression rules with compliant variable naming patterns.

title: #11701 [MCP] Hide codeunit APIs from Available APIs dropdown (AB#650771)
summary: Codeunit API options are hidden from the MCP Configuration Available APIs dropdown until platform compiler support is ready, while all underlying validation and helper code remains intact for future re-enablement.

title: #11705 [Master] - Bug 650785: [Expense Agent] Deleting an itemized Expense Category shows misleading missing-subcategories confirmation
summary: Fixed a misleading confirmation message when deleting an itemized Expense Category that incorrectly references missing subcategories.

title: #11710 [29.x]-Not enough inventory available at vendor location for this order
summary: Subcontracting receipt posting no longer duplicates component consumption by suppressing automatic flushing for India Localization output lines that already have consumption posted via Delivery Challan.

title: #11712 [Master] - Bug 624708: [Expense Management] Users sync - There should be a configuration wizard to ask if the Employees should be created behind if no match is found
summary: Expense user synchronization gets new logic in the Expense User table and a small change to the Expense Users page. Per the title, it addresses asking whether employees should be created when sync finds no matching employee. Tests were added.

title: #11722 [Shopify] Rename tax matching and add configurable processing limit
summary: Customer-facing references to Shopify Tax Matching Agent now read Shopify Tax Matching, and AL object names stay unchanged. A new fail-closed, per-company rolling order limit is configured through the ShopifyTaxMatchingProcessingLimit Azure Key Vault value, and new telemetry covers configuration problems and limit exhaustion.

title: #11727 Bug 650737: Description for new currencies should be aligned with existing full descriptions
summary: Currency labels in demo data now include country names to make their descriptions more complete and consistent across the application.

title: #11730 Bug 649042: [Expense Agent] It would be nice if default data setup included number series for users, reports, etc.
summary: The Contoso Coffee demo dataset now includes a number series for spend requests, making it available for users during default data setup.

title: #11734 [VIES Integration] Per-environment daily request rate-limit
summary: A per-tenant daily rate-limit of 2000 VIES lookups prevents a single tenant from flooding the shared outbound IP used by Business Central online, which could deny-list the IP for all co-located tenants.
tags: codeunit vat lookup ext. data hndl
table vat reg. no. lookup quota

title: #11736 [29.x][VIES Integration] Per-environment daily request rate-limit
summary: A per-environment daily request rate-limit was added to VAT Registration Number lookups against the EU VIES service to prevent single tenants from flooding the shared outbound IP and causing service unavailability for co-located tenants in Business Central online.
tags: codeunit vat lookup ext. data hndl
table vat reg. no. lookup quota

title: #11741 [MCP] Add company and environment descriptions
summary: Company and environment descriptions are now stored and exposed via APIs to provide richer context for MCP and other consumers. Company descriptions are stored as BLOBs in Company Information, environment descriptions once per database in System Application, and both are made available as read-only fields in API v2.0.

title: #11745 Bug 648781: check the party identifier that the PEPPOL export will use
summary: PEPPOL validation now uses the same party identifier provider as export to ensure EndpointID is never empty, fixing cases where validation passed but export created invalid documents.

title: #11747 [master][Subscription Billing] Sales-Explode BOM fails for foreign-currency customers
summary: Fixed a 'Sales Line does not exist' error when exploding an Assembly BOM on a sales order for a foreign-currency customer. GetDate() in the Sales Subscription Line table now reuses the cached in-memory Sales Line via GetSalesLine before falling back to a database lookup.

title: #11748 [Master] - Slice 626292: [Excise Tax][VENDOR] Bonded Locations for Excise Calculations
summary: Excise tax calculation now handles bonded-location scenarios for suspended-duty transfers, with logic that determines when transfers from bonded to non-bonded locations are subject to excise tax.

title: #11770 [Master] - Bug 650783: [Expense Agent][Demo Data] Posted demo expenses remain Submitted with a dangling Expense Report No.
summary: An issue where posted demo expenses remained in Submitted status with a dangling Expense Report number was fixed in the Expenses API.

title: #11774 Use lower case file extensions for document attachment file names
summary: GetAttachmentFileName on Electronic Document Format now lower cases the file extension, so documents saved to disk or zipped through document sending profiles get .pdf, .xml or .zip instead of upper case extensions. The procedure signature and events are unchanged.

title: #11798 [main] Bug 650733 External Doc No. now mandatory on Service Invoice
summary: Fixes a bug where posting a service invoice wrongly required an External Document No. The check in Serv-Posting Journals Mgt. is adjusted in the W1, NA and ES layers, and the service invoice posting tests are extended.

title: #11813 Bug 633676: Expense Agent - Setup wizard - Cannot clear default approver once saved from assist edit
summary: The Expense Agent Setup Wizard now allows users to clear the default approver field after it has been saved, fixing a previous restriction that prevented modification.

title: #11815 Improvements to E-Documents PO matching (E2E findings)
summary: E-Documents PO matching now correctly handles draft page warnings based on receipt status, prevents match state cleanup issues when resetting drafts, and shows finalized matches in the draft view for better visibility.

title: #11822 Added missing indexes for GP historical snapshot
summary: Added missing indexes to three GP historical snapshot staging tables to improve query performance during data migration.

title: #11823 [Main]-Create Movement from Movement Worksheet doesn't respect Quantity nor Qty. to Handle if we Get Bin Content
summary: Fixed the Create Movement function to properly respect the Quantity and Quantity to Handle fields when retrieving bin content during movement worksheet operations.

title: #11824 [29.x][Subscription Billing] Sales-Explode BOM fails for foreign-currency customers
summary: Sales Subscription Line creation now correctly handles cached Sales Line data during BOM explosion for foreign-currency customers, preventing 'does not exist' errors.

title: #11832 [Master] - Bug 651133: [Expense Agent][BugBash] Mileage setup
summary: Fixes a bug-bash issue with mileage setup in the Expense Agent Setup Wizard page. The change is a small 4-line addition; the PR gives no further detail.

title: #11846 Fix View file on outgoing E-Documents to open the exported file
summary: Opening the View file action on outgoing E-Documents now retrieves and downloads the exported file from the document log instead of failing, with appropriate user messages for XML files that cannot be previewed and cases where no exported file exists.

title: #11847 Use matching key for workflow event step instance lookup
summary: A workflow step instance lookup key is redefined to match the actual filter and sort order, improving query performance from table scans to index seeks on large datasets.

title: #11848 [main] Report 11564, Foreign Currency Layout: foreign currency opening balance is not included
summary: Report 11564 now correctly includes foreign currency opening balances for G/L accounts with multiple registered source currencies, fixing previously understated running FCY balances.
tags: report sr g/l acc sheet foreign curr

title: #11852 [main] Allocation Accounts with Invoice Discount produces wrong posted entries in Sales and Purchases documents in the Spanish version.
summary: Fixed incorrect posted entries when allocation accounts are used with invoice discounts in Spanish Sales and Purchase documents. The allocation logic now correctly uses the pre-discount line amount instead of the already-discounted amount.

title: #11854 [Shopify] Make refund currency codes read-only
summary: Currency Code and Presentment Currency Code fields on the Shopify Refund Header table are now read-only to prevent accidental modification of imported Shopify data.

title: #11866 [Shopify] Disable Sync Shipments To Shopify when no Shopify orders exist
summary: The Sync Shipments To Shopify action on the Shopify Orders page is now disabled when no applicable Shopify orders exist. The check honors the Shop Code filter from the Shop Card and ignores other page filters, so a visually empty page does not wrongly disable the action.

title: #11870 Reduce allocations in the "Export to Execl" scenario
summary: The Export to Excel scenario now allocates less memory by reusing objects instead of creating new ones for each cell, reducing garbage collection pressure in production.

title: #11889 [Master] - Bug 651129: Expense Agent - Distance UOM in Configuration
summary: Expense Agent setup now includes distance unit of measure configuration, enabling users to specify the unit of measure for mileage expense calculations.

title: #11890 Adding an in-product email storage cleanup
summary: The Payables Agent app adds an email storage cleanup page, reachable only via a URL parameter, that helps admins find duplicate email records and clean up email storage. A scheduler proactively sends admins steps for remediation.

title: #11895 Make Reject Order reachable on inbound sales order drafts and confirm…
summary: The Reject Order action for inbound sales orders is now accessible directly from the Sales Document Draft page where sellers review incoming documents. The action also requires confirmation and displays a confirmation message to prevent accidental rejection.

title: #11896 [Master Data Management] Cross-env over-cap blob clears the subsidiary blob
summary: In cross-environment Master Data Management sync, a source blob over 512 KB is no longer sent inline, and now a skip marker keeps the existing destination blob instead of clearing it. The inline media cache now uses last-write-wins per record and field, so the newest media state is applied.

title: #11899 [Shopify] Tax matching fixes for country, Canadian HST, and zero-rate lines
summary: The Shopify Tax Matching Agent now runs only for US and Canadian orders. It scopes Canadian HST/TVH jurisdictions by province, matches zero-rate tax lines, and holds orders as Tax Match Incomplete when a tax line is left without a jurisdiction. The matching prompt rules were also made consistent.
tags: pageextension shpfy tma order tax lines

title: #11901 Fix expense policy category mode
summary: The Expense Policies page now locks the expense category field when opened for a specific category, automatically applies that category to new policies, and reads page-link filters from supported filter groups.

title: #11906 [Main]-Incident 51000001968459: Issue while creating any import purchase invoice
summary: Fixed cost-loading logic for import purchase invoices with Nil-Rated GST and Non-Availment setting to properly include Custom Duty in inventory and direct cost entries.

title: #11907 [29.x]-Incident 51000001968459: Issue while creating any import purchase invoice
summary: Fixed inventory cost-loading for import purchase invoices with Nil-Rated GST and Non-Availment by ensuring Custom Duty is included in calculations even when GST amounts are zero.

title: #11920 Add title to field monitoring feature pages
summary: Field Monitoring Setup, Monitored Field Log Entries and Monitored Fields Worksheet pages now have a title.

title: #11938 Bug 650344: [Subcontracting] Prevent cancellation of vendor-supplied component lines
summary: Subcontracting planning no longer proposes cancellation actions for vendor-supplied component purchase lines, preventing unintended line removals during regenerative planning.
tags: codeunit subc. planning line mgmt ext.

title: #11939 Bug 650391: [Subcontracting] Show subcontracting transfer quantities
summary: The Prod. Order Comp. Line List page extension now displays transfer quantity fields (Qty. on Transfer Order, Qty. transf. to Subcontractor, and Qty. in Transit) for subcontracting components.

title: #11941 Bug 651577 CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns should be informed for Payment Discount lines on Unapplied Entries in the French Audit File.
summary: The FEC audit file export now populates CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns for payment discount lines on unapplied entries by using G/L entry source type and number as a fallback when customer/vendor ledger entries are unavailable.

title: #11945 Bug 648959: [Subcontracting] Fix serial splitting for non-last subcontracting put-away lines
summary: Subcontracting inventory put-away lines with serial tracking are no longer incorrectly split into quantity-1 lines when not marked as last operation.

title: #11947 [29x]-Create Movement from Movement Worksheet doesn't respect Quantity nor Qty. to Handle if we Get Bin Content
summary: The Create Movement from Movement Worksheet process now correctly applies the specified quantity and quantity to handle values when retrieving bin content, instead of ignoring these limits during bin lookups.

title: #11950 Adding an in-product email storage cleanup (backport to releases/29.x)
summary: Backport to BC29 of an email storage cleanup tool for the Payables Agent. It is reachable only through a URL parameter, helps find duplicate inbox emails and proactively sends admins steps for remediation.

title: #11959 [Master]-Production Order Fails to Finish Due to Quantity Rounding Difference Between Component Consumption and Item Tracking Quantity - Copy
summary: Production orders now correctly handle quantity rounding differences between component consumption and item tracking quantities to prevent finish failures.

title: #11960 [BC14] Classify historical entry pages as Archive in Tell Me
summary: Five historical data pages from BC14 are now classified as Archive rather than Lists in Tell Me, moving them from the general Lists category to Reports and Analysis.

title: #11961 Cache security group resolution in Effective Permissions
summary: Effective Permissions Mgt. now caches the security-group access control filter per user, and page 9853 reuses the page's global instance, so Entra group membership is resolved once per user instead of on every row. This targets slow exports of effective permissions to Excel.

title: #11967 Block Edit in Excel for pages based on the User table
summary: Edit in Excel now blocks page-based editing for tables that are the User table to prevent authentication corruption when users are edited via Excel and published back. A new check in the Edit in Excel implementation logs telemetry and raises an error before workbook generation.

title: #11968 Bug 648782: omit the buyer PartyTaxScheme when the company has no VAT registration
summary: Purchase order PEPPOL export now omits the PartyTaxScheme block when the company has no VAT registration number, preventing invalid XML validation failures.

title: #11970 Allow Azure OpenAI privacy notice in evaluation
summary: Azure OpenAI privacy notice is now treated as approved during evaluation mode unless explicitly declined, while the Expense Agent privacy notice continues to require explicit approval.

title: #11989 [Bug 500351] Allow Effective Permissions for delegated admins and helpdesk
summary: The Effective Permissions page now works for delegated admins and helpdesk users in SaaS instead of blocking them, since the underlying platform crash that prompted the original guard has been fixed.

title: #11992 Fix IRS Forms statement filters for box codes containing parentheses
summary: IRS Forms statement filters now handle box codes with parentheses correctly by treating form-box identifiers as literal values instead of filter syntax.

title: #11993 Enable HTTP requests before Expense Agent setup
summary: The Expense Agent extension now enables HTTP client requests when the setup wizard opens, allowing service communication before full setup completion.

title: #11994 [Master]- [Planning Worksheet] Production Copy to Req. Wksh fails because destination fields are missing
summary: Copying production planning lines to a requisition worksheet through the Carry Out Action Msg. - Plan. report no longer fails because of missing destination fields. The report now fills in the needed fields, and a new test covers the scenario.
tags: report carry out action msg. - plan.

title: #11995 OfficeMgt.IsAvailable check added to fix flaky tests
summary: The Outlook Mail Engine now checks if Office Management is available before reinitializing the configured Office host, preventing test failures when the Library Office Host Provider is overwritten with unsupported client host types.

title: #11996 Restrict expense configuration maintenance to admins
summary: Restrict configuration maintenance for expense management to administrators by removing write permissions from the Expense Mgmt. Edit permission set and granting them only through Expense Mgmt. Admin.

title: #12007 [Main]-TDS Amount incorrectly calculated under Tax Information Factbox if you use Applies-to ID in the Indian version.
summary: Fixed incorrect TDS amount calculation when applying payments to purchase invoices via Applies-to ID in the Indian version. The system was deducting the gross payment amount instead of the TDS base, resulting in over-deducted TDS.

title: #12008 [29.x]-TDS Amount incorrectly calculated under Tax Information Factbox if you use Applies-to ID in the Indian version.
summary: Fixed TDS amount calculation in the Indian version when applying payments via Applies-to ID, which was incorrectly deducting the gross payment amount instead of the TDS base amount.

title: #12051 [Peppol] Fix Remittance Advice XML line count, Note order and invoice reference
summary: The Peppol remittance advice XML export now correctly reports the actual line count, orders note elements according to XSD requirements, and uses the vendor invoice number for invoice references.

title: #12053 Remove-Sustainability-CLEAN27-tags-for-Wave2-2026
summary: Removes code marked for cleanup in version 27 (CLEAN27) from the Sustainability, Power BI Reports, Subscription Billing and E-Document apps. The obsolete Sustainability Power BI embedded pages in Power BI Reports are deleted, and the code and test values that depended on them are removed.

title: #12055 [E-Documents Core] Show error for unmatched inbound Order Response
summary: Unmatched inbound PEPPOL Order Responses now produce a descriptive error and remain visible in the E-Document list instead of being silently deleted.

title: #12059 [Master]-Reverse Production Entry fails when production output is posted using a non-base Unit of Measure.
summary: Reversing a production entry no longer fails when the production output was posted using a non-base unit of measure. The fix is in the Undo Prod. Posting Mgmt. codeunit.

title: #12061 [Master] - Bug 651754: Expense Management - Captions and ToolTips update
summary: Expense Management pages now display improved captions and tooltips to provide users with clearer and more accurate field descriptions.

title: #12062 [Master]-[Quality Management] Workflow events are not localized
summary: Workflow event labels in the Quality Management app are now properly localized for international users.

title: #12064 Support SharePoint paths containing hash and percent characters
summary: SharePoint connector now supports file paths containing hash and percent characters by adding separate decoded-path APIs backed by ResourcePath endpoints, with a new REST Base Folder Path Format setting to control URL decoding behavior.

title: #12066 Bugs/remove asm inv mfg clean27 tags for wave2 2026
summary: Removes the obsolete code that was kept under CLEAN27 conditional compilation in assembly, inventory, manufacturing and planning objects of the Base Application, its localization layers, and the Subcontracting, Sustainability and CZ Advanced Localization Pack apps.
tags: codeunit item jnl-post line handler cza

title: #12068 Bug 651757: [Repair Item] [Manufacturing] Warehouse Pick is not generated for Make-to-Order subassembly after registered put-away
summary: The Completely Picked calculation for production orders now includes components supplied by other production-order lines, ensuring warehouse picks are generated for make-to-order subassemblies after put-away registration.

title: #12070 Fix inconsistent CLEAN27/CLEAN28 tags in E-Document apps
summary: E-Document apps now use consistent CLEAN27 and CLEAN28 tags so each cleanup step can be removed independently, fixing compilation failures when only CLEAN27 was applied.

title: #12074 Expense Agent: travel request expense location, per-traveler reports, activity log and submitter comment
summary: The Expense Agent travel request feature now supports expense location selection using per diem rules, creates per-traveler expense reports on approval, logs the full request lifecycle, enables rejection with automatic reopen, and allows submitter comments for resubmissions.

title: #12078 [29.x]Reduce allocations in the "Export to Execl" scenario (#11870)
summary: The Export to Excel scenario now allocates significantly less memory by reusing a CellDecorator instance, eliminating redundant ExcelBuf record calculations, and reducing method call overhead during column processing.

title: #12080 Bug 649448: [Subcontracting] [IT] Fully received WIP purchase orders block Disable Legacy Subcontracting
summary: Fully received work-in-progress purchase order lines no longer prevent disabling the Legacy Subcontracting feature.

title: #12082 Bug 650429: [Repair Item] [Subcontracting] Show Document opens the wrong transfer order from Transfer Lines (Page 5749)
summary: In the Italian version, Show Document on the Transfer Lines page (5749) no longer opens the wrong transfer order for legacy subcontracting. The page now calculates the subcontracting-order FlowField before choosing which transfer order page to open.

title: #12097 [29.X]-[Quality Management] Workflow events are not localized
summary: Workflow event labels in the Quality Management module are now properly localized instead of showing hardcoded English text.

title: #12117 [Job Queue] Clearer message and attempt number for runs interrupted by the platform
summary: When the platform interrupts a job queue run, the log entry message now says the run was interrupted by a service restart or update, shows the attempt number, and says a retry is scheduled. The existing 0000PCR telemetry signal gets a JobQueueInterruptedAttempt dimension.

title: #12118 Fix Email Inbox retention policy failing on missing indirect Read permission
summary: Email Inbox retention policy no longer fails due to missing indirect read permission and now registers the table for existing tenants through an upgrade tag.

title: #12119 Fixing an APAC-specific issue with applying a posted sales credit memo when using unrealized VAT (GST)
summary: An infinite loop when applying a posted sales credit memo with unrealized VAT (GST) in APAC regions is fixed by correcting logic in the VAT Entry table.

title: #12124 Fix default bin assignment when creating purchase orders for drop shipments
summary: Fixed default bin assignment for drop shipments when creating purchase orders from sales orders. The requisition line no longer incorrectly receives a default bin during item validation when the drop-shipment flag is set.

title: #12127 [AT] VAT Statement report doesn't print the 4.9% VAT rate columns on the U30 Form
summary: The VAT Statement report for Austria now correctly includes 4.9% VAT rate columns on the U30 PDF form, fixing a gap in the original implementation.

title: #12133 Block file scheme in Web Request Helper
summary: Web Request Helper now rejects file:// URLs before creating HTTP requests to prevent unauthorized local file access through crafted URLs.

title: #12134 [main] bug 652313 - Add Approvals Management integration to compensation, payment order and cash document processing
summary: Approvals Management integration was added to compensation, payment order, and cash document processing in Czech localizations so approval entries are properly moved to Posted Approval Entry when documents are posted, preserving the audit trail.

title: #12135 Fix Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration
summary: Corrected field mappings and filtering logic in the Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration to properly transfer legacy values into new GB fields using type-correct filters.

title: #12139 [Shopify] Disable Create Sales Documents for empty order views
summary: The Create Sales Documents action on the Shopify Orders page is now disabled when the current filtered view contains no orders, preventing users from attempting to create documents with no data.

title: #12140 [Email - SMTP Connector] Fix OAuth Base64URL token parsing
summary: OAuth2 SMTP authentication now correctly decodes Base64URL tokens by normalizing them to standard Base64 before parsing, fixing intermittent authentication failures when JWT payloads contain URL-safe characters.

title: #12141 [Master]-Incorrect project ledger costs when non-deductible VAT is posted to a foreign-currency project
summary: Fixed incorrect project ledger costs when posting non-deductible VAT to a foreign-currency project by correcting currency conversions in the non-deductible VAT implementation.

title: #12143 Bug 649440: [Subcontracting] [IT] Disable Legacy Subcontracting leaves Component Supply Method empty after conversion
summary: The Italian subcontracting legacy migration now correctly maps the vendor's procurement setting to the component supply method for both production BOM lines and existing production-order components during conversion.

title: #12145 [Main]-Item charge assignment update Error on sales order when there is no Price.  "Sorry, we just updated this page. Reopen it and try again." when running in SaaS
summary: Fixed an error on sales orders when assigning item charges by amount when some item lines have no price. The assignment record set is now refreshed after bulk updates to prevent stale data issues.

title: #12152 [MCP] Clear environment description after environment copy
summary: Environment descriptions are now cleared when an environment is copied, preventing the destination from retaining information about the source environment.

title: #12157 Mark GetAddress.io objects as obsolete
summary: GetAddress.io UK postcode app objects are marked obsolete. Its page extensions and the test app were removed, and the remaining tables, pages, codeunits and permission set extensions now carry obsolete markings. The app is already uninstalled from tenants as of 28.3.

title: #12167 Track QuickBooks migration usage consistently
summary: QuickBooks migration now consistently tracks usage by adding an uptake telemetry event and backfilling historical migrations with completed status during upgrade.

title: #12188 [Master]-Reserved quantities do not match the expected quantities after planning - regression due to correction
summary: Fixes a regression, caused by an earlier correction, where reserved quantities did not match the expected quantities after planning. The change is in the Mfg. Invt. Profile Offsetting codeunit and comes with new tests.

title: #12189 Removing the restriction of deploying Power BI reports only to evaluation companies
summary: Power BI report deployment now works with regular companies, not just evaluation companies. Workspace selection is integrated into the deployment wizard, and the workspace name is tracked and displayed in deployment history.

title: #12194 Harden web request helpers: opt-in default credentials
summary: Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. now disable default credentials by default and require callers to opt in with SetUseDefaultCredentials(true) for on-premises installations, preventing unintended transmission of Business Central service account credentials to external hosts.
tags: codeunit soap web service request mgt.

title: #12196 [Master Data Management] Disable cross-env setup action OnPrem and fix field visibility issues
summary: Master Data Management cross-environment setup action is now disabled for on-premises installations and field visibility is corrected to display cross-environment details properly on the setup page.

title: #12198 [29.x]Source Currency Inconsistency for LCY Postings and cash posting on sales documents
summary: Fixes inconsistent Source Currency values on G/L entries for LCY postings and for cash posting on sales documents. The fix changes Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in the W1 layer and several localized layers in the 29.x release.

title: #12206 Track C5 migration usage consistently
summary: C5 2012 migration now emits standard cloud migration telemetry events for feature uptake, completion, and abort tracking, plus a one-time upgrade backfill for historical usage.

title: #12207 [MCP] Prepare Data Query Tools for billing
summary: Data Query Tools for MCP are now marked billable with a pricing acknowledgement requirement before activation. When imported, users are prompted to confirm pricing; headless imports default to disabled.

title: #12213 [Financial Reports] Add row and column definition preview
summary: Financial report row and column definitions now include preview capability. Users can set a counterpart definition on each report definition and quickly preview how the row or column layout renders.

title: #12214 [Shopify] Store currency handling for auto-created orders
summary: The Shopify connector now persists the currency handling mode used during order processing to the Shopify order record, ensuring the stored value reflects the actual mode applied to the created sales document even if the shop configuration changes during synchronization.

title: #12215 [Shopify] Link grouped invoice to all originating orders
summary: Invoice document linking to Shopify orders now correctly associates a single invoice with all originating Shopify orders when multiple shipments are grouped, instead of retaining filters from earlier shipments.

title: #12242 29.x: Removing the restriction of deploying Power BI reports only to evaluation companies
summary: Power BI report deployment is no longer limited to evaluation companies; deploying to My workspace still is. The setup wizard now lets you pick a workspace, and the workspace name is recorded at deployment time and shown in the deployments list.

title: #12255 Fix overwrite import of exported system permission sets
summary: System permission set imports with overwrite option now correctly delete permissions and relations that differ from the imported file, instead of merging silently. The fix handles both system and tenant format files, with tenant format now using exact role ID matching.

title: #12256 [Payables Agent] Exclude agent accounts from eligible users
summary: Automatic user selection in Payables Agent Setup now skips users with the Agent license type. Before this, saving the setup or activating the agent could fail when an agent account had created a posted purchase invoice in the last 30 days, because the platform rejects an agent configuring another agent.

title: #12260 [Shopify] Fix shop card transaction navigation
summary: The Shopify Shop Card payment transaction navigation now opens the correct transaction list and filters by the Shop field instead of the obsolete Shop Code FlowField.

title: #12261 Stop repeated rescheduling of Dataverse synch jobs on bulk changes
summary: The Dataverse synchronization job reschedule logic now checks both the scheduled task's next run time and the job queue entry's earliest start date to avoid repeated rescheduling during bulk changes, reducing unnecessary Service Bus costs.

title: #12290 Remove CLEAN27 from Service Management
summary: Removes code that had been kept behind the CLEAN27 symbol in Service Management across W1 and many localization layers. This deletes obsolete ES and IT pages and codeunits for updating posted service invoices and shipments and strips the related code from service tables, pages, page extensions, reports and codeunits.

title: #12293 Remove CLEAN27 from Warehouse
summary: Removes code guarded by CLEAN27 from warehouse codeunits, tables and a report in the Base Application. Elements obsoleted earlier are now deleted, so extensions still using them must be updated.

title: #12304 [Master]-Page cannot open because of FlowField 'Last Run By User'
summary: Fixes a problem where a financial reports page could not open because of the FlowField 'Last Run By User'. The change touches the Financial Report and Financial Report Audit Log tables and the Financial Reports and Acc. Schedule Overview pages.

title: #12306 Warn before releasing a purchase order that was already sent electronically
summary: A warning now appears when releasing a purchase order that was already electronically sent, preventing silent re-export of the same e-document with the same identifier that would later cause conflicts.

title: #12307 Make UpgradeDefaultDimensions ParentId backfill set-based (via DataTransfer)
summary: The UpgradeDefaultDimensions procedure now uses set-based DataTransfer operations instead of row-by-row processing to backfill ParentId fields in Default Dimension records, significantly reducing upgrade runtime on large tables.

title: #12309 Fix infinite recursion in Config. Package Field XML name generation
summary: Fixed infinite recursion in XML element name generation when configuration package fields produce duplicate XML names by replacing recursion with a bounded loop that appends counters and properly shortens base names.

title: #12320 Fix 409 conflict in APIV2 Company Info E2E description test
summary: Fixed 409 conflict errors in APIV2 Company Info E2E tests by disabling test isolation to allow commits to take effect, and changed Environment Information reads to no longer write the singleton record.

title: #12325 [Expense tests] Re-enable reviewed APIs and consolidate Expense fixes
summary: Expense Agent API tests are re-enabled. Eleven Expense API and helper paths move to shared authentication, 51 Expense API exclusions are removed, and nine non-API exclusions stay. Clean test codeunit execution is turned on, and 193 temporary API exclusions are added to the existing APIV1 and APIV2 manifests.

title: #12370 Guard removed Manufacturing Setup fields with CLEANSCHEMA30 preprocessor
summary: Manufacturing Setup fields marked as removed in version 30.0 are wrapped with preprocessor guards to comply with ObsoleteTag rules and match existing conventions in the file.

title: #12428 Add Copilot feature trial interface
summary: Added a public Copilot feature trial interface to System Application, enabling applications to initiate trials, query remaining quota, and consume trial usage with corresponding implementation codeunits and tests.

title: #12463 Fix Email upgrade writing during no-transaction upgrade test
summary: Email Installer no longer re-registers email tables based on allowed-table row presence, only checking upgrade tags or forced refresh to prevent unwanted database writes during upgrade tests.

title: #5833 Add Microsoft Graph API Support to SharePoint Connector
summary: The SharePoint Connector now supports Microsoft Graph API as an alternative to REST API, enabling downloads of files larger than 150 MB through chunked transfers while maintaining backward compatibility.

title: #7546 [Payables Agent] Agent-driven line matching
summary: Adds agent-driven line matching to the Payables Agent, allowing agents to resolve purchase lines by navigating BC pages instead of using the AL PrepareDraft pipeline when the PAAgentDrivenLineMatching feature flag is enabled.
tags: codeunit e-doc. hist. line data loader

title: #7938 Bugs/632378 make quality inspection gen rule warning actionable
summary: Fixes bug 632378 by making the Quality Management inspection generation rule warning actionable. The changes touch the generation rule table, the rules page, the management codeunit, the Create Inspection report and the receiving and warehouse setup guide pages.
tags: codeunit qlty. inspec. gen. rule mgmt.
page qlty. rec. gen. rule s. guide

title: #8051 [Edit in Excel] Expose ExternalizeODataObjectName and add Page Control Field publisher
summary: The Edit in Excel codeunit now exposes a public procedure for OData object name conversion and adds an event for filtering page control fields before generating workbooks, enabling other apps to integrate with Edit in Excel without duplicating logic.

title: #8085 [MCP] Server Features in MCP configuration: API Tools, Dynamic Tool Mode, Data Query Tools (Preview)
summary: Adds a Server Features surface to MCP configuration allowing admins to enable Data Query Tools, Dynamic Tool Mode, and API Tools through interface-based, extensible handlers. Each feature controls its own activation, settings, and system tools without requiring page modifications.
tags: codeunit mcp data query tools feature

title: #8115 Subscription Billing: respect Default Dimension Priorities on Subscription Lines
summary: Subscription Billing now respects Default Dimension Priorities when creating subscription lines from contracts, ensuring Item dimensions override Customer dimensions when configured with higher priority, instead of always letting Customer values win.

title: #8183 Handle failure to manually create E-Document from posted doc with no …
summary: E-Document creation now correctly reports failure when a posted document cannot be converted to an e-document instead of incorrectly showing a success message.
tags: pageextension e-doc. issued fin. charge memo
pageextension e-doc. posted sales cr. memo

title: #8318 SharePoint Graph Module - extend functionality with additional methods
summary: The SharePoint Graph module gains update and rename operations for drive items and list items via MS Graph PATCH endpoints, plus enhanced test infrastructure for multi-step operations.

title: #8429 E-Document DE: map Payment Method to PEPPOL payment means codes, add SEPA Direct Debit export support
summary: Payment methods can now be mapped to standard PEPPOL payment means codes, enabling SEPA Direct Debit support in German E-Document formats with automatic fallback to SEPA credit transfer for compatibility.

title: #8499 Adding `IsVerifiedDomain` to the `AzureADTenant` module
summary: The Azure AD Tenant module now includes a method to check if a domain is verified in the tenant's list of verified domains, retrieved from Microsoft Graph.

title: #8553 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling]: Performance: Billing document creation does not scale to large datasets (4M+ subscription lines)
summary: Billing document creation now scales to millions of subscription lines through code optimizations, database indexes, transaction checkpoints, and progress tracking, eliminating redundant lookups and event dispatch overhead.

title: #8554 [Shopify] Fix incorrect G/L line on credit memo for refund with exchange item
summary: Shopify connector now correctly handles credit memos for refunds involving exchange items by tracking exchange line items separately and emitting offsetting credit memo lines instead of incorrect G/L refund account entries.

title: #8556 [Quality Management] Enforce rules and restrictions with indirect and implicit permissions
summary: Quality Management uses InherentPermissions so that, when no setup or triggered generation rule exists, users need no QM permissions. When a rule does trigger, users without QM permissions get a standard permission error instead of silently skipping inspection creation. A new 'QltyMgmt - I. Create' permission set grants the minimum indirect rights.

table qlty. i. result condit. conf.

title: #8587 [Shopify] Make codeunit 30272 "Shpfy Update Price Source" public
summary: Codeunit 30272 "Shpfy Update Price Source" is now public, allowing partners to reference it for custom Shopify price calculation logic through explicit bind/unbind subscriptions.

title: #8634 [MCP] Register MCP server as a Copilot capability
summary: The MCP server is now registered as a Copilot capability on the Copilot & agent capabilities page, allowing administrators to activate or deactivate it. Deactivating the capability updates the Copilot Settings status, which the platform reads to control MCP availability.

title: #8646 [PEPPOL] Add PEPPOL SE localization: Swedish organisation number for endpoints under scheme 0007
summary: A Swedish PEPPOL localization app normalizes Swedish organisation numbers in electronic addresses and legal entity identifiers to the correct 10-digit format when emitted under scheme 0007, following the PEPPOL BIS 3.0 standard.

title: #8679 [Shopify] Fix missing shop currency mapping on order transactions
summary: Shop currency code mapping on Shopify order transactions was accidentally removed in a previous commit and is now restored to ensure the Currency field displays correctly on the Order Transactions page.

title: #8698 [E-Documents Core] [Peppol] - Enabling EDI capabilities with E-Documents. PEPPOL Order Response Message Handling
summary: E-documents now track order responses and acknowledgements as lifecycle events with a message model, enabling outgoing response generation and inbound order rejection with UI visibility.

title: #8713 [Shopify] Expose Product facade procedures for Add to Shopify parity
summary: Three new public procedures are added to the Shopify Product facade to enable partners to reproduce the native Add to Shopify flow when extending the connector, including shop confirmation, attribute compatibility checking, and product URL retrieval.

title: #8742 Enhance SharePoint error handling and add tests
summary: SharePoint error handling now correctly parses OData verbose error responses to show meaningful error messages instead of empty strings. The parser falls back gracefully to OAuth token error format and raw body when needed.

title: #8745 Bug 640098: Make Table Information Cache refresh resilient to duplicate table numbers
summary: The Table Information Cache refresh now aggregates metrics when duplicate table numbers are encountered instead of failing with a duplicate-key error. This makes the Data Administrator page's refresh action resilient to orphaned or renamed SQL tables.

title: #8747 [Subcontracting] Disable "WIP Item Transfer" for Machine Center
summary: The "Transfer WIP Item" field on routing lines is now restricted to Work Center types with subcontracting enabled, with validation failing and the field disabled for Machine Center types. Comprehensive UI and validation tests were added to ensure correct behavior.

title: #8750 [Bug Fix] #638688: Suppress availability warning for Transfer WIP Item lines
summary: Transfer order lines flagged as WIP items now skip the standard item-availability warning check since WIP items are intermediate goods managed by subcontracting, not subject to regular inventory constraints.

title: #8752 [Bug Fix] #638531: Disable Open TO from PO actions on non-subcontracting lines
summary: The Open TO from PO actions on subcontracting purchase order lines are now properly disabled for non-subcontracting lines instead of appearing enabled but doing nothing.

title: #8754 [Bug Fix] #638815: Subcontracting: actionable error for blank Subc. Location Code on WIP transfers
summary: The subcontracting transfer order report now raises a clear validation error when the subcontractor has no Subc. Location Code configured for WIP transfers, instead of showing a generic unhelpful message.

title: #8757 [Subcontracting] Bug 640115: Fix Subc. Order FlowField so subcontracting orders are visible in Purchase Order List
summary: Fixed the Subc. Order FlowField to correctly identify subcontracting purchase orders so they display in the Purchase Order List view.

title: #8771 Add OnBeforeFilterRemovedSourceRecords integration event in Email Impl
summary: Adds an OnBeforeFilterRemovedSourceRecords integration event with an IsHandled guard, published via the Email codeunit and raised in Email Impl's FilterRemovedSourceRecords. Partners can override the default permission-based filtering, for example to handle users with security filters on source tables.

title: #8871 Issue#7867: Removed the access restriction for procedures in the confirmation window.
summary: The Shopify Add Item Confirm page now allows unrestricted access to its procedures, eliminating the need for app developers to create a copy of the page.

title: #8875 [master] SOA: Bugbash for releases 28.x - Select an existing contact, or create a new one - Use another contact always
summary: Fixed an error when selecting an existing contact in the Sales Order Agent by adding a commit before opening the contact selection dialog, preventing a write transaction conflict.

title: #8878 [Master]- Service Item does not populate Ship-to Country/Region Code when Ship-to Code is blank
summary: The Service Item Card now fills in the Ship-to Country/Region Code even when the Ship-to Code is blank. A test covering this case was added.

title: #8902 Bug 639568: Scope Subc. PO component location check to current prod order line
summary: Fixed a false warning when creating subcontracting purchase orders from routing lines on production orders with multiple lines sharing the same routing link code by scoping the component location check to the current line.

title: #8905 [Master] Different source reference on reservation entries created directly from Job Planning Line and via a warehouse pick.
summary: Reservation entries for project (job) planning lines now get the same source reference whether they are created directly or through a warehouse or inventory pick. The change touches project warehouse handling, pick creation and posting, and adds upgrade code with upgrade tags for existing data.

title: #8914 [Master]- Changing Sales Order Line Description on a Sales Order unexpectedly changes the invoice total amounts.Changes
summary: Fixed an issue where editing a sales order line's description would unexpectedly change invoice totals by ensuring calculations only run when the item number changes.

title: #8924 [QM] Fixed overflow runtime error
summary: An overflow runtime error in Quality Inspection Header has been fixed with corresponding test coverage added.

title: #8935 [Main]-[Escalated] [Strategic] [BC-IN]Online: Performance issue in General journal line from June 17th 2026 - 2606170030006074
summary: Removed a redundant CurrPage.SaveRecord() call from 31 India journal and voucher page extensions in the GST, TCS, TDS and Tax Base apps. The extra call caused a database write and a workflow evaluation for every line, which made line entry slow. Tax calculation is unchanged.

title: #8947 [Permissions] Add Where-Used and Permissions Overview navigation actions
summary: Navigation actions have been added to Permission Sets, Permission Set cards, Table Information, and Page Inspection pages to open the Permissions Overview page with optional filters for viewing related permissions.

title: #8951 [Master]-Time zone issue to the G/L report in Business Central
summary: The GetUserTimezoneOffset function in the Type Helper codeunit now correctly accounts for Daylight Saving Time when calculating timezone offsets, fixing timezone display issues in G/L reports.

title: #8953 [Master]-Aged account receivable EXCEL and Aged account payable EXCEL ignores "Period Count" specified by user.
summary: Aged Accounts Receivable and Payable Excel reports now correctly respect the Period Count parameter specified by users, fixing a bug where this setting was being ignored.
