report exr aged accounts rec excel

title: #8959 Deliverable 638799: Spend Requests in Base App
summary: Spend Requests allow users to create requisitions for planned expenses and link them to journal entries and purchase documents for automatic updates during posting.

title: #8967 Ability to archive agents
summary: Agents can now be archived by admins from the Agent List and Card, which disables them and hides them from views while preserving their data and tasks in the database for auditing purposes.

title: #8999 Migrate Recommended Apps & Connectivity Apps to Official Marketplace Catalog API
summary: Recommended Apps and Connectivity Apps now get app logos from the official Marketplace Catalog API instead of the undocumented AppSource endpoint, which Azure WAF now blocks. The API key comes from Azure Key Vault and must be provisioned in the environment.

title: #9005 (Bug 641089) Guard Item Ledger/Value Entry No. allocation in Item Jnl.-Post Line with CommitBehavior::Ignore
summary: Item journal posting now prevents duplicate-key errors in concurrent scenarios by wrapping split posting in a commit-behavior guard frame, with an event for callers that need commits honored.

title: #9014 [E-Document] Remove Access = Internal from E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl. codeunit
summary: The E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl. codeunit access level is changed from Internal to public, allowing partners to reuse its functions for custom E-Document implementations.
tags: table e-doc. service data exch. def.

title: #9024 [Master] - Chance of success % does not validate correctly when using the action type "Update" in Opportunity
summary: Chance of Success % on an opportunity entry now validates correctly when the Update action type is used. The fix is in the Opportunity Entry table, and tests were added.

title: #9038 [master][Bug]: Page 615 "IC Inbox Transactions".RunInboxTransactions
summary: RunInboxTransactions on page 615 "IC Inbox Transactions" now checks IsBasicOnlyEnabled instead of IsFoundationEnabled. The request page therefore opens for users whose experience is more than Basic. Tests were updated to handle the request page by clicking OK.

title: #9039 Adding all Power BI reports to Business Manager's Role Center
summary: Power BI reports are now added to the Business Manager's Role Center, along with updates to related role centers and supporting modules.

title: #9044 [Master] Contact email is no validated during creation purchase documents_New
summary: Contact email validation is restored during purchase document creation, fixing a regression where email validation was skipped.

title: #9051 [639592][ALAppExtensions #30277][Event Request] Codeunit 426 "Payment Tolerance Management" OnPmtTolGenJnlOnAfterCheckConditions
summary: Codeunit 426 Payment Tolerance Management now exposes a new by-reference variant of the OnPmtTolGenJnlOnAfterCheckConditions event in the NL layer, allowing subscribers to modify general journal lines before payment tolerance processing continues.

title: #9053 [ALAppExtensions #30245][W1][Report][1701][Deferral Summary - Sales] Add integration event OnBeforeReturnSalesDocTypeString in ReturnSalesDocTypeString Procedure
summary: An integration event was added to the ReturnSalesDocTypeString procedure in report 1701 so that extensions can override the document type text shown in the Deferral Summary - Sales report.

title: #9062 [Master]-Production Order - WIP shows incorrect consumption amount.
summary: Fixes the incorrect consumption amount shown for production orders in the Inventory Valuation - WIP report, along with its Czech counterpart, Inventory Valuation - WIP CZA.

title: #9066 [master][ALAppExtensions #30068][ES] Codeunit 7000000 CarteraManagement - Refactor the Functions InsertReceivableDocs and InsertPayableDocs
summary: The InsertReceivableDocs and InsertPayableDocs functions in the Spanish CarteraManagement codeunit (7000000) were refactored, following an ALAppExtensions request.

title: #9067 Production Definition Wizard - Implementation
summary: The Production Definition Wizard is introduced as a guided multi-step interface for configuring Bill of Materials and Routing for manufactured items, with new setup fields, temporary record handling improvements, and expanded event publishers for extensibility.

title: #9068 [master][ALAppExtensions #30085][Event Request] Codeunit 11000007 "Check BTL91" - OnBeforeCheckFreelyTransferableMaximumAmount
summary: Codeunit 11000007 "Check BTL91" in the Dutch localization now has an OnBeforeCheckFreelyTransferableMaximumAmount event. Extensions can use it to customize the check of the freely transferable maximum amount.

title: #9071 Merged from [28.x]The transaction cannot be completed because it will cause inconsistencies in the G/L Entry table"
summary: Fixes the posting error 'The transaction cannot be completed because it will cause inconsistencies in the G/L Entry table' in codeunit Gen. Jnl.-Post Line. The fix is applied across the W1 layer and several localization layers, with new tests in the ERM Source Currency test suites.

title: #9073 Data Exchange Definition export performance improvement
summary: Data Exchange Definition exports now use in-memory mapping with bulk saves and reuse FlowField calculations to significantly improve performance on large record sets, with no change to output format.

title: #9075 Bug 598820: Item Availability by Event from Prod. Order ignores demand after Due Date
summary: Production Order availability by event now shows demand and supply after the due date by clearing the date filter before calculating availability.

title: #9077 [Quality Management] Bug 620326: Reset IsChangingStatus on handled Reopen/Finish early-exit
summary: Quality Management's Reopen/Finish procedures now properly reset the IsChangingStatus flag when a subscriber handles the OnBefore events, preventing improper modifications to completed inspections.

title: #9078 Bug 624364: Intrastat DE groups detail lines by Country/Region of Origin
summary: German Intrastat export now groups detail lines by both Tariff Number and Country of Origin to prevent merging lines with the same tariff but different origins and losing origin information.

title: #9079 Bug 631472: Cost Shares Breakdown (WIP) does not filter by Item
summary: Cost Shares Breakdown report now correctly filters capacity ledger entries by the selected item when printing WIP inventory costs, ensuring only the filtered item appears in the report.

title: #9080 Bug 635072: Subcontracting order uses Prod. Order Line location, not Work Center
summary: The subcontracting order creation process now consistently uses the production order line location instead of the work center location when creating purchase orders, aligning with the worksheet calculation path.

title: #9081 Bug 637846: Item Age Composition '...before' quantity reflected only last entry
summary: Report 5808 now correctly displays item age composition quantities across all ledger entries instead of only the last one, while preserving column bindings by maintaining unchanged column names.

title: #9083 Bug 639857: Project journal ignores task-level Bill-to Customer for pricing
summary: Project journal pricing now respects task-level bill-to customer settings when multiple customers are enabled, matching the behavior of project planning lines.

title: #9084 Bug 640321: Blanket Purch. Order to Order drops extended text for later items
summary: Fixes a bug where extended text lines are dropped when converting blanket purchase orders to regular orders if parent items end up on different line numbers. The fix remaps attached line references before insertion.
tags: codeunit blanket purch. order to order

title: #9085 Bug 640958: Guided error for subcontracting direct transfer from whse-handling location
summary: The subcontracting transfer order creation report now provides a guided error when attempting direct transfer from a warehouse-handling location without an in-transit route, instead of an obscure system error.

title: #9086 Bug 641085: Document Check factbox does not update live on Purchase Invoice/Cr.Memo/Return Order
summary: The Document Check factbox on Purchase Invoice, Purchase Credit Memo, and Purchase Return Order now updates live when lines are edited, instead of requiring a manual page refresh.

title: #9087 Bug 641331: Copy Production Order Document lookup shows the current document
summary: The Copy Production Order Document report now excludes the current production order from the document lookup when searching for a source document, preventing a late error when the same order is selected.

title: #9089 Merge-ES-Excluded-from-Calculation-to-W1
summary: Merges the Spanish Excluded from Calculation functionality into W1, according to the title. Customer, vendor, ledger entry and General Ledger Setup tables change across many localization layers. ES-specific copies of My Customer and Standard Statement are removed.

title: #9092 [Master]-Take Payment Discounts setting does not work as expected in the Suggest Vendor Payments EB routine from the EB Payment Journal in the Belgian version.
summary: The Suggest Vendor Payments EB routine in the Belgian version now correctly applies the Take Payment Discounts setting when processing vendor payments through the EB Payment Journal.

title: #9094 Add shared CompanyMetadata data source for report layouts
summary: A shared CompanyMetadata data source is now available for report layouts to bind company information, eliminating the need for each report to manually code Company Information fields.

title: #9098 Align the Vend. Entry-Edit post-modify event with its Cust. Entry-Edit counterpart
summary: The vendor entry-edit codeunit now raises an improved post-modify event that mirrors its customer counterpart, passing both the original and modified entry records for better context to event subscribers.

title: #9109 [Shopify] Add Transactions navigation action to Shopify Refund page
summary: The Shopify Refund page now includes a Transactions navigation action that displays payment transactions linked to a specific refund, matching the functionality already available on the Shopify Order page.

title: #9112 [Shopify] Skip refund credit memo while transaction is pending
summary: Shopify refund processing now skips credit memo creation when the refund transaction is still pending, preventing financially invalid documents with zero totals. The refund is retried on the next sync once the transaction succeeds.

title: #9114 Re-enable Data Classification test (CU 135153 TestDataSensitivities) in CI
summary: Re-enables the Data Sensitivity classification test (CU 135153 TestDataSensitivities) in CI. A temporary allow-list exempts apps that still ship unclassified fields, so new unclassified tables in other apps now fail the test.

title: #9120 [Subcontracting] Bug 641399: Move Subcontracting Transfer Orders action out of Entries sub-group
summary: Subcontracting Transfer Orders action moved from the Entries sub-group to the Order group level on production order pages, correcting its placement since transfer orders are documents rather than ledger entries.

title: #9121 [Subcontracting] Bug 641405: Production Order actions in ILE page not clickable for transfer lines
summary: Production Order, Routing and Components actions on the Item Ledger Entries page are now enabled for subcontracting transfer-type entries. When the base Order fields do not point to a production order, the production order is read from the Subc. Prod. Order fields.

title: #9122 Bug 641488: Add "Calendar Entries Available Until" FlowField to Work/Machine Center
summary: A new FlowField called Calendar Entries Available Until has been added to Work Center and Machine Center tables to show the latest date for which calendar entries have been generated, helping users avoid stale calendar errors during scheduling.

title: #9123 Bug 641489: Show Next/Previous Operation No. on routing lines when Type = Parallel
summary: Next Operation No. and Previous Operation No. fields on routing lines now automatically show when routing type is Parallel instead of remaining hardcoded invisible, eliminating the need for manual personalization.

title: #9124 [E-Document] [Payables Agent] Users can personalize-in the Name column on the draft page
summary: The E-Document purchase draft lines subform now includes a read-only Name column showing the matched entity (Item, G/L Account, or Resource), hidden by default but available for personalization to help reviewers verify line matching.

title: #9126 [Shopify] Base price-sync bulk threshold on changed price count
summary: Product price synchronization with Shopify now triggers bulk operations based on the count of changed variants rather than total mapped products, improving efficiency when few prices change in large catalogs.

title: #9127 Add Dataverse Cloud endpoints override for sovereign clouds
summary: A new interface and enum enable partners to override Dataverse endpoints for sovereign cloud environments without forking BaseApp. The setup table stores the cloud selection and endpoints are routed through the interface at all call sites.

title: #9129 [Master]-Bug 641503 Financial Reporting - Duplicate Rows in Financial Report Excel Export After Adding GL Budget Dimension
summary: The export of account schedules to Excel no longer produces duplicate rows when a GL budget dimension has been added to the report.

title: #9130 [Subcontracting] Refactor event subscriber for planning components and add test for Vendor-supplied components
summary: Vendor-supplied components in subcontracting no longer generate separate planning demand but still appear in the planning worksheet for consumption registration. title: #9133 [Master]-Project consumption: partial invoicing of non-inventory items posts negative adjustment value entry to wrong Item Ledger Entry
summary: Fixed posting of negative adjustment value entries for partially invoiced non-inventory items in project consumption, which were incorrectly linked to the wrong item ledger entry.

title: #9138 [Shopify] Add Belgium localization for company tax id mapping (Enterprise No.)
summary: A new Belgium localization app for Shopify Connector enables mapping customer tax IDs to the Enterprise No. field, which is required for Belgian B2B company sync. The W1 Shopify app notifies users if the optional Belgian app is not installed.

title: #9139 Fix Payables Agent permission error opening E-Document
summary: The Payables Agent codeunit now has elevated permissions to read the Agent Task Message table, preventing permission errors when opening E-Documents.

title: #9140 Remap object IDs during Payment Management FR data
summary: Payment Management FR now automatically remaps legacy report and xmlport IDs to their new equivalents when the app is activated, eliminating manual reconfiguration after upgrade.

title: #9142 [638695] Add Financial Report tables to always-logged list
summary: Financial Report tables are now added to the always-logged list so all changes to these tables are automatically tracked in the Change Log regardless of Change Log Setup configuration.

title: #9145 [E-Document] Show PDF preview factbox on purchase invoice pages
summary: A PDF preview factbox is added to purchase invoice pages to display the original invoice PDF linked to an inbound E-Document, appearing only when relevant and placed above the Incoming Documents factbox.

title: #9146 [Shopify] Fix GraphQL rate limiter under-waiting after elapsed time
summary: The Shopify connector's GraphQL rate limiter was waiting incorrectly when time had elapsed between requests, causing it to re-issue requests too early into the throttle window. The fix anchors the wake time to the current moment plus remaining wait time instead of incorrectly subtracting the elapsed gap twice.

title: #9168 [QM] Fix internal put-away from Quality Inspection sourcing wrong bin
summary: Internal put-away disposition from Quality Inspection now resolves the source bin from actual Bin Content in directed put-away locations instead of relying on field naming conventions, fixing errors when items no longer exist in their original receive bins.

title: #9177 [master] - Calculate Calendar reports missing from Work/Machine Center Cards and missing filter fields on request pages
summary: The Calculate Calendar reports are now accessible from Work Center and Machine Center Cards through a new processing action, and their request pages include additional filter fields for Work Center Group Code and Work Center No.

title: #9179 Contoso demodata renaming
summary: Some variables and procedures in the Contoso Coffee demo data codeunit Create Mfg Prod. Routing were renamed.

title: #9180 Copy record links to posted Phys. Invt. Order and Recording headers
summary: Record links attached to physical inventory order and recording headers are now copied to their posted documents, matching the behavior of sales, purchase, and warehouse posting flows.

title: #9188 [Shopify] Create BC customer on order import when Shopify customer has no default address
summary: The Shopify connector now handles customer sync when no default address is set by falling back to the first available address instead of silently mapping to the default customer or erroring, ensuring orders are properly linked to newly created BC customers.

title: #9191 Bug 641232: [Subcontracting] Offer to install missing apps instead of hard error when disabling Legacy Subcontracting
summary: In the IT localization, disabling Legacy Subcontracting on Manufacturing Setup no longer stops with a hard error when the Subcontracting or IT Subcontracting Migration app is missing. It now offers to install the missing app; the user then runs the disable action again.

title: #9194 Add API Overview page (page 812)
summary: A new admin page shows all available APIs (pages and queries) from all publishers in the environment, with clickable URLs to test endpoints before external integration.

title: #9195 Fix Aged Accounts Receivable (Report 120) performance on large ledger history
summary: The Aged Accounts Receivable report (Report 120) now reads only the four columns it needs from Detailed Cust. Ledg. Entry inside its per-row loop. This lowers the per-row SQL cost on databases with long ledger history.

title: #9196 [Master] - What If Impact on Planning and Supply
summary: Adds a supply what-if analysis to analyze the negative impact of supply changes on demand, with new Supply What-If Scenario and What-If Impact tables and pages plus planning engine codeunits.
tags: codeunit calc. item plan - plan wksh.

title: #9199 [Main]-Incident 21000001049308 : [BC-IN] Purchase invoice with a deferral schedule and Non-availment GST is not functioning correctly
summary: A purchase invoice with Non-availment GST can now be posted when a default deferral template is configured on the G/L account, by handling the deferral validation for India localization in the tax engine.

title: #9200 Cloud Migration bug fixes (BC14 reimplementation, custom mapping, OnPrem dev companies)
summary: Cloud migration tooling improvements include skipping the table mapping step in BC14 setup, preventing upgrade errors when no data is replicated, making the custom mapping page closable without valid entries, and adding an action to register existing on-premise companies for cloud migration development.
tags: codeunit bc14 old g/l entry migr.
codeunit bc14 posted sales inv migr.

title: #9201 [Main]-Incident 51000001072719 : [BC-IN][28.1] Wrong TDS amount is being reflected on the TDS Entries page while posting a Purchase Invoice against a foreign (NRI) vendor.
summary: Fixed TDS amount currency conversion for foreign vendors without PAN under concessional codes by adding the missing Currency Code field mapping in the tax engine use case configuration.

title: #9204 [Master]-Vendor Order No. exceeds 20-character limit causing error in Intercompany Purchase Invoice
summary: Fixes an error in Intercompany Purchase Invoice when the Vendor Order No. is longer than 20 characters. The fix changes the Purchase Invoice page in several localization layers, and the intercompany tests are updated.

title: #9206 Added new privacy policy for BizChat depending on Microsoft Copilot 365 with EEA environments behavior changes
summary: New privacy policy for Microsoft Copilot in Chat V2 with EEA-specific behavior changes disables chat by default for European users and enables a shortcut to AI capabilities.

title: #9208 [Enforced Digital Vouchers] - Attaching EDocuments when using Digital Vouchers
summary: Digital Vouchers now automatically attach generated E-Documents to posted sales and purchase documents when configured to do so. The Digital Voucher Entry Setup table adds an E-Document check type option that streamlines compliance document management and reduces manual attachment effort.

title: #9211 [Shopify] Surface skipped records and sent JSONL for bulk price sync
summary: When a bulk price sync reverts variants that Shopify rejected, the Shopify connector now logs a Shopify Skipped Record with the Shopify error message for each one. When Logging Mode is All, it also stores the sent JSONL on the bulk operation, and a new action lets you download it.

title: #9212 Bug 629779: [Inventory] Show a single Export/Import item data action pair on Cost Adjustment and Item Card
summary: The Cost Adjustment and Item Card pages now show a single Export/Import action pair that automatically switches between standard inventory and manufacturing data formats based on whether the Manufacturing module is enabled, eliminating duplicate and confusing action options.

title: #9217 [Extensibility][SubscriptionBilling]: Make IsLineAttachedToBillingLine accessible from external apps in Sales Line and Purchase Line
summary: The IsLineAttachedToBillingLine procedure in Sales Line and Purchase Line table extensions changed from internal to public visibility, allowing external applications to access this method.

title: #9220 Backport SL Migration - Snapshot Project Transactions
summary: Support for snapshotting and migrating historical Dynamics SL project transactions is added to the SL historical data app, including new tables, viewing pages, and configuration options.

enum sl hist. migration step type

title: #9221 [Shopify] Uptake Admin GraphQL API to version 2026-07
summary: The Shopify connector now supports the Admin GraphQL API version 2026-07 and handles market-driven shipping by reading shipping option names from market delivery settings instead of the deprecated merchant delivery profile APIs.

title: #9222 [Main]- When issuing a prepayment invoice with an invoice discount applied, the prepayment amount does not take into account the total amount including tax.
summary: Fixed an issue where prepayment invoices with invoice discounts applied were not correctly including tax when the prepayment include tax setting was enabled. The reconciliation logic now uses the tax-inclusive amount as the target when calculating the prepayment difference.

title: #9224 [main] GitHub event batch 1746
summary: A batch of fixes for linked work items and ALAppExtensions issues changes Item Jnl.-Post Line, Copy Sales Document, Sales Price Calc. Mgt., Calculate Plan - Plan. Wksh. and Whse.-Source - Create Document. The description does not say what each fix does.

title: #9225 [Extensibility][SubscriptionBilling]: Make usage data billing filtering extensible in SetUsageDataBillingFilters
summary: Usage data billing filtering in Subscription Line now uses an open-ended filter instead of a bounded range, allowing custom enum values to be included, and adds an integration event to let partners adjust the filters.

title: #9253 [Shopify] Disambiguate Shopify timestamp field captions and tooltips
summary: Shopify timestamp field captions and tooltips are now clearly marked with a (Shopify) suffix and updated references to improve disambiguation from Business Central's system auditing fields.

title: #9254 [Master] Exchange Rate Adjustment filter not working
summary: Codeunit 699 "Exch. Rate Adjmt. Process" was fixed so that filters set for an exchange rate adjustment are applied. New tests cover customer and vendor scenarios.

title: #9257 Hide Provide feedback action on E-Document Purchase Draft when user-i…
summary: The Provide feedback action on the E-Document Purchase Draft page is now hidden when tenant admins disable user feedback in PPAC, preventing users from seeing a non-functional button.

title: #9260 Bug 637507: [master] [Report 743 VAT Reconciliation Report] Incorrect VAT Base and Amount when using Non-Deductible VAT
summary: The VAT Reconciliation Report now includes a configurable option to report either the total VAT amount including non-deductible VAT or only the deductible portion, addressing cases where non-deductible VAT was previously always included.

title: #9264 [master] Bin Capacity Policy "Prohibit More Than Max. Cap." fails and allows more than the maximum Capacity, when you split lines on Inventory Movement
summary: Fixed bin capacity enforcement in non-directed warehouses so that registering partial inventory movements now correctly prevents bins from exceeding maximum capacity limits.

title: #9272 Fix duplicate in-transit location in localized Contoso demo data
summary: The Contoso demo data now uses a single source for the in-transit location code across inventory and warehousing modules, eliminating duplicate location records in non-English locales.

title: #9273 Extend Contoso Mfg shop calendar range to cover next-year due dates
summary: Contoso Coffee Manufacturing demo data calendar now covers the next calendar year, preventing backward scheduling from silently clamping production order dates to the current year end.

title: #9275 [ALAppExtensions #30250] Matrix Management: reorder OnFormatRoundingFactor Signature
summary: Matrix Management (codeunit 9200) reorders an event's parameters so AmountDecimal comes first, matching related events. The description names OnAfterSetAmountDecimal; the title names OnFormatRoundingFactor. Existing subscribers must update their parameter order.

title: #9276 Add second subcontractor (Local Assembly) to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data now includes a second subcontractor (Local Assembly) alongside the renamed Bulk Assembly subcontractor, with corresponding work centers, locations, and routing updates to support dual-sourcing scenarios.

title: #9277 Add PRODUCED item template to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Manufacturing demo data now includes a PRODUCED item template with manufacturing-specific settings like replenishment system, manufacturing policy, and flushing method pre-configured for created items.

title: #9278 Add Standard Tasks with work instructions to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data now includes Standard Task master records with work instructions linked to routing operations, enabling the Standard Tasks page and Subcontractor Price table to have usable data out of the box.

title: #9280 Project Task Billing Method reverts to original value in project card without validation or error
summary: Project Task Billing Method field now persists correctly when changed from One Customer to Multiple Customers, fixing a race condition that previously caused the value to revert without error.

title: #9281 Add read isolation support to Isolated Storage Management
summary: Isolated Storage Management codeunit now provides Get method overloads that accept an IsolationLevel parameter, allowing explicit control over read isolation for both Text and SecretText values.

title: #9282 [Main]- Description field in the contact history is showing the number of the original unregistered reminder instead of the registered reminder number when using the reminder automation setup.
summary: Contact history descriptions in reminder automation now display the registered reminder number instead of the original unregistered reminder number when reminders are posted.

title: #9291 Add [NonDebuggable] to Cryptography Management encrypt/decrypt procedures
summary: The Cryptography Management system application now marks all encryption and decryption procedures with the NonDebuggable attribute to prevent AL debugger access to sensitive cleartext data.

title: #9293 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Process Usage Data Billing uses lines marked Processing Status = Error (currency mismatch)
summary: Process Usage Data Billing now excludes lines marked with Processing Status Error, preventing recalculation of erroneous data and consolidating filtering logic into a single helper method. Processing Status is now properly maintained throughout the billing workflow and users can manually close or reopen usage data imports.
tags: codeunit import and process usage data

title: #9297 [Main]- Error The Bin Content does not exist.Not able to post an Inventory Pick for Assemble to Order
summary: Fixed a bug preventing posting of inventory picks for assemble-to-order items by skipping bin content validation for ATO pick lines, which don't have bin content until assembly posting occurs.

title: #9306 [Main] Unbalanced G/L Entries if you apply a Payment and a Posted Purchase Invoice having both different Posting Groups and using the "Applies-to Document No." on the line instead of using Apply Entries in the Spanish version.Initial commit
summary: Fixed unbalanced G/L entries when applying a payment to a purchase invoice with different posting groups using inline application in the Spanish version.

title: #9307 Added missing event call so the search results page subscribes to the…
summary: The Data Search Result Records page now makes an event call it was missing, so it subscribes to the same event as the data search itself.

title: #9310 SOA: Open Item Availability from Agent panel
summary: The Sales Order Agent can now open the multi-item availability page from the agent panel with filters applied. The availability page was extended, an Item table extension was added, and the agent instructions were updated.

title: #9311 Withholding Tax for Employee
summary: Withholding tax support for employee transactions has been added, allowing users to calculate and track employee-related withholding taxes similar to existing purchase-based functionality with new employee setup tables, calculation logic, and ledger entries.
tags: tableextension wht tax posting setup ext

title: #9313 [Shopify] Fix Product Sync deleting mapped variants on stale Updated At timestamp
summary: The Shopify variant sync now correctly distinguishes between variants that have stale local timestamps (should be kept) and variants deleted on Shopify (should be removed), preventing incorrect deletion of mapped variants during asynchronous bulk operations.

title: #9315 [Projects] Add Assigned Resources to projects and project tasks
summary: Projects now support assigning resources at the project level or to specific posting-type tasks, with multiple resources per project or task managed through a new Assigned Resources table and UI actions.

title: #9316 [Shopify] Preserve manually set Sell-to Customer No. when Bill-to mapping fails
summary: Fixed a Shopify Connector bug where manually set Sell-to Customer No. was overwritten when Bill-to Customer No. failed to map, and added fallback logic to derive Bill-to from Sell-to when unmapped.

title: #9317 [Shopify] Add Companies to Shopify navigation menu
summary: The Shopify Companies list is now accessible from the Shopify navigation group in the Business Manager, Order Processor, and Sales & Relationship Manager role centers, with a new Companies action placed after Customers.
tags: pageextension shpfy sales & rel. mgr. rc

title: #9318 [Shopify] Fix Get Catalogs tooltip to explain company dependency
summary: The Get Catalogs action on the Shopify Catalogs page now displays a clearer tooltip explaining that it only retrieves B2B catalogs for companies already imported into Business Central.

title: #9320 [Shopify] Import HS code and country of origin from Shopify
summary: The Shopify connector now imports harmonized system codes and country of origin from Shopify variants when the sync setting is enabled, matching them to existing Business Central tariff numbers and countries during item creation and updates.

title: #9321 [Shopify] Add Unlisted product status
summary: The Shopify Connector's product status enum now includes the Unlisted value that Shopify added to its API, correcting the misrepresentation of unlisted products during import.

title: #9322 [FS Integration] SVCITEM-CUSTASSET mapping ignores "Convert to Customer Asset" flag — every Service Item synced to FS unconditionally
summary: Field Service Integration now respects the Dataverse Product setting Convert to Customer Asset when syncing Service Items, preventing unconditional synchronization unless the flag is enabled or records are already coupled.

title: #9327 [Shopify] Migrate Shopify Connector to Expiring Offline Access Tokens
summary: The Shopify Connector now supports Shopify's expiring offline access tokens with automatic refresh-token rotation. The connector transparently migrates legacy non-expiring tokens to expiring tokens during API calls and refreshes tokens before expiry, with a user notification when the refresh token expires.

title: #9333 [Main]-Bin content Block Movement does not prevent outbound posting for negative adjustments and sales orders
summary: The posting logic for sales orders and negative adjustments now respects bin content block movement settings to prevent unauthorized outbound warehouse movements.

title: #9339 [master][Gen. Jnl.-Post Line]` Add var NextEntryNo, var NextVATEntryNo, and var NextTransactionNo to OnAfterInitGLRegister in StartPosting
summary: The OnAfterInitGLRegister event raised from StartPosting in codeunit Gen. Jnl.-Post Line now passes NextEntryNo, NextVATEntryNo and NextTransactionNo as var parameters, so subscribers can read and change them.

title: #9340 [main][Gen. Jnl.-Post Line]` Add var NextVATEntryNo to OnAfterGLFinishPosting in Code
summary: The OnAfterGLFinishPosting event in codeunit 12 "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line" now passes NextVATEntryNo as a var parameter. Subscribers can read and change the next VAT entry number after G/L posting finishes. The change is made in every localization layer.

title: #9341 [main][Change Request] Page 8901 - Add empty "layout" to the RoleCenter
summary: An empty layout section was added to page 8901 "Finance Manager Role Center" in all 19 localization layers where the page exists.

title: #9343 [master][Event Request] Request at table 98 "General Ledger Setup",
summary: New events were added to table 98 General Ledger Setup in response to an event request, in every localization layer.

title: #9344 [master]- Posting service order without External document no. will copy the 'Service Order No.' to GL entries
summary: Posting a service order without an External Document No. no longer copies the Service Order No. into the G/L entries. The fix is in Serv-Documents Mgt. in the W1, NA, ES and IT layers.

title: #9345 [master]Codeunits 8364, 8365, 8367 Add integration event OnAfterPopulateLineBufferForReporting to filter Dimension Perspective sections before rendering
summary: Three Dimension Perspective codeunits now expose an integration event that allows filtering which sections appear before rendering in financial reports.

title: #9346 [master]-Cannot delete Project Planning Line due to incorrect reservation entries
summary: Fixes a bug where a Project Planning Line could not be deleted because incorrect reservation entries existed. The fix is in the Inventory Profile Offsetting codeunit, which is used for planning, and a test was added for the scenario.

title: #9347 Fix IssueDate in E-Documents for Germany
summary: Fixed the IssueDate field in German E-Document exports (XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats) to ensure correct date handling.

title: #9349 [master]-[ES][Cartera Bills] Applying a foreign-currency payment to a bill that leads to gain-loss entry cannot be reversed
summary: Fixed an issue where applying a foreign-currency payment to a bill that generates a gain-loss entry could not be reversed in the Spanish localization.

title: #9351 [master]Subscription Billing: O(N²) contract-renewal detection in Sales-Post subscribers slows posting (~28% of batch CPU)
summary: Contract renewal detection in the Subscription Billing Sales-Post subscribers was reworked to remove O(N²) behavior. Before the fix, this check took about 28% of batch posting CPU.

title: #9352 [FI] Obsolete unused 'Print on Invoice' VAT setting
summary: The unused 'Print on Invoice' VAT field on VAT posting groups is marked obsolete on the pending-to-removed cycle, with no behavioral impact until final removal in a future version.

title: #9354 Incident 51000001074180 : [BC-IN] GST Component code alignment issue in Pay GST Calculation details.
summary: GST Settlement calculation now processes components in the configured Return & Reco Sequence order instead of alphabetically, ensuring correct Credit Utilized and Surplus Credit display in Pay GST Calculation Details.

title: #9355 [master] [FR] [E-document] Changed place for "SIRET No." and exposed codeunit for export Factur-X
summary: The SIRET No. field was moved to a different place on the French Company Information page, and the Export Factur-X Document codeunit in the French E-Document app was exposed for use outside the app.

title: #9356 [Main]-Payment XML file generated from EB Payment Journal upon selecting "FCY Symbol" includes currency text
summary: Payment XML files exported from EB Payment Journal now correctly exclude currency text when FCY Symbol option is selected, fixing formatting issues in SEPA payment files.

title: #9357 [Shopify] Add Compare-at Price field to Shopify Variants page for personalization
summary: The Shopify Variants page now includes a Compare at Price field control for personalization, allowing users to display and review the Shopify compare-at price for variants.

title: #9360 Harden SFTP Client module (security review phase 1)
summary: The SFTP Client module hardens security by removing MD5 fingerprint support, adding a 25 MB file-size limit, disabling debugging, and applying NonDebuggable attributes to sensitive code paths. The SFTP Connector now only accepts SHA256 fingerprints.

title: #9362 [FI] Delocalize FI VAT-VIES Declaration report into FI Core
summary: The Finnish VAT-VIES Declaration report is moved from a localized FI BaseApp override into FI Core as a report extension, with shared dataset columns added to the base report and Finnish-specific rendering handled through FI Core's extension layer.

title: #9363 GP - Updates 202607
summary: The GP migration now spreads item transactions across multiple batches instead of one and supports more custom G/L account expense categories. title: #9364 Slice 622414: [SOA] [Pioneer] Enhancing Sales Order Agent with Item Variant : availability and prices
summary: The Sales Order Agent now resolves customer requests to a specific item variant and uses it for availability, pricing and quote or order creation. Variant alternatives are kept only when classified as safe, and Variant Code stays empty when no variant was requested. If no suitable variant is available, the agent tells the customer and does not create a quote.

title: #9365 [SOA] Prevent translated username token and remove dead GetAgent helpers
summary: Sales Order Agent usernames are now prevented from being translated by marking the label as locked, and unused GetAgent overloads and SetAgentDefaults helper are removed from the setup codeunit.

title: #9371 Bug 642180: DE report 11015 Export Business Data fails when scheduled via Job Queue: Client callbacks are not supported
summary: Report 11015 Export Business Data now stores generated ZIP files in the Report Inbox when scheduled via Job Queue instead of attempting a client callback that fails in background sessions.

title: #9374 [master] Contact No. Lookup on Sales Quote returns All Customers instead of related Contacts after Updating to v28.2 - regression.
summary: Fixed a regression in the Contact No. lookup on Sales Quotes that was showing all contacts instead of filtering to only the related customer's contacts.

title: #9391 [Master] - Slice 616928: [Expense Management] [App part] Expense Managements Travel Requisitions 💸

title: #9396 [Subcontracting] Fix subcontracting order opening wrong purchase order after creation

title: #9397 [main] Ship to address Var/protected var fix
summary: The Ship-to Address table had a label text accidentally moved when a variable was changed from Var to Protected Var, which has been corrected.

title: #9398 [Main]Incorrect Cost Amount (Actual) in Value Entries after posting Assembly Process and calulating the assembly standard costsInitial commit
summary: Fixes wrong Cost Amount (Actual) in value entries for assembly orders after Calc. Assembly Std. Cost. For assembly orders, the inventory adjustment now recalculates overhead from the cost shares and re-rounds it, so per-unit and per-output indirect costs match.

title: #9400 Route early preview feedback to the correct OCV area
summary: Early Access Preview feedback now routes to the correct OCV feedback area instead of appearing in the general feedback category.

title: #9401 Fix Incoming Documents default processed filter
summary: The Incoming Documents page now defaults to showing only unprocessed records when opened without a filter, while preserving explicit filter choices. This restores the expected behavior after a regression.

title: #9402 Fix RSA private key PEM import
summary: RSA private key import from PEM format now works correctly by using the proper RSA cryptographic service provider type instead of the base RSA type.

title: #9404 [Shopify] Fix Sync Prices using stale WorkDate from SingleInstance cache
summary: Fixed the Shopify product price calculator to rebuild its cached temporary sales header when the Work Date changes, preventing price sync from applying outdated discounts after changing the work date mid-session.

title: #9405 [FI] Delocalize FI Currency Exchange Rate import into FI Core
summary: Finnish currency exchange rate import functionality moved from the base application layer to the FI Core extension, with the original code retained as obsolete for backward compatibility.

title: #9407 Add Microsoft apps view to AppSource product list (Fix ADO #642217)
summary: A new predefined view called "Microsoft apps" was added to the AppSource Product List page to let customers quickly filter and browse only Microsoft-published applications.

summary: A new integration event is added to the G/L Book - Print report that allows partners to set custom filters on G/L Book Entry before validation runs.

title: #9416 [ALAppExtensions #30313]codeunit 441 "Prepayment Mgt."  OnBeforeReleaseSalesDocument
summary: Codeunit 441 now exposes two new integration events that fire before and after processing pending prepayment sales, allowing partners to hook into the prepayment-driven release flow.

title: #9417 [ALAppExtensions #30221][Event Request] table 12137 "Purch. Withh. Contribution"
summary: Two integration events added to the Purch. Withh. Contribution table enable partners to override the INPS calculation or populate custom fields during record creation without affecting the default behavior.

title: #9418 [ALAppExtensions #30229][Event Request] table 12113 "Tmp Withholding Contribution"
summary: Adds an IsHandled event OnCalculateWithholdingTaxOnBeforeAssignWithholdingTaxValues to the Tmp Withholding Contribution table and extracts field assignments into a separate procedure to allow customization of withholding tax calculation logic.

title: #9421 [Event Request] codeunit 367 "CheckManagement": add OnFinancialVoidCh…
summary: Adds an `IsHandled` event to CheckManagement codeunit that allows partners to replace the balance-account posting logic in financial void check operations.

title: #9422 table 12116 "Withholding Tax": scope Reported/Paid modify guard to st…
summary: The Withholding Tax table now allows modifications to extension fields on reported or paid entries, while still blocking changes to standard fields to preserve compliance.

title: #9426 [E-Document Formats] Migrate NAV PRs 247170 and 247176 into BCApps
summary: PINT A-NZ and Factura-E e-document formats are migrated to the structured import pipeline with new IStructuredFormatReader implementations that parse XML directly into purchase draft staging tables.

title: #9428 637301 Report layout override lifecycle
summary: Report layout overrides for extension-installed layouts now write Tenant Report Layout Override records with lifecycle properties (status, description, obsolescence) scoped per field and per company, preserving existing company-level overrides while offering copy as an escape hatch.

title: #9430 Fix untrappable JSON error in E-Document ADI import (Bug 640122)
summary: E-Document matching assistance import now handles malformed Azure Document Intelligence responses gracefully by checking JSON property existence and adding telemetry for diagnostic purposes instead of crashing with an untrappable error.

title: #9433 636017 Move Item Price List and Res. Price List report action tooltip…
summary: Report action tooltips for Item Price List and Res. Price List reports are moved from page actions to the report objects themselves, consolidating the tooltip definition to a single location.

title: #9434 [Main]-"Factura Duplicada" error message appears under SII History if you use the same Vendor Invoice No. for the same Vendor (VAT Registration No.) in different documents in the Spanish version.

Memo No. matches a posted entry of the opposite document type for the same vendor and date. SII would later reject such a document as 'Factura Duplicada'.

title: #9437 [Extensibility Request] issue 30339: add OnAfterCalcAvailableQtyBase event to Whse. Worksheet Line
summary: An integration event was added to the warehouse worksheet line calculation to allow extensions to adjust the available quantity after the standard calculation completes.

title: #9438 SL - Add support for migrating historical project transactions

title: #9439 [Extensibility Request] issue 30330: add OnCancelInvoiceOnBeforeConfirm event
summary: An integration event enables extensions to adjust the confirmation message shown when cancelling a posted sales invoice, ensuring the text matches any customized behavior for restoring quantities.

title: #9440 [Extensibility Request] issue 30331: add event to adjust corrective credit memo confirmation text
summary: An integration event has been added before the corrective credit memo confirmation dialog, allowing extensions to adjust the confirmation text when a posted sales invoice is being corrected.

title: #9441 [Extensibility Request] issue 30337: add OnCreateProdOrderLineOnBeforeCreateProdOrderLineFromItem event
summary: A new integration event OnCreateProdOrderLineOnBeforeCreateProdOrderLineFromItem allows extensions to completely replace the standard item source type processing when creating production order lines, with control over the error outcome.

title: #9443 [Extensibility Request] issue 30222: add handled event before RecreatePurchLines in Pay-to Vendor No. validation
summary: A new handled integration event OnValidatePayToVendorNoOnBeforeRecreatePurchLines was added to the Pay-to Vendor No. field validation in Purchase Header, allowing extensions to take ownership of purchase line recreation logic instead of being forced to replicate the entire validation trigger.

title: #9444 [Extensibility Request] issue 30223: add IsHandled events to Purchase Line (translation, price calc, WMS)
summary: Three new IsHandled integration events are added to the Purchase Line table, enabling extensions to intervene in item translation, location-based price calculation, and WMS location checks.

title: #9445 [Extensibility Request] issue 30173: add integration events to Sales Line Discounts page
summary: Two integration events are added to the Sales Line Discounts page to allow extensions to customize record filtering and resolve filter descriptions for item type values without modifying base code.

summary: A new integration event `OnPostItemJnlLineJobConsumptionOnBeforePrepareJobLine` is added to codeunit 90 Purch.-Post, allowing extensions to modify the quantity to invoice and optionally bypass standard job line preparation during purchase posting.

title: #9447 [Extensibility Request] issue 30239: add OnBeforeOnRunOnCheckWarehouse event in Mfg. Item Jnl. Check Line
summary: A new OnBeforeOnRunOnCheckWarehouse integration event enables extensions to conditionally bypass manufacturing warehouse validation for specific item journal transactions without affecting standard behavior.

title: #9448 [Extensibility Request] issue 30264: add and extend events in CalcBestDirectUnitCost
summary: Two new integration events and an extended existing event provide customization points in purchase price selection logic, allowing subscribers to override minimum-quantity checks, best-price selection rules, and no-price fallback handling without duplicating internal loops.

title: #9449 [Extensibility Request] issue 30334: fix OnAfterCarryOutToReqWksh record order
summary: The OnAfterCarryOutToReqWksh integration event now passes the target requisition line as a modifiable var parameter, allowing subscribers to persist changes to the newly created line.

title: #9450 [Extensibility Request] issue 30290: Add OnBeforeUpdateSetupOnBillToCustomerChangeInSalesHeader event
summary: A new integration event OnBeforeUpdateSetupOnBillToCustomerChangeInSalesHeader is added to the Sales Header table to allow extensions to override or skip the standard VAT registration update logic when the bill-to customer changes.

title: #9451 [Extensibility Request] issue 30292: add temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter to OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader
summary: The OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader event in the Create Pick codeunit now includes a temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter, allowing subscribers to inspect pick lines before a warehouse activity header is created.

title: #9452 [Extensibility Request] issue 30329: override confirmation text in CancelPostedInvoiceAndOpenSalesOrder
summary: An integration event allows extensions to override the confirmation text when canceling a posted sales invoice, enabling accurate messaging when custom logic changes the behavior applied to the originating sales order.

title: #9453 [Bug 642248] Header/Footer Theme Assignment: persist selected layout (missing Rec.Modify)
summary: A data-persistence bug on the Header/Footer Theme Assignment page is fixed by adding a missing Rec.Modify() call, ensuring selected header and theme parts are saved to the database. A minor caption casing fix is also applied to the Report Layouts page.

title: #9454 Fix site scoped contextinfo
summary: SharePoint request-digest calls now correctly target site-scoped URLs instead of tenant root for operations like CreateList, CreateListItem, CreateFolder, and UpdateListItemMetaDataField.

title: #9455 Update permissions for G/L Transaction table
summary: Access to the G/L Transaction table is added across Base Application layers: many permission sets (W1, RU, CH, NA, GB), plus the permissions of Gen. Jnl.-Post Reverse, the date compression reports, Adjust Add. Reporting Currency and User Management.

title: #9461 [Extensibility Request] issue 30335: add OnBeforeRecreateSalesLine IsHandled event
summary: A new OnBeforeRecreateSalesLine integration event with IsHandled flag was added to the Sales Header table in all country layers, enabling extensions to skip the standard sales line recreation logic and provide custom implementations.

summary: Production Order Routing Line table adds an integration event OnValidateNoOnBeforeModifyCapNeedEntries that fires after work/machine center transfer logic but before capacity needs are updated, giving extensions access to both current and previous record state.

title: #9464 [Extensibility Request] issue 30349: add OnBeforeCheckTrackingIfRequired event to Item Journal Line
summary: An integration event is added to the CheckTrackingIfRequired procedure in the Item Journal Line table, allowing extensions to perform custom item tracking validation and raise more meaningful error messages before standard checks run.

title: #9465 [Extensibility Request] issue 30350: add OnBeforeTestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking event
summary: A new integration event OnBeforeTestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking was added to codeunit 22 so extensions can validate item tracking and optionally modify the Item Tracking Code before standard validation runs.

title: #9466 [Extensibility Request] issue 30351: extend OnCheckExpirationDateOnBeforeAssignExpirationDate event
summary: The OnCheckExpirationDateOnBeforeAssignExpirationDate event gains three new parameters (GlobalItemTrackingCode, ItemJnlLine2, SignFactor) to allow subscribers to access the data needed for expiration date assignment logic.

title: #9467 [Extensibility Request] issue 30346: make InsertPostValueEntryToGL public in Item Jnl.-Post Line
summary: The InsertPostValueEntryToGL procedure in codeunit 22 Item Jnl.-Post Line is now public, allowing extensions to reuse the standard General Ledger posting logic for inventory variances.

title: #9477 [main]-Invalid SEPA export file format when SEPA Non-Euro Export enabled
summary: Fixes an invalid SEPA credit transfer export file that was produced when SEPA Non-Euro Export is enabled. The SEPA CT pain.001.001.09 xmlport was changed in several localization layers.

title: #9478 feat(Sustainability): Add Reverse Transaction for Sustainability Ledger Entries
summary: Users can now reverse posted Sustainability Ledger Entries manually from the page or automatically when their originating G/L transaction is reversed, with all emission fields negated and the reversal posted on the original entry's date.

title: #9479 [Master]-]Withholding Tax Entries are not generated at payment because the Withholding Tax. Prod. Posting Group field gets not transferred to the payment line
summary: The Withholding Tax Prod. Posting Group field is now carried over to the payment line, so Withholding Tax Entries are created again when the payment is posted.

title: #9481 [Withholding Tax] FCY documents get wrongly rounded to LCY precision …
summary: Foreign currency withholding tax documents no longer incorrectly round amounts to local currency precision, fixing a calculation issue in withholding tax management.

title: #9482 Make service-invoked System Application facades callable by any user (Privacy Notice + Page Summary Provider)
summary: Two System Application facade codeunits now declare inherent entitlements and permissions so any authenticated user can call them in low-permission sessions like web services, OData, Copilot, and agents, instead of requiring explicit Execute permission.

title: #9485 [main]-Multiple error messages when posting to period with VAT Return already in status Released
summary: Posting to a period whose VAT Return is already in status Released should no longer produce multiple error messages. The change updates the VAT Reporting Date Mgt codeunit and makes a one-line change to the VAT Entry table in each layer.

title: #9514 [Main]-Interest Document issued with non-taxable VAT does not generate non-taxable VAT entries in the Spanish localization
summary: Interest documents with non-taxable VAT now correctly generate non-taxable VAT entries in the Spanish localization. The fix updates the No Taxable Management codeunit to handle interest documents properly.

title: #9515 [Master] - 'Greater Than' Withholding Tax Calculation Rule is not applied correctly in Withholding Tax Posting Setup.
summary: The 'Greater Than' withholding tax calculation rule and other rule options are now applied correctly in withholding tax posting setup by replacing hard-coded threshold checks with a rule-aware procedure.

title: #9525 [Shopify] Automatic Transaction Posting
summary: Shopify payment transactions can now be automatically posted as general journal lines when related invoices or credit memos are posted in Business Central, with configurable journal templates and safety checks to prevent unintended posting.

title: #9528 636017 Move CashFlow report action tooltips to report objects (W1)
summary: Cash Flow report action tooltips are moved from role center page actions to the report objects themselves, with duplicate tooltips removed from page actions across all country layers.

title: #9531 [Master]- Report 152 "Calculate Low Level Code" terminates with error: "Cannot add instance as another with key %1 has already been added." after upgrade to v28.1

title: #9532 [Master]Error when creating a Pick "Nothing to handle. The quantity to be picked is in bin W-09-0002, which is not set up for picking."
summary: Fixes warehouse pick creation by checking all ship-type bins for picked-not-shipped quantities instead of only the default shipment bin, preventing false 'nothing to handle' errors.

title: #9537 [Shopify] Store tax lines linked to order shipping charges
summary: Shopify order imports now persist tax lines linked to shipping charges in the existing tax-lines table, with a new action on the Shipping Costs page exposing these details including Channel Liable status.

title: #9538 [main]- Requests to Approve: Open Record shows wrong Requisition Worksheet batch after viewing a different batch
summary: The Req. Worksheet page now correctly displays the intended requisition batch when opened from an approval record, preventing stale batch filters from interfering with the record view.

summary: Outbound replies in the Sales Order Agent now limit retry attempts to five per message, provide a manual retry action, and isolate failures to prevent blocking other messages.

summary: Fixes a field that was missing when dimension values are copied or mapped to IC dimension values through the IC Dim Values Selector page.

title: #9550 [Main]-[BC-IN] Purchase invoice with a deferral schedule and Non-availment GST is not functioning correctly
summary: Purchase invoices with non-availment GST and deferral templates now post correctly in the India localization by handling deferral validation in the tax engine.

title: #9552 [Main]-Issue in TDS calculation during payment application against invoices
summary: Fixed TDS calculation during payment application against invoices by scaling the applied amount to match the payment's TDS base, ensuring correct tax base computation when GST and payment amounts differ.

title: #9564 [main] bug 640380 - Add Word layout and email body support for Purchase Quote and Sales Shipment
summary: Word layouts and email body support have been added for Purchase Quote and Sales Shipment reports in the Czech localization, enabling these documents to be sent via email.

title: #9568 [main] bug 640523 - Bonus depreciation functionality in CZ

title: #9570 [Master]-Rounding Differences in ARAP with Deferrals and Non-Deductible VAT
summary: Gen. Jnl.-Post Line (codeunit 12) is changed in 11 localization layers to fix rounding differences in receivables and payables when deferrals and non-deductible VAT are combined. Tests for non-deductible VAT were added in W1 and IT.

summary: Opening a price list from the Customer Card is made faster on large datasets, where it took around 220 seconds because of the AddAllSourceType call. The logic in Price List Management is reworked and UI tests are added.

title: #9575 [Payables Agent] set Document Date and Due Date on Incomming Document when Draft is created

title: #9578 [E-Documents Core] - Enabling remittance advice export via E-Documents (payment journal + posted payments)
summary: E-Documents now supports exporting remittance advice from payment journals and posted vendor payments as PEPPOL BIS 3.0 UBL 2.1 XML documents. The existing UK remittance advice email functionality moves into the base application, while legacy page extensions are marked obsolete.

title: #9580 636017 Move Manufacturing report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Manufacturing report action tooltips are moved from page actions to report objects themselves, allowing tooltips to be defined once and inherited across all pages that invoke the reports.

title: #9581 [Shopify] Add Unlisted to Status for Created Products and update status tooltip

summary: Sales report action tooltips are moved from page actions to the report objects themselves, eliminating duplicates across role centers and pages where these reports are invoked.

summary: Report action tooltips are moved from page actions to report objects themselves, with duplicate tooltips removed from pages. This uses the new 2025 wave 1 feature where actions inherit UI descriptors from target objects.

summary: IRS 1099 reporting fields on vendor ledger entries are now consistently left empty for vendors without a 1099 Form Box No., whether posted through a General Journal or Purchase Invoice.

title: #9612 Fixing correct value for Legacy Subcontracting flag in Italy during u…
summary: Italian customers upgrading to version 28.3 regain access to legacy subcontracting pages by fixing the initialization of the Legacy Subcontracting flag in Manufacturing Setup.

title: #9613 [Master] - Sustainability: Specific Carbon Tracking, Item Charge emissions & setup fixes (Bugs 641051, 641486, 641487, 641049, 641222, 641055, 641289, 641224, 641309)
summary: Sustainability module fixes for carbon tracking with item charges, value chain posting, and setup validations. Corrects proportional CO2e distribution across split item ledger entries, adds missing value entries for undo operations, and improves field visibility and defaults.

title: #9631  [Main]- "Filter by Attribute" action does not apply the filter under specific circumstances
summary: The 'Filter by Attribute' action on the Item List page now preserves user-applied filters instead of replacing them, fixing cases where filters were incorrectly lost during attribute filtering.

title: #9635 Obsolete MLLM Payables Agent rollout scaffold
summary: MLLM processing is now the permanent behavior for the Payables Agent feature. The rollout scaffold including the MLLM toggle, setup page, and related integration events are obsoleted, and the feature configuration experiment gate is removed.

title: #9637 [Event Requests] Add integration events across base app and SMTP module
summary: Ten partner event requests were implemented in one batch, adding new integration events or extra parameters on existing ones in the base application and the SMTP email modules. Default behavior is unchanged.

title: #9638 Fixed Filtering the Sales Order List using the 'Delayed' view the list shows sales orders that are out of scope
summary: The Sales Order List page now correctly filters sales orders when using the 'Delayed' view, removing orders that fall outside the intended scope.

summary: When the EU 3-Party Intermediary field is deactivated in sales or purchase document headers, the EU 3-Party Trade field is now also deactivated instead of remaining active.

title: #9646 [Bug]: [DE] XRechnung/ZUGFeRD — no posting-time error when SELLER CONTACT (BG-6) source data is incomplete, producing non-compliant e-invoices
summary: E-Document posting now validates that seller contact information (from salesperson or company data) is complete before generating XRechnung/ZUGFeRD e-invoices, preventing non-compliant XML that would fail validation.

title: #9648 [master]-[BE] [PEPPOL] There is a problem between the totals on the invoice printout and the XML PEPPOL with Payment discount
summary: Fixed discrepancy between invoice printout and PEPPOL XML totals in Belgium when payment discounts are applied by correcting how taxable amounts are calculated.

title: #9650 [Master] -Revert Changes- 'Greater Than' Withholding Tax Calculation Rule is not applied correctly in Withholding Tax Posting Setup.
summary: Reverts the earlier change from PR 9515 to how the 'Greater Than' withholding tax calculation rule is applied. The journal subscriber, withholding tax management and purchase subscriber codeunits return to their previous logic, and the tests added by that PR are removed.

title: #9651 [Extensibility Request] issue 30352: add SkipNewExpirationDateCheck to OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot
summary: A new parameter SkipNewExpirationDateCheck was added to the OnCheckExpirationDateOnAfterCalcSumLot event, allowing subscribers to bypass the mandatory New Expiration Date validation during item journal posting without affecting other logic.

title: #9652 [Extensibility Request] issue 30358: add OnBeforeOnPreReport event to Redraw Receivable Bills report
summary: Adds an OnBeforeOnPreReport integration event to the ES Redraw Receivable Bills report (7000096). Extensions can set the request page variables and, through IsHandled, skip the NewDueDate and journal batch validations so the report can run unattended, for example from a job queue.

title: #9653 [Master][ALL-E] No Reservation created when the item is selected by Description in Sales Lines
summary: For Reserve = Always items, choosing the item through the Description lookup on a sales order line now creates the automatic reservation. Before, only manual description entry did, because xRec resynced after SaveRecord and the No. change guard became false.

title: #9656 [main] - Incorrect Prepayment Invoice Amount for Sales Orders with Invoice Discount, Prices Including VAT and negative non-inventory line.
summary: Fixes incorrect prepayment invoice amounts for sales orders with invoice discounts, prices including VAT, and negative non-inventory lines by computing expected prepayment amounts line-by-line instead of from the order header.

title: #9657 [Extensibility Request] issue 30359: add Direction parameter to OnBeforeScheduleRoutingLine

summary: Extends BC14 cloud migration to stage customer, vendor, and item subledger transactions alongside G/L entries, enabling migration of open receivables, payables, and inventory for both current and historical data.

title: #9670 [Main] - Posting from Released production order affects Firm planned production order with same ID.

summary: Fixed a bug where the FA General Report procedures could clear the FA Posting Group or Tax Depreciation Group fields with blank values from depreciation book records instead of only updating with non-blank values. Added comprehensive unit tests for both scenarios.

summary: The caption of the OnlyIfUntrusted option in the Payables Agent Email Review Policy enum changes from 'Only untrusted senders (recommended)' to 'Manage per sender (recommended)'.

title: #9705 [master] Transfer Order header deletion blocked by reserved quantity — inconsistent with line deletion and all other document types
summary: Transfer order header deletion is now allowed when reserved quantities exist, making the behavior consistent with deleting individual transfer lines and other document types.

title: #9708 Enable manual task creation for Sales Order Agent
summary: The Sales Order Agent now allows users to manually create tasks directly from the Agent Tasks pane using the New action, which opens the existing SOA Create Task page.

title: #9710 [Main] [all-e]CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns should be informed for Payment Discount lines in the French Audit File.Initial Commit

summary: The Calculate Inventory report now caches item variant information to reduce redundant database lookups when processing multiple records with the same variants.

title: #9746 [main] bug 644148 - Use VAT base amount (after discounts) for reverse charge limit check
summary: Reverse Charge VAT commodity limit check for Czech invoices now evaluates the amount after discounts (VAT base) instead of the gross unit price amount to align with Czech GFR regulation.

title: #9747 [Subcontracting] Bug 641607: Fix misleading error message when disabling Legacy Subcontracting with open WIP purchase orders
summary: Fixed the error message when disabling Legacy Subcontracting to correctly state that only purchase orders with WIP Items block the operation, not all subcontracting purchase orders.

title: #9748 Image Analyzer: use Computer Vision v3.2 instead of retiring v1.0
summary: The Image Analyzer app switches from the retiring Computer Vision v1.0 to v3.2 API to prevent failures after the v1.0 retirement date of September 2026.

title: #9749 OIOUBL fixes after schematron update
summary: OIOUBL export now correctly handles discounts by reporting them with proper VAT categories per tax type instead of using a synthetic ReverseCharge, ensuring compliance with updated schematron validation rules.

title: #9751 Extract invoice date into Invoice Date field and recover due date fro…
summary: Invoice Date on the purchase draft is now filled from the extracted invoice date in both the ADI and MLLM readers. When the top-level due date is missing, the MLLM reader now takes the Due Date from payment_means.payment_due_date.

title: #9754 [Extensibility Request] issue 30380: add OnSplitPostedWhseReceiptLineOnNotFindWhseItemEntryRelation event
summary: A new integration event OnSplitPostedWhseReceiptLineOnNotFindWhseItemEntryRelation is added to codeunit 6500 Item Tracking Management, allowing extensions to customize the handling of posted warehouse receipt lines when no warehouse item entry relations exist.

title: #9772 [PA][Pioneer]: Numeric line fields mis-extracted (discount, quantity, unit of measure)
summary: E-Document importer now preserves zero quantities instead of forcing them to 1, derives quantity from total and price only when valid, never fabricates discounts, and carries unresolved unit codes through to the unit of measure field.

title: #9774 [Extensibility Request] issue 30378: add OnItemVariantOnAfterGetRecordOnBeforePrintOnlyIfSalesCheck event in Item Sales Statistics report
summary: A new integration event allows extensions to influence whether item variant rows are printed in the Item Sales Statistics report when "Only Items with Sales" and "Breakdown By Variant" are both enabled, by exposing the skip decision and related data to subscribers.

title: #9775 [Main]-Issued Reminders are printed without any header or footer in the United Kingdom version
summary: The Reminder report in the United Kingdom version now displays header and footer content when printed, restoring missing layout elements.

title: #9776 [main] bug 639499 - fix: Remove Status = Released condition from Send action buttons on Cash Document page
summary: The 'Release and Send' and 'Post and Send' actions on the Cash Document page are now enabled for all Receipt documents, not just those with Released status.

title: #9777 [Extensibility Request] issue 30377: add OnBeforePrintOnlyIfSalesCheck event in Item Sales Statistics report
summary: Item Sales Statistics report now exposes an integration event that allows extensions to override the skip decision for items based on sales quantity before printing, enabling custom logic for alternate UOM scenarios.

title: #9778 [Extensibility Request] issue 30362: add OnPostDocumentLinesOnBeforeInsertPostedHeaders event to Service-Post
summary: A new integration event OnPostDocumentLinesOnBeforeInsertPostedHeaders enables extensions to control which posted service document is created during service posting, matching the extensibility available in Sales-Post.

title: #9779 [Extensibility Request] issue 30361: add OnAutoArchiveJobOnCaseElse event to Job Archive Management
summary: A new integration event OnAutoArchiveJobOnCaseElse is added to Job Archive Management so extensions can handle custom archive modes beyond the standard options.

title: #9783 [Master] Purchase Return Order Posting Fails for Manually Reserved Lot-Tracked Items with Exact Cost Reversing Mandatory Enabled: "Applies-to Entry must not be filled out when reservations exist in Item Ledger Entry Entry No.='XXX'"
summary: Purchase return order posting now correctly handles manually reserved lot-tracked items when exact cost reversing is mandatory by automatically deriving the applies-to entry from the existing reservation during posting.

title: #9784 [E-Document Formats] Fix defects in V2 draft migration for XRechnung, PINT A-NZ and Factura-E
summary: Fixes defects in the V2 draft import for XRechnung, PINT A-NZ and Factura-E. Re-reading an XRechnung draft no longer duplicates lines, and unsupported root elements or namespaces are rejected. PINT A-NZ vendor-matching fallbacks now receive values. Credit notes and corrective invoices now map the original invoice reference so they can be applied.

title: #9787 [Subcontracting] Added actionable notification when a vendor does not have a subcontracting location code
summary: A notification now alerts users when a vendor lacks a subcontracting location code, enabling early detection of missing configuration before downstream processes require it.

title: #9788 [Master]-Incorrect Reservation Split Generated After Replanning a Replenishment Production Order Created by MRP Planning Run
summary: Fixed incorrect reservation splits when replanning production orders with multiple component lines using the same item. The fix rebuilds the reservation split instead of only adjusting the delta.

title: #9789 [Main]-Payment discount tolerance is doubled when posting a vendor payment
summary: Fixed a bug where payment discount tolerance was calculated twice for vendor payments with Applies-to ID in foreign currency, causing inflated bank amounts and sign errors in GL entries.

title: #9792 Migrate ZUGFeRD, PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE, Factur-X FR and Peppol BIS 3.0 FR to the V2 draft import pipeline
summary: German ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE formats and French Factur-X and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 FR formats are now migrated to the V2 draft import pipeline, enabling the draft-based workflow and Copilot-assisted matching previously unavailable for these localized e-document formats.

enumextension peppol bis 3.0 de read draft

title: #9796 Show a message when an e-document file cannot be viewed or no data could be extracted
summary: E-document import handling now displays user-friendly messages when a PDF file cannot be displayed or no data was extracted, instead of throwing runtime errors.

title: #9797 Bug 641388: Fix WIP transfer remainder over-creation when open line quantity is reduced
summary: Fixed a bug in the Create Transfer Order to Subcontractor report where reducing an open WIP transfer line quantity caused incorrect duplicate lines to be created instead of properly tracking the remainder.

title: #9803 [master] Variant Code mandatory should not allow to refresh the production order with no variant code
summary: The Refresh Production Order report now validates that when an item requires a variant code, the production order cannot be refreshed without specifying one.

title: #9805 Update Email Folder tooltip to reference renamed 'Manage per sender' review option
summary: Payables Agent strings are updated to reference the renamed email review option 'Manage per sender' instead of 'Only if untrusted' across tooltips and labels.

title: #9810 [master]-Edit in Excel fails with false duplicate error when creating new Item Variants
summary: Item Variants page no longer fails with a false duplicate key error when creating new variants through Edit in Excel by limiting the forced record update to interactive clients only.

title: #9814 Revert "Expose AppService location and EUDB membership on Environment Information for internal consumption (#9716)"
summary: Removed Microsoft-only methods from the public Environment Information codeunit to avoid exposing internal functionality that third-party extensions cannot use.

title: #9818 [Subcontracting] Added assisted setup guide for initial app configuration
summary: Subcontracting app now includes a three-step assisted setup wizard that guides users through initial configuration independently, without requiring Manufacturing Setup during installation.

title: #9820 Use ReadCommitted isolation for CalcFields in Job Queue Entry GetXmlContent
summary: Job Queue Entry GetXmlContent method now uses ReadCommitted isolation when reading the XML parameter BLOB to prevent unnecessary locking and blocking in concurrent scenarios.

title: #9838 Grant indirect read on Privacy Notice tables in Privacy Notice Impl.
summary: The Privacy Notice Impl. codeunit now grants indirect read permission on Privacy Notice and Privacy Notice Approval tables to allow non-SUPER users to check privacy notice approval state in Copilot and service sessions without NavPermissionException.

title: #9841 Indent the case block under the IsHandled guard
summary: The case block in FinancialVoidCheck of the CheckManagement codeunit is now indented under its 'if not IsHandled' guard in the APAC, NA, RU and W1 layers. The change is whitespace only.

title: #9850 Fix VariantCode lost during Contract Price Update proposal
summary: Fixed variant code not being passed during subscription contract price updates, which caused the system to propose base item prices instead of variant-specific prices.

title: #9857 [main] bug 644746 - Add configurable EPO Service Setup for gov.cz domain migration
summary: A configurable EPO Service Setup table and page allow Czech administrators to manage the Electronic Filing Office endpoint URL when migrating from adisspr.mfcr.cz to mojedane.gov.cz, replacing hardcoded values with admin-configurable settings and registering the service in Service Connections.
tags: codeunit data class. eval. handler czl
