title: #9859 [Master] - Move Expense Agent (Preview) app into BCApps
summary: The Expense Agent (Preview) app source is moved into BCApps as a W1 app with country apps for AT, AU, CA, DE, DK, ES, FR, GB, NZ and US. It covers expense reports, approvals, an agent with Copilot capability, and API pages.

title: #9860 [Bug]: [DE] XRechnung/ZUGFeRD - Item Charge lines exported without a valid unit of measure code (BR-CL-23 / BR-23 on BT-130)
summary: Item charge lines are now correctly exported as allowances or charges in XRechnung and ZUGFeRD documents instead of fabricated invoice lines, with configurable mapping strategies to comply with EN 16931 validation rules.

title: #9863 [Extensibility Request] issue 29074: expose PurchLineQty in OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount
summary: The OnSumPurchLines2OnBeforeDivideAmount event now exposes the PurchLineQty parameter by reference, allowing subscribers to adjust the purchase line quantity before amount division calculations run.

title: #9864 [Extensibility Request] issue 29078: Add OnBeforeTestTransferLine event
summary: An OnBeforeTestTransferLine integration event was added to the TestTransferLine procedure on the Transfer Header table, enabling extensions to observe or extend transfer line testing logic.

title: #9865 [Main] - 'Greater Than' Withholding Tax Calculation Rule is not app…
summary: The withholding tax calculation now respects the configured calculation rule (Less than, Greater than, Equal to, etc.) instead of hard-coding comparisons, fixing incorrect withholding tax creation or suppression across different rule types.

title: #9868 [MAIN]-Bug 644801-IRS Reporting Period - Copy Setup process will copy the 1099 Adjustments as part of the process of copying from one IRS Reporting Period to a new Period setup.
summary: The copy setup process for IRS Reporting Periods now correctly resets 1099 adjustment amounts to zero when copying from one period to another, preventing incorrect carryover of adjustment values.

title: #9872 Add missing telemetry event IDs to E-Document Session.LogMessage calls
summary: Added missing telemetry event IDs to 21 Session.LogMessage calls in E-Document and Avalara connector apps to enable proper aggregation and monitoring in the telemetry pipeline.

title: #9876 [Subscription Billing] Rename progress tracker
summary: Codeunit 8035 was renamed from 'Progress Tracker' to 'Sub. Billing Progress Tracker' to avoid name conflicts with objects outside Subscription Billing, with all references updated accordingly.

title: #9878 Add buyer order reference to ZUGFeRD export
summary: ZUGFeRD export now includes the buyer order reference as BuyerOrderReferencedDocument to associate invoices with customer purchase orders, matching other German e-document formats.

title: #9886 [Master]  Expense Report posting FCY rounding mismatch "Expense Report Posting Test" fail in Spain only (Source Currency Amount 649.97 vs 650
summary: Fixed foreign currency rounding mismatch in expense report posting for Spain by improving how source currency amounts are calculated for employee payables balancing entries.

title: #9887 Exclude spend request G/L link from replication
summary: Table 6845 'Spend Request To G/L Link' is configured to exclude data replication, aligning with its parent Spend Request tables that already have this setting.
tags: table spend request to g/l link

title: #9892 [main] Bug 644283: Renumber Subcontracting app object ids as it clashes with partner range
summary: Subcontracting app object IDs are renumbered to avoid conflicts with partner-reserved ranges, affecting codeunits, tables, pages, and other objects throughout the app.

title: #9894 Suppress zero-value rows in Trial Balance by Period
summary: The Trial Balance by Period Excel report now suppresses rows with zero values by default and adds an optional request-page parameter to include them when needed.
tags: report exr trial bal by period excel

title: #9896 Rename PBI embedded pages
summary: Embedded Power BI report pages in the Power BI Reports, Subscription Billing and Sustainability apps were renamed. The change covers 127 files, each with a small two-line edit.

title: #9898 [Main]-The Reservation Entry does not exist error when creating a Purchase Order from a Sales Order
summary: Reverts an earlier change (PR 242051) to Item Tracking Management and Sales Line-Planning that caused a 'Reservation Entry does not exist' error when creating a Purchase Order from a Sales Order. The earlier change had targeted reservation entries for serial numbers assigned in that flow.

title: #9904 Let the agent see and set vendor posting groups and CIF or NIF
summary: The payables agent can now see and set vendor posting groups and tax identification numbers because the invoicing tab is visible in the agent profile, and the agent has permission to write VAT registration log entries.

title: #9905 [Bug][SubscriptionBilling] Contract lines of type G/L Account never post to the selected G/L account
summary: Contract lines of type G/L Account now post to the G/L account specified on the line instead of the default account from General Posting Setup, both for immediate posting and deferral release scenarios.

title: #9906 [Bug Fix] #641100: Export Acc. Sched. to Excel - log report usage in OnPostReport to avoid modal page in write transaction
summary: Report 29 now logs financial report usage after processing instead of before, preventing a write transaction that blocked modal pages when exporting account schedules with multiple worksheets.
tags: report export acc. sched. to excel

title: #9909 Searching for PayPal webhooks subscription is blocking the Cloud Migration
summary: PayPal webhook subscription search now uses SetFilter placeholders to handle special characters robustly while maintaining case-insensitive matching, preventing cloud migration blocking.

title: #9910 [SOA] Move attachment processing to direct model reading
summary: Sales Order Agent now processes PDF and image attachments directly with GPT-4.1 mini to extract structured JSON containing customer references, item details, quantities, and dates, replacing platform-generated attachment text before relevance validation.

title: #9912 Restore the IRS Forms assisted setup registration removed by the CLEAN25 sweep
summary: The IRS Forms setup wizard registration that was accidentally removed during a code cleanup sweep has been restored, allowing US users to access the 1099 setup guide from the Assisted Setup list again.

title: #9914 [APIV2] Return unapplied lines from the Vendor Payments API
summary: The Vendor Payments API now returns all payment lines in a batch, including unapplied payments and those with non-invoice applications, matching the behavior of the Customer Payments API.

title: #9933 [MAIN]-Fix-Bug 644909 Cant modify Item Template after Item deletion
summary: Item Template validation no longer fails with warehouse entry errors when modifying templates after item deletion. The fix prevents warehouse entry checks when validating temporary blank-numbered Item records.

title: #9937 Fix error when selecting item as the line type in German language
summary: Fixed an error that occurred when selecting an item as the line type in German language versions of Business Central on blanket sales order forms.

title: #9943 [Master]-Purchase invoice in USD with deferral shows 0 "Amount LCY" in Deferral Schedule View"
summary: Purchase invoices in foreign currency now correctly display the Amount LCY field in the Deferral Schedule view instead of showing zero values.

title: #9946 Fix Retrieve Users overwriting existing users' custom Role Center (AB#641534)
summary: Fixed a regression where Retrieve Users silently overwrote all existing users' custom Role Centers to Business Manager. The fix preserves existing users' Role Center customizations while still assigning the plan default to newly created users.

title: #9947 Allow long localized sales and purchase line type captions
summary: Sales and purchase document subforms no longer fail when a localized line type caption is longer than 20 characters, such as the French allocation account caption. A new FormatTypeAsText() returning Text[30] replaces FormatType(): Text[20], which stays as an obsolete wrapper.

title: #9949 [Bug 645022] UI improvements for report themes and header/footers (composite layout)
summary: Composite layout administration pages get UI improvements: page 9663 shows decoded part names, and page 9666 gains a Description column plus Replace, Edit description and Show info actions. Page 9668 adds a Description field, and page 9660 enables composite actions only for Word layouts.

title: #9950 [Master] - Bug 645038 Withholding Tax entries from a previous posting preview appear on unrelated documents (e.g. expense report)
summary: Withholding Tax entries from a previous posting preview no longer leak into unrelated document previews. The fix clears temporary WHT entries at the start of each preview instead of only during actual posting.

title: #9952 Show address lines 1-3 in address lookup display text
summary: The address lookup modal for Ideal Postcodes now displays address lines 1-3 combined in a single text field instead of showing separate address, city, and post code columns.

title: #9953 Rename AppSource UI text to Marketplace
summary: User-facing text that references AppSource has been updated to use Marketplace terminology throughout the application and system components.

title: #9954 Restoring undefined action. (Purchase Orders page can't be open in latest `main`)
summary: An earlier change emptied the body of an E-Document action. Because it was then not emitted, actionrefs pointing to it stopped the Purchase Orders page from opening. This change restores the action body so the pages open again.

title: #9955 XRechnung – Invalid XML Generated When Invoice Discount Percentage Exceeds 2 Decimals
summary: Fixed invalid XML generation in XRechnung when invoice discount percentage has more than 2 decimal places by reverting a previous regression.

title: #9958 [Main] -Detail Trial Balance - Running Balance Incorrect When "Include Closing Entries" Is Disabled
summary: Fixed the Detail Trial Balance report so that excluded closing entries no longer incorrectly accumulate into the running balance column, ensuring displayed balances reconcile with visible entries.

title: #9959 [Shopify] Add catalog filters to Sync Catalog Prices report
summary: The Sync Catalog Prices report now supports filtering by individual catalogs, allowing merchants to split large sync operations across multiple Job Queue entries to work within Business Central's 12-hour session limit.

title: #9960 [Extensibility Request] issue 30396: expose sales document lookup
summary: The lookup procedure in the Copy Sales Document report is now public, allowing report extensions to reuse the standard sales document selection logic without duplication.

title: #9961 [Extensibility Request] issue 30381: expose page sender to filter subscribers
summary: The OnRefreshPageOnAfterSetItemFilters event now exposes the page sender, allowing extensions to access page filters during item availability calculations without replacing standard behavior.
tags: page item availability by bom level

title: #9962 [Extensibility Request] issue 30383: add purchase line transfer event
summary: An IsHandled integration event is published in the purchase availability transfer logic, allowing extensions to handle additional purchase document types like Blanket Orders without encountering unsupported source errors.

title: #9963 [Extensibility Request] issue 30384: expose planning suggestions variable
summary: The IncludePlanningSuggestions variable on the Item Availability by Event page is now accessible to page extensions through protected scope.

title: #9964 [Extensibility Request] issue 30392: make Archive Jobs extensible
summary: The Archive Jobs setting in Jobs Setup is now extensible through an enum, allowing third-party solutions to add custom archival options while maintaining backward compatibility with existing values.

title: #9966 Harden Contact Sync delta URL and ownership checks
summary: Contact Sync now validates delta URLs against the approved Microsoft Graph endpoint and enforces record ownership checks to prevent malicious URL manipulation or cross-user record access.

title: #9967 [Main]-Production BOM Version certification does not check Variant Mandatory on lines
summary: Production BOM Version certification now validates that variant codes are populated for items marked as Variant Mandatory, preventing incomplete configurations from being certified.

title: #9968 [BC-IN] TDS Amount Not Calculated on Initial TDS Section Selection in Bank Payment Voucher
summary: TDS/GST/TCS taxes are now calculated on first entry of tax fields in Indian journal and voucher pages. The fix restores record saving before tax calculation and adds an event for advanced customization.

title: #9969 Add AL fast prompt interface and wrappers
summary: A new GetFastPrompt interface and AOAI Fast Prompt Response codeunit enable AL code to fetch blob-backed prompt templates from Edge Configuration Service with typed response handling.

title: #9973 [WHT]-Withholding Tax is not deducted from Expense Report lines based on the Expense Category during posting
summary: Withholding tax is now deducted from expense report lines during posting based on the expense category. The change adds new objects in the ExpenseWithholdingTax app and touches Expense Report posting, the WithholdingTax employee codeunits and Gen. Jnl.-Post Line in all layers.
tags: codeunit wht exp. report post handler

title: #9982 [Main] Item tracking validation when lot numbers are assigned concerns the warehouse pick level rather than at the sales order levelInitial Commit
summary: Fixes a bug where item tracking validation for assigned lot numbers was evaluated at the warehouse pick level instead of at the sales order level. Logic was added to the Item Tracking Data Collection codeunit, with new tests in the W1 and RU SCM item tracking test codeunits.

title: #9984 [Main] Error with unposted prepayment amounts on Order
summary: Fixed an error where unposted prepayment amounts on sales and purchase orders were calculated incorrectly when the quantity to invoice was modified, by making the prepayment deduction calculation idempotent across multiple trigger invocations.

title: #9985 [Master]-For an Item of 'Type' Service or Non-Inventory we allow you to increase the Quantity of the Corrective Credit Memo which then if posted updates the Purchase Order with a negative Received and Invoiced values
summary: Fixes corrective credit memos from posted purchase invoices with Service or Non-Inventory lines. Before, the quantity could be increased, and posting the credit memo left negative Received and Invoiced values on the original purchase order. Purchase Line and Correct Posted Purch. Invoice are changed in W1 and the localization layers.

title: #9987 Fix Payment Management FR data update paths and per-company feature status
summary: Centralizes the French payment data migration in a new codeunit so the Feature Management path also remaps payment step object IDs, and adds an upgrade tag to repair companies migrated before remapping existed. Feature status is no longer copied to every company after a data update, in the Payment Management FR app and the three GB apps.
tags: codeunit upg. tag payment management fr

title: #9988 [Expense Agent] Fix Employee subscriber permissions
summary: Fixes Expense Agent Employee event subscribers so they can sync and delete Expense Users without callers needing Expense User permissions, using method-scoped inherent permissions. Adds an API.ReadWrite.All application entitlement and moves internal agent APIs out of the Expense Management - Objects permission set.
tags: entitlement ea - azure ad application api

title: #9989 [SOA] Skip Item Selector for exact items without variants
summary: The Sales Order Agent no longer calls the Item Selector when an exact item search returns exactly one item and that item has no variants. This cuts latency and token use. Items with variants and standard or broader searches still go through the Item Selector.

title: #100 Add P0 integration and control add-in runtime guidance
summary: Adds guidance and code samples for linking API parts on SystemId with Multiplicity set, webhook eligibility and validationToken renewal, credentialed AJAX loading of packaged control add-in resources, and throttling AL calls and payload size from control add-ins. The web-services and UI review skills were extended to match.

title: #101 style-review: fix example finding id to match references[0].path
summary: The example in the style review documentation now has a correct finding id that matches its references path.

title: #102 Privacy DataClassification fixes + keep Label-scope findings at minor
summary: Fixed factual errors in the privacy data-classification article about platform defaults and expanded the classification taxonomy to cover organization and account identifiers. Corrected label-scope findings severity from info to minor since no analyzer enforces this rule.

title: #105 Promote validated community knowledge
summary: Community AL best practice articles are promoted to Microsoft-endorsed knowledge, removing duplicates and overlapping guidance while updating review skills with canonical references.

title: #108 Complete AL review knowledge readiness
summary: AL review knowledge expanded with new guidance on telemetry, Query objects, AppSource, breaking changes, and security; content gaps fixed, and validation harness added for consistent small-model evaluation.

title: #109 style-review: calibrate variable-declaration order (AA0021) to info
summary: The variable-declaration-order rule (AA0021) severity is calibrated down from minor to info level in quality reviews because it is redundant with the CodeCop analyzer.

title: #110 review: stop reference-less agent findings in privacy and UI/accessibility leaves
summary: The privacy and UI/accessibility review skills now report only findings backed by a BCQuality knowledge file. Concerns without a reference are omitted instead of being emitted with empty references, which cuts false positives at the cost of at most one true positive.

title: #112 Add precision guards for systematic agent false-positive patterns
summary: Adds six knowledge articles that act as precision guards against recurring agent false positives. They cover tooltips on bound page fields, Boolean page triggers that default to true, filters defined outside the diff, CalcFields in both GetRecord triggers, and unreleased symbol or schema changes that need no breaking-change or upgrade handling.

title: #114 Document the skill-vs-knowledge boundary so BC facts land in knowledge files
summary: Documentation now clarifies that skills should contain mechanics while knowledge files hold Business Central facts, establishing a boundary to prevent facts from being duplicated or misplaced across skills and knowledge articles.

title: #117 tooltip: PR review flags genuinely-missing tooltips instead of deferring to AA0218
summary: PR review now independently flags genuinely missing tooltips on page fields instead of deferring to compiler analyzer AA0218, which can be disabled or downgraded in team rulesets.

title: #118 knowledge: 3 FP-suppression guards from BC apps negative feedback
summary: Three knowledge articles are added to clarify AL facts that were incorrectly flagged by the review agent, suppressing false-positive findings for ObsoleteReason omissions, bare Get() calls, and OnAfterGetCurrRecord behavior.

title: #119 Add batch-2 FP guards: sentence-case action captions + PK Get is transaction-cached
summary: Two knowledge articles were added to guide developers about correct use of sentence-case action captions and transaction-cached primary key lookups, helping suppress false positive quality warnings.

title: #123 Fix bridge skill manifest references after #122 root move
summary: The documentation for the bcquality-al-review bridge skill was updated to reflect the plugin manifest relocation from `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` to the repository root `plugin.json` after PR #122.

title: #124 Add FP guards: field relocation to tableextension + event parameter addition (bug 642303)
summary: BCQuality adds two false-positive guards to prevent incorrect breaking-change flags when relocating a field to a table extension or adding a parameter to an event publisher.

title: #125 knowledge(data-modeling): TableRelation delete/rename asymmetry and the xRec before-image contract
summary: Adds three community data-modeling knowledge articles, each with good and bad AL examples: owning tables must delete dependents in OnDelete, ValidateTableRelation = false also stops rename propagation, and xRec is a true before-image only in some triggers.

title: #128 knowledge: improve review precision from BCApps PR 10080 feedback
summary: BCQuality knowledge articles improve precision based on feedback from BCApps code review runs, refining guidance on object affixes and error handling patterns.

title: #130 knowledge(performance): align SetLoadFields placement with AL Guidelines
summary: BCQuality aligned SetLoadFields code examples with AL Guidelines by placing filters before SetLoadFields, clarifying that this order is a readability convention rather than a performance requirement.

title: #131 Correct table-level data classification guidance
summary: Privacy guidance now states that a valid table-level DataClassification is inherited by fields unless they override it. The fixture and related PII article were updated to separate inherited defaults from genuinely unclassified fields, which should stop false-positive review comments asking for redundant field-level declarations.

title: #132 Refine self-improvement review guidance
summary: BCQuality guidance refined to reduce false positives in event handling, UI testing, performance analysis, and label scope rules by narrowing criteria to match documented platform behavior and actual code semantics.

title: #133 Add TransferFields SkipFieldsNotMatchingType guidance
summary: Added guidance in BCQuality to warn developers against using TransferFields with SkipFieldsNotMatchingType as a blanket solution, as it can silently drop fields when type mismatches occur within the same extension.

title: #134 knowledge(performance): add community rules for performance
summary: Adds 16 community performance rules for Business Central to BCQuality. Each rule has a markdown explanation and paired bad and good AL examples covering partial records, HTTP calls inside transactions, ChangeCompany use, page and session I/O, number-series batching and database access patterns.

title: #135 Correct severe misconception about SetCurrentKey in the knowledge base
summary: Documentation corrected to clarify that SetCurrentKey only affects SQL sort order, not index selection by SQL Server, removing outdated guidance that misled AL developers.

title: #136 Add community knowledge: AL boolean operators do not short-circuit
summary: Two community knowledge articles explain AL's lack of short-circuit evaluation for boolean operators and recommend using case statements as alternatives for complex condition chains.

title: #137 Add community guidance and review support for Business Central agents
summary: Business Central agent developers gain 20 community-authored guidance rules covering agent registration, permissions, profiles, instructions, session handling, and lifecycle management, with good and bad code examples for each rule.

title: #138 knowledge(style): event subscribers bind by parameter name, so a shorter list is not a mismatch
summary: The style guide for event subscribers is clarified to document the actual behavior that AL binds subscribers by parameter name rather than position, allowing subscribers to omit parameters and reorder them without it being a mismatch.

title: #139 knowledge(breaking-changes): adding a parameter to an event publisher is not a signature break
summary: The breaking-changes knowledge article now clarifies that adding a parameter to an event publisher is not a breaking change, since event subscribers bind by parameter name, not position. This aligns the article with the existing events knowledge and removes a false positive report.

title: #142 Add AL-focused AppSource validation guidance
summary: Six community AppSource knowledge articles with paired good and bad AL samples now cover profile objects, invariant date literals, page extension action placement, UI calls in web-service paths, UsageCategory on searchable entry points, and time-zone offsets. The AppSource review skill routes AL signals to them.

title: #144 Avoid Public Event publisher
summary: A new community knowledge article with samples advises declaring event publishers local or internal instead of public, because the access modifier controls who may raise an event, not who may subscribe. Sample files of four existing Microsoft-layer articles drop their incidental public modifier.

title: #145 Process Context via manual event subscriber pattern
summary: Adds community knowledge article documenting how to expose process context to extensions using manual event subscriber bindings tied to variable scope instead of singleton flags that persist across failed transactions.

title: #146 knowledge: three false-positive guards from BCApps PR 10277, 10278 and 10346
summary: Three BCQuality knowledge articles were added or updated to stop false positives: insert-only transfers that rely on the caller to clean up first, member affixes in apps that do not configure an AppSourceCop mandatory affix, and permission tests that lower the context through a composed role. Genuine defects remain reportable.

title: #147 ShowMandatory + OnQueryClosePage Check
summary: Two new UI community knowledge articles with code examples demonstrate best practices for marking required fields and validating request page input to prevent common defects like fields appearing optional or losing user input on validation errors.

title: #148 Add Job Queue reliability and scheduling guidance
summary: Six new performance guidance articles document reliability and scheduling practices for Job Queue and Task Scheduler workloads, including idempotency requirements, UI independence, failure propagation, category-based serialization, on-hold behavior, and duplicate task prevention.

title: #149 knowledge(web-services): under schema 2.0 an API enum field is a contract by member name, under 1.0 by caption
summary: A knowledge article clarifies how API enum fields are published: under schema 2.0 by member name with captions in entityDefinitions, under schema 1.0 by en-US caption as Edm.String. Good and bad code samples demonstrate the contract implications.

title: #150 Simplify standalone AL code review skill
summary: The standalone AL code review skill is renamed from bcquality-al-review to al-code-review, with its SKILL.md simplified to a thin adapter that delegates to internal Entry and coordinator components. Plugin manifests and version are updated accordingly.

title: #152 knowledge(events): ChangeCompany leaves triggers and trigger-event subscribers running in the calling company
summary: A knowledge article documents that ChangeCompany does not move trigger execution context to the target company; triggers and trigger-event subscribers still run in the calling company. StartSession is recommended for cross-company operations that require proper trigger handling.

title: #153 Promote knowledge for Microsoft-owned review skills
summary: Moves 29 knowledge articles and 56 companion samples used by Microsoft-endorsed review skills from the Community layer to the Microsoft layer, so they stay available when consumers disable the Community layer. File contents are unchanged, and the Agents corpus stays in Community.

title: #156 18 AL/BC patterns: style, data-modeling, web-services, appsource, breaking-changes, performance, testing
summary: Adds 17 AL/BC knowledge articles with good and bad samples across style, data modeling, web services, AppSource, breaking changes, performance and testing, and updates the matching review skills. The description lists a FlowFields web-services article that is not among the changed files.

title: #157 18 more AL/BC patterns: data-modeling, testing, style, security, error-handling, ui, upgrade, web-services, appsource
summary: BCQuality adds 18 new knowledge articles covering data modeling, testing, style, security, error handling, UI, upgrade, web services, and AppSource patterns with code examples and best practices.

title: #158 3 AL/BC patterns from CURABIS's internal automated-testing training material
summary: Four new AL/BC best practice patterns were added covering item ledger entry document numbers after combined posting and three testing approaches for verifying field UI state and generating unique test values.

title: #159 3 AL/BC testing patterns from an external BC testing expert's blog (Luc van Vugt, fluxxus.nl)
summary: Adds three AL testing knowledge articles drawn from Luc van Vugt's blog: excluding known invalid relations in Table Relation Test through the OnAfterRemoveTableRelation event, committing shared fixture data inside a lazy Initialize(), and using Assert.IsFalse rather than asserterror around Assert.IsTrue.

title: #160 Clarify page field caption and tooltip inheritance
summary: Knowledge articles now state that bound page fields inherit Caption and, from BC24 runtime 13.0, ToolTip from their source table fields. Agents should inspect source fields before flagging missing properties, which avoids redundant page-level captions and tooltips.

title: #161 AL methods limited during write transactions (RunModal, Codeunit.Run)
summary: New performance guidance documents platform restrictions on calling RunModal and Codeunit.Run methods during write transactions, explaining when each method is blocked and how to structure code to avoid triggering the runtime error.

title: #172 Support standalone runners and complete app-folder reviews
summary: AL review skills now support standalone runners and folder-based app reviews by decoupling scheduling concerns and enabling parallel execution of independent review domains while maintaining deterministic result ordering.

title: #173 Frame app review as one standalone plugin example
summary: BCQuality documentation now presents the project as a general skill plugin model with app review as one example, removing code-review-specific framing and external orchestrator references.

title: #174 Make BCQuality documentation easier for partners to get started
summary: BCQuality documentation is reorganized to guide partners through practical first-use paths, leading with CLI prerequisites and plugin installation rather than internal architecture. Sample references across knowledge articles become clickable links, and the Community Agents review gains folder-path support.

title: #175 9 AL/BC patterns: document distribution, price calculation & barcode extensibility
summary: Nine new AL/BC patterns document best practices for document distribution, report selections, price calculation extensibility, barcode usage, and posting-cascade field mirroring, with verified examples from Business Central source.

title: #176 Complete partner contribution and knowledge consumption guides
summary: Documentation expanded to guide partners on reading quality knowledge, contributing articles, and consuming skills in custom agents, with clarifications on metadata, integration, and SetLoadFields guidance.

title: #177 Add retention policy knowledge to the privacy domain
summary: Added guidance to the privacy domain in BCQuality about registering extension-owned tables for retention policies and shipping default retention policy setups, addressing common mistakes in how extensions handle log table cleanup.

title: #178 Separate deterministic analyzer rules from BCQuality
summary: Deterministic analyzer rules and their documentation are removed from BCQuality, leaving only knowledge that adds BC-specific context beyond what the compiler already enforces.

title: #179 Add bounded knowledge retrieval
summary: Adds bounded, lossless knowledge retrieval for BCQuality review skills. Catalog pages are capped at 16,000 UTF-8 bytes and return every applicable row with no ranking. Article and sample bodies are fetched exactly in chunks of up to eight paths. Each review leaf gets private GUID-scoped scratch and report paths, and its return is validated deterministically before rollup.

title: #180 Normalize recoverable leaf finding ranges
summary: Review findings whose primary line lies inside location.range but differs from start-line are no longer rejected. A deep-copied candidate drops the optional range, keeps the raw output unchanged, and must pass the existing strict acceptance gate. All other invalid or ambiguous leaves still fail.

title: #182 Add machine-readable review orchestration contract
summary: BCQuality now generates a deterministic, machine-readable skill index from review frontmatter and validates review composition through schemas and CI checks.

title: #183 Add reporting review guidance and evaluation fixtures
summary: Nine reporting rules and guidance articles have been added to the BCQuality knowledge base covering report variable clearing, CurrReport control flow, report extensions, table view narrowing, and request page cancellation.

title: #184 Fix Job Queue knowledge sample links
summary: Job Queue knowledge articles were corrected to use relative Markdown links for code samples instead of inline code references, restoring the proper format required by the knowledge retrieval system.

title: #186 Add Query filter semantics guidance
summary: Documentation added explaining how DataItemTableFilter and ColumnFilter behave with runtime filters in queries, with examples and validation through the Query review skill.

title: #187 Code reviewer skill for recognizing and validating unauthenticated responses
summary: A new code reviewer skill was added to detect unauthenticated URL usage and validate the required response checks that must be enforced in those scenarios.

title: #192 Add SCM functional knowledge domain
summary: SCM (supply chain management) functional knowledge domain added with nine scoped rules and self-contained AL code samples covering item posting, reservations, warehouse adjustments, and requisition workflows.

title: #193 Clarify locale-safe DateFormula Evaluate inputs
summary: Adds a Microsoft Style article clarifying that DateFormula Evaluate calls require language-independent literals to work correctly in non-English localizations, addressing a localization gap where such calls could fail despite correct downstream CalcDate typing.

title: #195 Add foundational AL developer knowledge
summary: Adds seven foundational AL knowledge articles covering document default initialization, directed rounding, guarded interface casts, dropdown visibility, page-part refresh, and install/upgrade ordering and version context. Related review skills get targeted retrieval cues.

title: #196 Strengthen review contracts and add AL reliability guidance
summary: Adds seven AL reliability rules with good and bad samples: two on outbound HttpClient failure and status handling, and five on base quantities, SetFilter placeholders, test isolation, JSON null checks and format 9. The review framework also gets deterministic layered skill precedence and a findings-report validator.

title: #198 Add BC performance knowledge from OptimAL learnings
summary: Adds six performance knowledge articles with paired good and bad AL examples on workload-based and overlapping indexes, buffered inserts, aggregate-before-write, scoped reuse and repeated validation. Refines existing guidance on partial loads, temporary buffers, bulk updates, existence checks, primary-key caching and FlowField versus stored totals.

title: #199 Fix indirect permission letters: `ri` is indirect read plus insert
summary: A security best practice article now correctly explains that permission letters r, i, m, d each represent one permission (read, insert, modify, delete), and corrects its examples to avoid over-granting indirect permissions.

title: #202 Restore deterministic review fixture coverage
summary: Quality review fixtures now register 23 knowledge articles with deterministic coverage, including retrieval keywords to ensure clean and positive controls remain discoverable within the bounded candidate set.

title: #203 knowledge(data-modeling): Prices Including VAT decides the basis of sales/purchase/service line amounts
summary: A knowledge article clarifies how the Prices Including VAT header flag affects the basis of line amount fields in sales, purchase, and service documents, distinguishing fields that follow the flag from those with fixed net or gross basis.

title: #204 Validate composed reviews against the expected leaf worklist
summary: The findings-report validator gets an optional expected-composition manifest. It checks that selected leaves, versions, result order and legitimate skips match what the host chose. Duplicate producers are now rejected, and a composition with missing leaves must be reported as partial or failed instead of completed.

title: #205 Preserve business filters when recommending Record.Get
summary: The performance guidance for replacing FindFirst with Record.Get now clarifies that additional business filters must be preserved, either by keeping the filtered FindFirst or by enforcing equivalent conditions after Get.

title: #207 2 AL/BC UI patterns: client-expression in-list (AL0573) and Role Center AccessByPermission
summary: Two new UI knowledge articles were added. One covers in-list set-membership tests in client expressions such as Visible or Enabled on actions, groups and parts, which only raise warning AL0573. The other covers using AccessByPermission for permission gating on Role Centers, where triggers and procedures are not allowed.

title: #208 2 AL/BC patterns: TableRelation field length and RecordRef.Open Temp parameter
summary: Two new knowledge articles identify silent runtime mismatches in table relations and record reference calls that compile without diagnostic warnings. The articles explain the exact rules for field length matching and the pitfalls of using RecordRef.Open with the temporary parameter flag.

title: #209 3 AL/BC patterns: Insert/Delete trigger defaults on master data and declined Confirm in OnValidate
summary: Three new articles guide developers to use triggers when writing or deleting master data and to properly abort validations when user confirmation is declined.

title: #210 knowledge(upgrade): upgrade code must not use ChangeCompany
summary: New quality rule and knowledge article prevent upgrade code from using ChangeCompany, which can cause data races, duplicate upgrades, and trigger misexecution in the calling company context.

title: #213 knowledge(events): database trigger setup flags may only be set to true
summary: Adds a knowledge article and review check: subscribers to GetDatabaseTableTriggerSetup (Global Triggers) or OnAfterGetDatabaseTableTriggerSetup (codeunit 49) should only set the shared trigger flags to true. Assigning false or a lookup result can clear flags that other features or apps rely on.

title: #214 UI knowledge: notification recall needs a known Id; open mixed-type documents through Page Management
summary: Two new UI design guidance articles added to help developers properly manage notifications by using known IDs for recall and handle multi-document routing through Page Management instead of hard-coded mappings.

title: #215 knowledge(performance): grouped query (Count + ColumnFilter = HAVING) for distinct values and duplicates
summary: A new performance knowledge article teaches developers how to use query objects with grouped methods and column filters to detect duplicate values in a single SQL statement instead of looping with multiple queries.

title: #216 knowledge(style): a new procedure that changes the page's current record should take it as var Record
summary: New style guidance document for AL developers on when procedures that modify a record should take the record as a var parameter, with good and bad code samples and exclusions.

title: #218 Harden findings-report producer constraints
summary: Findings reports now enforce stricter validation rules for finding IDs, confidence levels, and severity values to prevent contract failures. Finding IDs must not contain citation fragments, uncited findings are restricted to medium/low confidence and minor/info severity, and a checklist clarifies proper handling of citation paths and line numbering.

title: #49 Promote security knowledge from community to Microsoft layer
summary: Five security knowledge articles moved from the community layer to the Microsoft layer with minor content refinements to remove non-existent references and contribution prompts.

title: #54 Emit human-readable domain label on review findings
summary: BCQuality review leaves now set an optional human-readable domain label on every finding, so BCQuality owns the display label instead of the consumer engine's static map. Once the BC-ALAgents counterpart is merged, new review domains can render with their own label rather than Other.

title: #57 Add source-verified Finance knowledge and review domain
summary: Adds a Microsoft-owned Finance knowledge domain with nine articles, each paired with bad and good AL samples, plus a new al-finance-review skill. The articles cover posting ledger entries, dimension sets, applying entries, due dates, reversals, journal balance and Normal VAT amounts.

title: #62 Add testing knowledge: UI handlers, table relations, asserterror, fixtures (P1+P2)
summary: Adds three testing knowledge articles to BCQuality under microsoft/knowledge/testing: UI handlers in tests, pairing asserterror with expected error checks, and using library codeunits for test fixtures. Each article has a markdown page plus good and bad AL examples.

title: #65 Add data-modeling and appsource knowledge articles (MICROSOFT layer)
summary: Seven remedial BCQuality knowledge articles added to the MICROSOFT layer covering data-modeling patterns, AppSource conventions, and styling best practices, with good and bad AL code examples for each.

title: #84 Package BCQuality as an installable plugin (experiment)
summary: Experimentally packages BCQuality as an installable plugin for Copilot CLI and Claude Code hosts. It adds marketplace and plugin manifests plus a bridge skill that bootstraps the existing entry protocol for AL code review, without changing knowledge or routing logic.

title: #87 Fix knowledge corpus integrity issues
summary: Fixes broken references and mismatched examples in BCQuality skill documentation and limits DataTransfer, teaching-tip and 'this' articles to the Business Central versions that support them. It also restores a missing article title and lets the root-entry guard accept .claude-plugin/. The knowledge and findings contracts are unchanged.

title: #92 Correct security and privacy knowledge guidance
summary: Security and privacy knowledge articles were corrected to align with current Business Central APIs and behavior, including fixes for SecretText HTTP guidance, error telemetry semantics, field data classification, and consent handling.

title: #93 Fix lifecycle compatibility guidance
summary: Knowledge articles and samples on error handling, events, interfaces, upgrade, testing, web services and breaking changes were corrected. API page defaults were clarified, version-specific API shapes now need separate page objects, and the web-services review example now follows APIVersion defaulting to beta.

title: #94 Correct performance knowledge guidance
summary: Several performance knowledge articles and their samples were corrected for partial records, transactions, N+1 lookups, SIFT, bulk writes and read isolation. The invalid filter-only SetLoadFields rule and the generic production-scale article were removed, and an unsafe Sales Header deletion sample was replaced with a staging-table scenario.

title: #95 style-review: calibrate analyzer-redundant rules to info; keep correctness bugs out of style scope
summary: The al-style-review skill recalibrates analyzer-redundant rules to info severity and clarifies domain boundaries to keep correctness issues out of the style scope, reducing false-positive findings in code review.

title: #96 Add missing AL review leaf skills
summary: Four new AL code review leaf skills were added to cover testing, data modeling, AppSource, and telemetry review scenarios, integrated into the main AL code review capability.

title: #97 Add per-row AL performance guidance
summary: New performance guidance documents how to use SetAutoCalcFields for per-row FlowFields and how to avoid cloning records before Modify or Delete in loops, with corrections to the commit checkpoint sample.

title: #98 Add P0 event and interface compatibility knowledge
summary: Guidance added for event and interface compatibility patterns, covering enum unknown value handling, published interface evolution, subscriber contracts for local and internal events, and shipped event attribute immutability.

title: #99 Add lifecycle error and privacy knowledge
summary: Five new knowledge articles with code samples were added covering try-function semantics, upgrade phase data writes, install-versus-upgrade dispatch logic, ErrorInfo privacy exposure, and FeatureTelemetry logging, plus related review skills were updated.

title: Integrating AI in Business Central: A Step-by-Step Guide

title: Understanding ToText() in Business Central 2025
summary: ToText(), new in Business Central 2025 Wave 1, turns values of many AL data types into text using a fixed default format with no formatting options, though date and time types take an optional boolean for invariant output. The post shows the results for decimal, big integer, integer, byte, boolean, date, time, datetime, duration, GUID and version, noting output mostly matches Format(value, 0, 0) and that it does not replace Format.

title: Effortless Layout Editing in Business Central
summary: Business Central Designer Mode enables drag-and-drop field editing through Visual Studio Code by pressing F6 instead of F5, automatically generating AL code from the visual changes made to pages without requiring manual coding.

title: Exploring Dynamics User Groups at DynamicsCon 2025
summary: DynamicsCon 2025 is a conference offering 350+ sessions where professionals in the Dynamics community gather to network, share knowledge, and learn from each other despite being competitors in the business. Dynamics User Groups (DUG) provide local networking and free training opportunities for users and partners.

title: Experience at DynamicsCon 2025: Friends, Fun, and Learning
summary: A retrospective on attending DynamicsCon 2025, highlighting sessions on Business Central performance management, Power Pages, sales pricing, Power Automate, AI in AL Development, and Power BI, along with networking experiences and community engagement at the conference.

title: Creating Data Driven Text with AI in Business Central
summary: This post shows how to build a Copilot in Business Central that generates personalized reminder text for overdue customer balances by combining user input with customer data from the database. It demonstrates passing customer name, balance due, last invoice date, and tone to an AI model to create natural-sounding collection letters.

title: Creating Low-Code AI Agents with Copilot Studio and Business Central
summary: Copilot Studio enables low-code creation of AI agents that connect to Business Central and other platforms without requiring extensions. The post walks through building an accounts receivable assistant by configuring the Business Central Find Records tool, adding PDF knowledge sources, and publishing to Teams.

title: Business Central Queries: Simplifying Complex Data
summary: Business Central Query objects allow developers to combine data from multiple tables using joins and filters, similar to SQL queries. Queries simplify complex data retrieval by defining linked data items with columns and join types, and can be exposed in Business Central for analysis and reporting.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Excel Reporting in Business Central
summary: Excel reporting in Business Central allows developers to create data-driven reports that users can easily customize with pivot tables and charts. The post demonstrates building a customer activity report and uploading the customized layout back to Business Central so updates appear automatically in future runs.

title: How to Work with JSON in Business Central’s AL Code
summary: Working with JSON in Business Central AL involves understanding JSON structures (values, objects, arrays) and using JsonObject, JsonArray, and JsonToken types to parse incoming JSON data and export records as JSON. This is essential for API integrations, AI systems, and computer-to-computer data exchanges.

title: Implementing a Multi-Step Process for AI Recommendations in Business Central
summary: This post demonstrates how to build a multi-step AI-assisted process in Business Central that generates product recommendations from sales order line descriptions. The process uses AI to identify keywords from sales line data, then searches the item catalog to recommend relevant products for users to add to their orders.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Business Central API Queries
summary: This post explains how to create Query objects configured as APIs in Business Central to expose data for external systems like Power BI and Power Automate. It demonstrates building a Vendor Ledger API and connecting it to Power BI for reporting, highlighting advantages like handling related records and enforcing read-only access.

title: Understanding User Control Host in Business Central
summary: User Control Host is a new Business Central page type that hosts web pages and custom controls with minimal overhead, designed originally to support Power BI reports and enabling embedded HTML resources without standard page infrastructure.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Word Reports in Business Central
summary: Word reports in Business Central allow developers to create report objects while power users design the layout in Microsoft Word, enabling document-style reports like invoices or activity summaries. This approach separates data definition from presentation design using Word's XML mapping features.

title: Easy Steps to Edit Word Reports in Business Central
summary: This post explains how to edit Word report layouts in Business Central by exporting an existing report, modifying it in Microsoft Word using Developer tools, and understanding the XML mapping structure that connects report fields to data. It covers the process from exporting a layout to uploading the modified version back to Business Central.

title: Step by Step Guide to Importing Excel Data into Business Central
summary: This post demonstrates how to import Excel data into Business Central by creating a staging table, using the Excel Buffer record to read spreadsheet contents, validating the data, and then creating actual business records. It covers practical steps for handling external Excel files with custom logic and error checking.

title: Best Practices for Handling Delimited Data Imports into Business Central
summary: This post explains how to import comma-separated values (CSV) customer data into Business Central by parsing delimited files into a temporary staging table and then creating customer records. It demonstrates best practices for handling unstructured, flat file formats through code examples and provides a complete workflow from file upload to database insertion.

title: Understanding RDLC Reports in Business Central
summary: RDLC reports use Report Definition Language Client to create self-hosted pixel-perfect printed reports in Business Central. This post explains RDLC fundamentals, how to edit existing report layouts with Microsoft Report Builder, and when to use RDLC versus Excel and Word reporting formats.

title: Essential Guides to Data Imports in Business Central
summary: An index post for Business Central developers that points to a series of guides on importing and exporting data with AL. The linked guides cover JSON handling, delimited files, header and detail imports, Excel and multi-tab Excel files, and XML.

title: Enhancing Business Central with Address Validation AI
summary: Address validation using Azure OpenAI compares user-entered addresses against existing Business Central address records to identify matches and preserve associated metadata. The solution uses a system prompt to guide AI in matching addresses semantically rather than character-by-character, returning match confidence scores.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Page Customizations for Business Central in AL
summary: Page customizations in Business Central allow developers to tailor page layouts to specific user profiles without modifying core functionality. The post demonstrates how to create page customization objects and profiles in AL code to hide fields and actions, hide financial data from data entry users, and deploy customizations as part of an extension.

title: Business Central 2027 release wave 1: Preparing for OData Endpoint Removal
summary: Business Central version 30 will remove pages managed by Microsoft extensions from OData Web Service endpoints. Organizations using these endpoints must migrate to Business Central API 2.0, create custom 2.0 APIs, or copy pages to custom objects to maintain system integrations like Excel and Power BI.

title: Guide to Handling Header and Detail Imports into Business Central with AL
summary: This guide demonstrates how to parse and import delimited files containing header and detail records (like sales orders) into Business Central using AL. It covers two formats: normalized (separate header/detail lines identified by markers) and denormalized (merged header/detail data on single lines), with code examples for parsing both formats into staging tables and creating sales orders.

title: Securing Sensitive Data in Business Central AL using SecretText
summary: SecretText is a data type in Business Central AL that protects sensitive values like API keys and authentication credentials from being exposed in debuggers or passed insecurely between procedures. The post demonstrates how to use SecretText with JSON objects and isolated storage to keep secrets hidden during extension development.

title: Azure OpenAI in Business Central AL: Managed vs Unmanaged
summary: The post compares two ways for AL code to authenticate to Azure OpenAI in Business Central. SetAuthorization uses your own Azure OpenAI deployment, which gives you control but you pay for and maintain it. SetManagedResourceAuthorization uses the Microsoft-managed resource, which is included in the Business Central allotment, and it gets grounded Bing search when Copilot web search is enabled.

title: Understanding AL Development: The Type Helper Code Unit
summary: The Type Helper code unit is a utility in Business Central's System.Reflection namespace containing 74 procedures for data formatting, localization, type conversion, and math functions commonly used in API handling and advanced AL development scenarios.

title: Top Improvements in Business Central Page Scripting in Release 2025 Wave 2
summary: Page Scripting tool in Business Central 2025 Wave 2 adds features to manage and edit recorded scripts more flexibly, including step deletion, insertion, reordering, parameter management, and script composition - addressing pain points from manual YAML editing and full re-recording requirements.

title: Truncate vs. DeleteAll: Speed in Dynamics 365 Business Central AL
summary: The new Truncate AL method in Business Central 2025 Wave 2 deletes large data volumes 118 times faster than DeleteAll by bypassing triggers and event subscriptions, but only works on specific table types without certain field types or security restrictions.

title: Exploring Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Business Automation in Business Central
summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers enable AI agents to interact with Business Central data and perform actions like querying, creating, and modifying records. The post explains MCP concepts, demonstrates setting up an MCP server for the sales quote process, configuring it in Copilot Studio, and highlights security considerations such as limiting data exposure through custom APIs.

title: Understanding AL Development: String Conversion Management Code Unit
summary: The String Conversion Management Code Unit provides four procedures for handling text transformations in AL development, including encoding conversion, padding, decimal removal, and alphanumeric filtering. It wraps .NET System.Text objects functionality that would be difficult to implement in AL alone.

title: Using CoPilot to Upgrade Service Notes for Invoices in Business Central AL
summary: This post demonstrates how to use Copilot to automatically upgrade raw service technician notes into professional, customer-facing text for invoices in Business Central. It addresses the common problem of processing hundreds of poorly written service notes daily by creating a table for resolution notes, extending the Sales Header with a BLOB field, and implementing a Copilot prompt dialog that generates formatted HTML summaries.

title: Advanced JSON Management for Business Central Developers
summary: Codeunit 5459 JSON Management provides a comprehensive toolset for reading, writing, and converting JSON in Business Central AL code. It simplifies complex data handling by grouping procedures into Read, Write, and Convert categories, with special attention to SaaS-safe operations for cloud deployments.

title: Understanding AL Development: Environmental Information Code Unit
summary: Codeunit 457 Environment Information provides methods to detect deployment type, environment type, and application family in AL extensions. It helps developers run different code paths for production versus sandbox environments, such as redirecting emails in sandbox to safe addresses instead of real clients.

title: How to Use Concealed Text Fields in Business Central AL
summary: Business Central 27.1 introduces Concealed Text Fields, which mask sensitive data during input to prevent shoulder surfing and screen captures. Developers can enable this feature through Feature Management and apply the MaskType property to Code, Text, Decimal, and Integer fields.

title: Importing Multi-Tab Excel Files into Business Central
summary: This post explains how to import multi-tab Excel files into Business Central with a header/line relationship structure. It provides code examples using AL to read separate header and line sheets, maintain relational integrity with a dictionary-based key mapping system, and populate staging tables.

title: Managing Optional Extensions in Business Central AL Code
summary: This post explains how to create a single Business Central extension that optionally interacts with a third-party extension without creating a hard dependency. The technique uses NavApp.GetModuleInfo to detect if an optional extension is installed, then uses RecordRef and FieldRef to conditionally set extension-specific fields.

title: Debugging Business Event Subscriptions in Business Central
summary: Business Central has hidden pages for debugging Business Event Subscriptions (which function as web hooks). title: 2025 Highlights: Engaging Moments in Business Central Events

title: Streamline Your AL Development with Global NuGet Symbols

This streamlines AL extension development by adding al.symbolsCountryRegion configuration and using a new download symbols command in Visual Studio Code.

title: How to Use External APIs in Business Central
summary: This post explains how to consume external APIs from within Business Central by making HTTP requests using the HttpClient data type and parsing JSON responses. title: Step-by-Step Guide to AI Campaigns in Business Central

Set up the feature in GitHub settings and create a codereview.instructions.md file with AL-specific guidelines to guide Copilot's review process and ensure AppSource-ready, high-quality extensions.

title: Navigating Namespace Changes in Business Central 28
summary: Business Central 28 introduces fully qualified names for pages, codeunits, reports, and record references, allowing developers to reference objects directly without requiring using statements at the top of files. This improves code clarity by making object origins explicit at the point of use.

title: Overcoming Integer Limits in Business Central with BigInteger
summary: Business Central's integer data type maxes out at 2.1 billion records, a limit some implementations have hit. AL Version 18 (Business Central 2026 Wave 1) now supports migrating integer fields to BigInteger, which extends the range to 9.2 quintillion values, with compiler warnings to prevent overflow issues.

title: Effective Steps for Troubleshooting Business Central Agents
summary: This post explains how to troubleshoot Business Central agents by examining task logs, step-by-step operations, and detailed agent actions. It covers analyzing agent reasoning, reviewing data visibility, adjusting agent permissions and profiles, and monitoring Copilot credit consumption.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Secure Business Central Agent Implementations in AL
summary: This post demonstrates how to secure AI agents in Business Central by implementing restrictive profiles, page customizations, and permission sets. It shows the security risks of overly permissive agent configurations and provides step-by-step AL code examples to limit what agents can see and do.

title: My 2026 Tradeshow Schedule and Highlights
summary: A presenter outlines their 2026 tradeshow schedule at Directions and DynamicsCon, featuring sessions on AI-powered Business Central extensions, performance optimization with telemetry tools, deprecation of OData page endpoints, and hackathon preparation, with code examples and resources to be shared after the events.

title: Native SFTP Support in Business Central 28
summary: Business Central 28 added a native SFTP Client codeunit (ID 9762) for listing, uploading, downloading and deleting files on SFTP servers from AL code. The author shows a sample that keeps the connection settings in Isolated Storage. An update says Microsoft has since decided to remove or deprecate the module because of platform hardening, so SFTP will again need alternatives such as Azure Functions.

title: Celebrating 55 Years of the 555 Timer
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

title: Maximizing Productivity with Copilot Cowork Skills

title: New Features for Report Lifecycle Management in Business Central 28.1
summary: Business Central 28.1 introduces report layout lifecycle management with status tracking. The Report Layouts page now supports Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, and Retired statuses, allowing developers to manage report layout versions without exposing incomplete versions to end users.

title: Boost Business Central Development with Skills in Visual Studio Code
summary: Skills in Visual Studio Code enable developers to create advanced, repeatable prompts for Business Central AL development. The post explains how to install and manage skills using a .github folder, and recommends existing skill libraries like the AL Development Collection to accelerate Copilot-assisted development.

title: Creating a Low-Cost RFID System with Business Central and Power Automate
summary: Building a low-cost RFID scan-in and scan-out system using an ESP32 microcontroller, PN532 RFID reader, Power Automate, and Business Central tables. The system captures location-based scans for resource tracking, automatically handles edge cases like forgotten scan-outs, and stores results in two related tables for monitoring.

title: Using Power Automate for Business Central SFTP
summary: Shows an alternative to native SFTP in Business Central: a custom table with a BLOB field, list and card pages, and an API page keyed on SystemId. A Power Automate flow reads a file from an SFTP server, creates a record through the API, then uploads the file content to the BLOB so it can be parsed in Business Central. The reverse direction, pushing files to SFTP, can be triggered with Business Events.

title: Step-by-Step Guide to Custom User Controls in Business Central
summary: Custom user controls in Business Central use HTML, JavaScript, and AL to create bespoke UI components beyond standard controls. The post demonstrates building a star rating control for vendors, covering the control addin definition, JavaScript implementation, and AL page integration.

title: Push Documents from Business Central to SFTP via Power Automate
summary: This post demonstrates how to push a Sales Invoice PDF from Business Central to an SFTP site whenever an invoice is posted, using a staging table, a custom codeunit that subscribes to posting events, and a Power Automate workflow to handle the file transfer and status updates.

title: Troubleshooting AL Extension in VS Code: Phantom Errors
summary: Resolving phantom AL extension errors in VS Code where tables appear marked as missing permission sets despite successful compilation. The issue occurs because file updates are only processed when the AL extension starts, and can be fixed by restarting the extension host.

title: Optimizing Business Central Indexes for Performance with Copilot
summary: The post shows how to export the Database Missing Indexes table to Excel and use a Copilot prompt to generate AL tableextension index recommendations. It then advises benchmarking with the Performance Profiler before and after, applying only about five indexes at a time, and weighing faster reads against slower writes, especially on GL Entry.

title: Connect Claude to Business Central MCP: A Step-by-Step Guide
summary: Step-by-step guide to connecting Claude Desktop to a Business Central MCP server through a locally hosted Python proxy (bc-mcp-proxy), which reduces authentication and configuration complexity. It covers the Entra ID app registration with redirect URIs and API permissions, registering the app in Business Central, running the proxy setup, and adding the generated config to claude_desktop_config.json.

title: Background Page Tasks in Business Central Explained
summary: Background page tasks enable pages to automatically refresh themselves or trigger actions when long-running processes complete. Introduced in Business Central 2019 Wave 2, they prevent users from repeatedly refreshing pages while waiting for operations to finish by using the OnPageBackgroundTaskCompleted trigger to update data and UI automatically.

title: Efficient AI Development in Business Central: Caveman Mode Explained
summary: Caveman Mode is a communication technique that reduces AI token consumption by approximately 75% while maintaining technical accuracy. This approach instructs AI to provide minimal narrative, drop pleasantries, and use brief responses, making it practical for cost-conscious Business Central development.

title: Understanding Business Central’s Format Address Codeunit
summary: Codeunit 365 (Format Address) handles address formatting across Business Central for customers, vendors, and contacts, applying global postal rules based on country configuration. The post explains its architecture, extensibility through integration events, and demonstrates how to extend it with custom logic for compliance or data correction.

title: Mastering the Business Central Administration API: A Complete Guide for SaaS Admins
summary: The Business Central Administration API enables SaaS admins to automate environment management tasks using scripts instead of the Administration Center. This first part covers authentication setup, app registration in Azure, and making initial API calls to retrieve environments, installed apps, and available updates.

title: Business Central v29: SQL Table Extensions Redesign Explained
summary: Business Central v29 completes a redesign of table extensions by storing all custom fields directly in the primary SQL table instead of creating separate extension tables, eliminating JOIN operations and improving performance. This architectural change simplifies indexing and reduces overhead for heavily customized systems but introduces a 1024-column SQL Server limit constraint.

title: Mastering Business Central API for App Management
summary: This post provides practical PowerShell examples for automating extension management in Business Central using the Administration API, including deploying .app files, monitoring installation progress, handling failures, and uninstalling extensions.

title: Automate Business Central Extension Deployment with PowerShell and the Admin API
summary: PowerShell automation script that deploys Business Central extensions to production by sorting them by dependencies, checking installed versions, and monitoring installation status through the Admin API. Useful when deploying multiple extensions from UAT environments or performing large-scale updates.

title: [Preview] bc2adls and Fabric Open Mirroring
summary: bc2adls release 26.32 adds preview support for Microsoft Fabric Open Mirroring. Business Central data files go to a Fabric Landing Zone, and Fabric does the CDC processing itself, so no notebook is needed. Setup requires a Landing Zone string, a _metadata.json file created through Schema Export, and a __rowMarker__ column in the exported files.

title: Document amount on Purchase Invoice Header
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 1 adds a feature to compare document-level totals with line-level amounts on purchase invoices, preventing posting discrepancies and ensuring data accuracy. The feature requires setup in Purchases & Payables and validates that header amounts match line totals, including VAT considerations.

title: Late Payment prediction in Fabric instead of BC
summary: Building a late payment prediction model in Microsoft Fabric using AutoML instead of the native Business Central feature. The post demonstrates how to export BC customer ledger data, engineer features from payment history, train an automated machine learning model, and score open invoices to forecast payment dates for cash flow planning.

title: Microsoft Agent Framework and Business Central MCP server
summary: The Business Central MCP server enables AI agents to connect to Business Central through the Microsoft Agent Framework. Pro-code developers can use the open-source Agent Framework combining Semantic Kernel and AutoGen to build .NET and Python agents that authenticate, connect to the MCP endpoint, and expose Business Central tools.

title: Data agent inside Fabric ask question on your Business Central Data
summary: Data Agents in Microsoft Fabric enable users to ask natural language questions about Business Central data without using APIs. The feature works with Mirrored Data sources for near real-time data synchronization and can be integrated into Copilot Studio for enhanced user experience.

title: Migrate bc2adls from PTE to appsource extension
summary: The bc2adls extension for exporting Business Central data to Azure Data Lake Storage is now available on AppSource. Users with the existing PTE extension can migrate to the AppSource version using a migration app while preserving their exported data and configuration.

title: Agents in Business Central – part 1 – the architecture
summary: Agents in Business Central 27.4 allow you to create custom agents that process tasks asynchronously using an orchestrator architecture. The post explains how agents are triggered via task creation, how the orchestrator manages execution with separate sessions and transactions, and how to handle incoming and outgoing messages programmatically.

title: Agents in Business Central – part 2 – the prompt
summary: Building effective agents in Business Central requires well-structured prompts with clear responsibilities, guidelines, and task instructions. The post explains how to use memory, page-specific instructions, and conditional logic to guide agent behavior reliably and keep humans in control.

title: Agents in Business Central – part 4 – troubleshooting
summary: This post explains how to troubleshoot Business Central agents when they don't behave as expected. It covers diagnostic tools like the Agent Consumption page and Agent Task Log, and identifies common pitfalls including unclear error messages, poorly written tooltips, excessive fields, and duplicate captions that confuse agents.

title: Agents in Business Central – part 5 – Creating agent from code
summary: This post explains how to create, configure, and register agents programmatically in Business Central using AL code instead of relying solely on configuration. It covers agent interfaces, capability registration, setup pages, and KPI tracking needed for production-ready, ALM-compatible agent solutions.

title: Agents in Business Central – part 6 – The conclusion
summary: This post compares agents built directly in Business Central with those created in Copilot Studio, covering deployment, licensing, capabilities, and integration scenarios. It provides guidance on choosing between the two approaches based on business requirements.

title: Native connection with Fabric in Business Central
summary: Business Central introduces native integration with Microsoft Fabric for data synchronization, replacing the need for APIs or bc2adls tools. The sync operates directly from the SQL database using change logs, supporting all tables with minute-level latency and no impact on Business Central performance.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 1 release: the state of SOAP deprecation.
summary: Starting with Business Central 2025 Wave 1 (version 26), exposing Microsoft UI pages as SOAP endpoints is off by default. It can be turned back on with a Feature Management key, and it will be removed for good in version 29. Custom pages exposed as SOAP still work but should move to OData. Exposing Microsoft UI pages as OData now gives warnings and stops being possible in version 30, so custom OData pages should move to APIs.

title: An MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central? Why not?
summary: Explains the Model Context Protocol, an open standard from Anthropic for connecting AI apps to tools and data, and contrasts it with function calling. The author argues MCP suits Business Central and demos an alpha Admin Center MCP server that lists installed AppSource apps, checks for updates and schedules them from GitHub Copilot agent mode or Cursor.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central agent capabilities: how much does they cost me?
summary: The post explains how the new Sales Order Agent in Business Central 2025 Wave 1 automates email-based sales quote processing and details the billing models for agentic AI features. It covers Copilot Studio message-based pricing (pay-as-you-go at $0.01 per message or prepaid message packs at $200/month for 25,000 messages), environment linking requirements, and cost scenarios ranging from $77 to $803 monthly based on agent complexity and usage.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: using secrets in JsonObjects.
summary: Handling secrets securely in JSON objects for API integrations in Business Central requires using the new WriteWithSecretsTo method introduced in runtime 15.1 (version 26.1). This method replaces placeholder values with SecretText credentials before serializing the JSON, preventing secrets from being exposed during debugging.

title: Azure Function SQL Trigger: how to use it (and why it can be useful in your Business Central projects)
summary: Azure SQL Triggers for Azure Functions enable real-time event-driven integrations with Business Central by automatically triggering a function when data changes occur in a SQL database. The post demonstrates setup, implementation, and testing of SQL change tracking to synchronize external application data with Business Central.

title: GitHub Copilot Coding Agent helps you stay strong on the bike…
summary: The author assigned an urgent issue on an internal Business Central app to the GitHub Copilot Coding Agent from GitHub Mobile while out cycling. The agent worked in a cloud environment run on GitHub Actions and opened a pull request that added new events to the AL code, which the author reviewed and accepted. The agent is in preview and has to be enabled on the GitHub organization or account.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: using a static IP address to access APIs.
summary: When third-party systems require a static IP address for API calls to Business Central, a common solution uses an Azure Function with a virtual network NAT gateway to route traffic through a fixed outbound IP. This approach bypasses the limitation that SaaS environments have dynamic IP addresses.

title: High performance workflows with Azure Logic Apps: using Azure SQL as storage provider.
